Teacher Lesson Preparation Manual 📅 Class Progress Week 01 📅 2026-09-01 (2)
👋 Smiling and Greeting Superman
🏷️ Unit 1: Self-Awareness and Classroom Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Vitality Greeting Officer

[Meet each other at the beginning of school] Say hello loudly - get to know new classmates and establish a sense of security

🎯 Summary of core objectives:On the first day of school, students overcame their unfamiliarity and shyness, learning to make eye contact, smile, and greet their teachers and peers with their names and a "good morning."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎒 The little bear in the magic backpack and the first "Good morning"!

On September 1, the first day of school, colorful welcome balloons were hung at the door of the special education classroom. The four little heroes walked into the classroom carrying new schoolbags, feeling both excited and nervous. Yu clutched the strap of his schoolbag and lowered his head, Xiaojiu looked around looking irritated, He was shy and hid behind the door, and Jia looked around curiously. Smiling, he walked forward with a bear puppet and said, "Good morning, everyone!" Welcome to our warm learning castle!”The little bear hand puppet stretched out his hand to everyone, looking at everyone gently with his eyes. Yu took a deep breath, raised his head and said loudly: "Good morning!" I am Yu!"This loud greeting lit up the whole classroom like sunshine, and everyone laughed happily!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you meet Xinhe classmates for the first time, if you keep your head down and say nothing, will others recognize you? What magic can come from looking someone in the eye and saying good morning out loud?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:On the first day of school, everyone walks into the classroom, faces a new teacher and new classmates, and practices making eye contact, smiling, and clearly introducing themselves!
🦁 Yu Yu took the initiative to greet her
🎬 Action:Stand tall with your head held high and chest out, look straight ahead, smile with the corners of your mouth turned up, and wave your right hand to greet others.
"Good morning everyone!" My name is Yu. Please give me your advice in the new semester!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome anxiety in unfamiliar situations and practice active spoken greetings.
🐻 Jun Jun introduces himself generously
🎬 Action:Let your arms hang naturally at your sides, take a step forward with steady steps, and speak loudly.
"I am Jia!" I like sports and building blocks the most, and I am very happy to be in the same class with you all! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance to transform excess energy into generous and confident self-expression.
🐼 He A gentle response from He
🎬 Action:Gently place your hands in front of your stomach, bow deeply to everyone, and look at them with gentle eyes.
"Hello, I am He, and I will often help you organize the classroom! ”
💡 Tips:Help He speak openly in safe situations to improve self-efficacy.
🦊 Jia A warm welcome to Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the class welcome sign and lead the applause three times to create a lively welcoming atmosphere.
"Welcome to the learning classroom!"The four of us will definitely be the best team!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to give full play to the advantages of affinity and hosting leadership.

🎯 IEP Quantitative Goals & Putt Collaboration & Family Life Behavioral classification tripartite connection
🎯 IEP observable quantitative goals:When encountering relevant social or emotional situations, students can make "👋 The corresponding behavior of "Smile and say hello to Superboy" has an achievement rate of over 80%.
🏫 Post-it notes on integration tips for regular class instructors:
[Put Cooperation Formula] When students encounter a situation similar to "meeting each other at the beginning of school and saying hello loudly" in the ordinary class, please prompt the formula: "Start [👋 Say hello to Superboy with a smile]! ";publicly affirm his progress in class: "Look, your classmate just did it [👋 Say hello to Superboy with a smile], very polite! ”
🏠 Home Practice Check-In:
After returning home from school, raise your head, smile and say loudly "Dad/Mom, I'm back" to your family, and give them a warm high-five!
🧩 Individualized differentiated support (support scaffolding for students with special needs) UDL multiple representation and participation
🔹 Students with autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
Provide "👋 Smile and say hello, "Superman" structured visual prompt card, marking eye focus and body distance to reduce anxiety in unfamiliar social situations.
🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)
There is no need for cumbersome text copying. The whole process uses color picture and text circle selection, body movement drills and oral repetition as the main learning evaluation methods.
🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Before the drill, clearly agree on the safety boundary and token rewards. If you are emotionally excited, you are allowed to go to the calm corner to take a deep breath, and then conduct the role drill after your emotions stabilize.

🎖️ Today’s Badge: Focused Gaze Officer

Friendly Looks and Warm Smiles: Communicating Without Words

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Learn nonverbal social signals: Look at the other person's "triangle between their eyebrows" for two to three seconds and give them a genuine smile to overcome shifty and avoidant eye contact.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦉 Grandpa Owl's "Magic Triangle Between the Eyebrows"!

In the elementary school classroom at OO, Yu always looked at the floor or the fan when talking to people. His classmates often asked him, "Yu, are you even listening to me?" Yu felt wronged. He was definitely listening, but looking into other people's eyes made his heart race and made him very uncomfortable. Principal Owl gave him a small transparent card with an inverted triangle drawn on it: "Child, you don't need to stare into the other person's eyes. Just look at the 'triangle between their eyebrows,' and they will feel your focus and respect!" Yu practiced, smiling at He's brow. He happily said, "Yu, you look so handsome when you smile at me!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you're talking to someone and your eyes are constantly looking at the ground, how will the other person feel? What is the "magic triangle between the eyebrows" referring to?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:If the other person looks around while you are speaking, it will make you feel disrespected. The four partners practice "looking at each other between the eyebrows + smiling for three seconds"!
🦁 Yu Yu focusing on the space between the eyebrows
🎬 Action:Focus your eyes on the space between the other person's eyebrows, lean forward slightly, and nod earnestly.
"Look, Jia!"I am looking at your eyebrows now, I am listening to you attentively!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use the visual fixation point between the eyebrows instead of looking directly at the eyeballs to reduce social anxiety.
🐻 Jun A young man who feels respected
🎬 Action:Put down the toy ball in your hand, face Yu, place your hands flat, and smile in response.
"Yu, you look at me talking, I feel so comfortable, I know you are listening!"”
💡 Tips:The guide experiences the positive feedback of being listened to with respect.
🐼 He Little He with a gentle gaze
🎬 Action:Slightly raise the corners of your mouth, look warmly at your peers, and gently clap your hands.
"Everyone looks at each other and smiles when they talk. The atmosphere when we talk is so warm! ”
💡 Tips:Help He strengthen the consistency of eyes and facial expressions.
🦊 Jia Watching the timekeeper, Jia
🎬 Action:Extend three fingers to show a "three-second countdown" and confirm that both parties are looking at each other.
"Look at it for three seconds and smile!" Eye Spotlight was a great success, everyone cleared the level! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to master the quantitative standards of non-verbal communication.

🎛️ Magical volume control on the dashboard
🏷️ Unit 1: Self-Awareness and Classroom Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Volume Wizard

The Five-Level Voice Meter: Choosing the Right Volume

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Develop environmental volume awareness: recognize 1 minute for whispering, 2 minute for small group whispering, 3 minute for whole class speaking, 4 minute for loudspeaker on the playground, and 5 minute for emergency help, and learn to adjust the volume according to the location.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🔊 Big Horn, Little Dinosaur, and Magical Volume Control!

Jia's voice is very loud. When speaking in the corridor, it's like turning on a loudspeaker. When reading in the library, he also yells! Today I drew a colorful "volume five-level instrument panel" on the blackboard: "1 point is like a kitten whispering, used in the library and lunch break;2 points is like two birds chatting, used in group discussions; 3 points is like a lecture, used in raising hands to speak; 4 points is like a playground athlete, used in outdoor physical education classes; 5 points is like a life-saving roar in the event of a fire! ”Let Jia practice turning the volume knob. When Xiaojiu adjusted the volume from 4 minutes to 2 minutes and spoke to Yu gently, Yu said happily: "Xiaojiu, it sounds great when you speak with a 2 minutes voice!"”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you speak at a 4/5 volume in a quiet classroom or library, who will you disturb? What volume should you use during group discussions?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the library and group discussion, everyone practiced turning their throat knob to the correct volume level!
🦁 Yu Yu adjusting the volume
🎬 Action:Place your index finger in front of your lips to indicate quiet, and lower your throat to produce a steady and gentle voice.
"It's library time now, I'll switch the sound to a whisper!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to switch volume levels autonomously in different situations.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, who pressed the brakes on his loud voice
🎬 Action:Place your right hand on your throat and feel the vibration. Intentionally soften your tone and speak softly.
"Hoo~ I turned down the loudspeaker!"Now for the group discussion, I’m using volume two!”
💡 Tips:Guide the speaker to detect the vibration intensity of the larynx and self-regulate the speaking decibels.
🐼 He The soft-spoken He
🎬 Action:Take a small step closer to your peer, and speak in a clear but gentle voice, like a breeze.
"Jia, your voice has become gentler, and you can just hear it when we discuss it like this!"”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the comfortable communication feeling brought by appropriate sound volume.
🦊 Jia Volume Tester - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold the volume indicator card, point to the green 2-minute mark, and nod vigorously in affirmation.
"The volume is accurately locked by two points!" No noise, you can hear clearly, the class is 100% quiet! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the monitoring and feedback of the collective sound environment.

💌 Little Ambassador of Respect and Gratitude to Teachers
🏷️ Unit 2: Autumn Celebrations and Gratitude 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: A role model for respecting teachers

[Teacher's Day] Seeing the hard work of teachers, I sincerely say "Thank you"

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with Teachers' Day in September, guide students to recognize the hard work of special education and regular class teachers, and express their sincere gratitude through specific polite actions (standing at attention, bowing, and presenting cards with both hands).

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💐 The cup of warm water and the bright red teacher's card in front of the podium!

Teacher's Day is coming on September 28th, and gratitude music is playing on campus. He observed that he had to correct homework every day, practice emotional thermometer with everyone, and lead the team. He was often so busy that he had no time to drink water and his throat became hoarse. When class was over, He quietly brought warm water and put it on the table. Yu and Xiaojiu also took out hand-painted golden love cards, and Jia wrote "Happy Teacher's Day" on the blackboard. When I walked into the classroom and saw all this, I was so moved that my eyes became red. The four little heroes stood up straight and bowed deeply: "Thank you for teaching us patiently every day, and I wish you a happy Teacher's Day!" ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What hard things do you usually do to take care of everyone? In addition to saying Happy Holidays on Teachers' Day, what actions can we take to express our gratitude?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:It's Teacher's Day, and four little heroes practice giving sincere thanks and gifts to their mentors and special education teachers who have worked hard to accompany them!
🦁 Yu Yu bowing respectfully
🎬 Action:Place both hands on either side of your thighs, bend your waist at a 45-degree angle, and bow deeply to the teacher.
"Hello, teacher!"Thank you for patiently teaching me to breathe deeply every day. I wish you a happy Teacher's Day!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to implement the complete teacher-respecting etiquette of "standing at attention, bowing, and looking at".
🐻 Jun Little Jun, loudly proclaiming your love
🎬 Action:Respectfully present the hand-drawn gold heart card with both hands, and speak with sincere and bright eyes.
"Thank you for your hard work, teacher!"I cut this card by myself. I will definitely pay more attention in class in the future!”
💡 Tips:Guide students to turn their impulses into respect for their teachers and self-commitment.
🐼 He Here's some warm water for you, He.
🎬 Action:Hold the cup of warm water with both hands and gently place it on the table, with a warm smile on your face.
"Teacher, you are thirsty after talking. Please take a sip of warm water. Thank you for taking care of us every day!"”
💡 Tips:Help He practice considerate action in life observation.
🦊 Jia Respect for Teachers Commander - Jia
🎬 Action:Raise the hand gesture and lead all students in saying thank you and applauding enthusiastically.
"Salute!" Thank you, teacher. I wish you happiness every day and a happy Teacher’s Day!”
💡 Tips:Guide the group to create a positive atmosphere of gratitude.

🌕 Mid-Autumn Festival Treats to Foodies
🏷️ Unit 2: Autumn Celebrations and Gratitude 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Share the fairy

[Mid-Autumn Festival] Mooncake and Pomelo Reunion: Food sharing and taking turns

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the etiquette of taking snacks at festive parties: queue up, each person takes one portion and doesn't hoard the largest piece, and offer snacks to classmates to enjoy the fun of sharing with others.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🥮 A round and plump egg yolk pastry with an adorable pomelo hat!

The Mid-Autumn Festival celebration table was laden with fragrant egg yolk pastries and pomelos. The most eye-catching item was the "Golden Egg Yolk Pastry" in the very center of the plate, studded with a large egg yolk! Jun's mouth watered at the sight, and he immediately reached out to grab it! Jia gently reminded him, "Jun, we need to take one each in line!" Remembering that the Mid-Autumn Festival represents "completeness and courtesy," Jun took a deep breath, withdrew his hand, and smiled at Yu, saying, "Yu, you go first! You love egg yolks the most!" Yu was overjoyed. Everyone wore green pomelo hats that He had peeled himself, sitting around eating mooncakes, their hearts filled with a sweeter, more complete joy than the moon itself!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What would happen if we grabbed the biggest mooncake we wanted? Why did everyone laugh even more when Jun offered it to Yu?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:At the Mid-Autumn Festival celebration, everyone lined up to get snacks. When faced with the most popular egg yolk pastry, everyone practiced taking one and offering it to their friends!
🦁 Yu Yu, who follows the rules of queuing
🎬 Action:Hold your small paper plate and stand quietly at the back of the line, holding the plate with both hands and not pushing or shoving.
"Everyone in line gets a piece. Everyone can eat it. The round moon is so happy during the Mid-Autumn Festival!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to maintain queuing body boundaries when the food is present.
🐻 Jun The polite little fellow
🎬 Action:Pull back the hand that is about to be reached out to grab, step aside to let your peer choose first, and smile on your face.
"Yu, take it first!"I’ll leave you with the largest piece of egg yolk cake, and I’ll get the mung bean cake next to it!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to restrain their desire for exclusivity and experience the high self-esteem brought by courtesy.
🐼 He Little He distributing pomelo hats
🎬 Action:Gently place the grapefruit peel, which has been peeled into a crown shape, on your colleague's head with both hands and smile gently.
"Wear a grapefruit to keep you safe!" The grapefruit meat is so sweet and juicy, let’s eat it slowly together! ”
💡 Tips:Help He invest in sharing roles and enjoy the joy of social interaction.
🦊 Jia Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion Host - Jia
🎬 Action:Raise paper cups with both hands and lead everyone in a toast with fruit juice instead of tea to celebrate the successful completion of the festival.
"It is sweetest when people in the full moon are reunited and know how to share!"Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to everyone!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the core values ​​of the festival.

[Double Ten National Day] Group gathering and queuing: Put your hands on both sides and look ahead

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the group marching discipline: look ahead, keep your hands at your sides without swinging them too much, take steady steps without looking around or stepping on your heels.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🇹🇼 National Day flag bearers and the majestic little train in the corridor!

On National Day, the whole school lined up to walk to the playground for the flag-raising ceremony. Jun, who loves to look around while walking, would glance at the swallows' nest and kick the shoes in front of him. "Thump!" Jun stepped on Yu's heel! Yu almost fell: "Ouch! Don't keep stepping on me!" Jia, the team leader, waved his small national flag and announced the rhyme: "Hands on thighs, eyes looking behind your head, one step apart!" Jun immediately withdrew his hands and feet and stood up straight. The line marched forward in perfect unison, the national flag fluttering in the morning sun, and everyone looked incredibly proud!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What dangers might occur if we turn our heads around and step randomly while walking in a line? Where should we put our eyes and hands when walking?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:During the National Day flag-raising ceremony, the whole school moved in a line. Four students practiced maintaining a safe distance, keeping their hands on their thighs, and looking straight ahead while moving forward!
🦁 Yu Yu, the straight-legged team leader
🎬 Action:Stand tall with your chest out, focus your eyes on the back of the student in front of you, and walk steadily with your hands close to your thighs.
"Put your hands on your sides and look ahead!" Follow the beat step by step, the team is neat and safe! ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu to maintain the stability of the moving line with a visual fixed point.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who braked just in time
🎬 Action:Retract your kicking feet, stand up straight immediately, and take a step away from the student in front of you.
"What a risk!"I almost stepped on someone! I am now a little National Day guard, walking attentively without pushing!”
💡 Tips:Help Jun to control excessive movements of the limbs and maintain self-control in traveling.
🐼 He Maintain a small following distance
🎬 Action:Extend your arm forward to show a safe distance and gently remind the students behind you to slow down.
"Everyone keeps an arm's length apart, one section after another like a small train!”
💡 Tips:Help He establish a clear concept of body space.
🦊 Jia Marching Review Officer - Jia
🎬 Action:Holding a small national flag, guide the procession from the side, leading everyone into the venue in neat steps.
"Keep pace and be energetic!"All members of the OO special education guard team have met the standards!”
💡 Tips:Guidance Jia exerts guidance and regular motivation abilities.

🧭 Detecting body alarms
🏷️ Unit 3: Understanding Feelings and Practicing Self-Control 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Body Detective

My Body's Alarm: Noticing Signs of Anger

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Guide students to become aware of physical physiological signals such as rapid heartbeat, clenched fists, and flushed face, and use a 1-5 point emotional thermometer to visualize anger and establish a sense of braking.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💥 The Thunderous Block Castle Collapses and Heart-Pounding Drums!

Xiaohao spent a whole class building the building block castle, but it was severely smashed by classmates who were running to pick up the ball! Xiao Hao froze on the spot, his palms were sweating wildly, his fists were clenched as tightly as stones, and his teeth were clenching. His chest said "Dong dong!"Boom!” Beating like a drum, the whole face was as hot as a furnace! There's a train screaming in my head: "I'm going to rush up and beat them up!" ” Holding his shoulders gently: “Xiao Hao, look at your emotional thermometer. What’s your temperature now? "Xiao Hao looked at the thermometer, took a deep breath and shouted: "I'm four points now! I'm about to explode! ”The moment he mentioned the thermometer, his body slowly found the brake pedal!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What angry warning signs did Xiaohao's body send out? Say your emotional score aloud; why does this help put the brakes on your brain?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When the building blocks are knocked over and everyone is about to explode with anger, everyone practices pointing out physical warning signs such as heartbeat and clenched fist, and saying the score of the emotional thermometer!
🦁 Yu Yu, who sensed the alarm
🎬 Action:Look down at the blocks on the ground, clench your fists and slowly release them, take a deep breath and feel your heartbeat, pick up the mood thermometer and point to 4.
"My castle has been knocked down!"My heart is beating so fast and the thermometer is 4 points! I was angry but I took a deep breath first!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to identify alarm signals such as rapid heartbeat and flushed face, and tell the level to replace physical outbursts.
🐻 Jun Little Jun suppressing his impulses
🎬 Action:Immediately stop walking, turn to face Yu, lower your hands without defense, look sincerely into his eyes and bow.
"I'm sorry!"I was running too fast and knocked down your building blocks! Let me help you pick up the blocks and re-cover them!”
💡 Tips:Leaders should stop immediately when faced with conflict, adopt a non-confrontational stance, and offer specific compensation.
🐼 He Handing over the acupressure ball.
🎬 Action:Quickly walk to the locker, take out the acupressure ball and deep breathing chart, hand them to Yu, and gently pat his shoulders.
"Yu first holds the acupressure ball, inhale and exhale with me, and let's slowly lower the temperature! ”
💡 Tips:Help He play a supportive role in calming the emotions of peers, and provide sensory soothing teaching aids.
🦊 Jia Thermometer Recorder - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold an emotion thermometer rating board next to Yu and record the score changes, giving positive verbal feedback.
"That's awesome!" It only took thirty seconds from Yu saying four points to taking a deep breath and lowering it back to three points! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to observe the emotional regulation process of peers and strengthen self-monitoring and positive reinforcement.

🛡️ The amazing turtle shell-shrinking technique
🏷️ Unit 3: Understanding Feelings and Practicing Self-Control 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Braking master

The Turtle Pause: Breathe Three Times and Count to Ten

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master impulse control techniques: When you feel like you're about to lose your temper or attack, cross your arms over your chest like a turtle retracting into its shell, take three deep breaths, and mentally count down ten seconds.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🐢 Po the little turtle's magical green protective shell!

Po, the little turtle, used to be a ticking time bomb. If anyone touched him, he'd immediately lash out with his claws. Grandpa Turtle gave him a magic book: 'When you feel like getting angry, retract your head and hands into your shell, slowly inhale and exhale, counting in your mind: ten, nine, eight… all the way down to one!' Today after class, a classmate accidentally snatched Po's beloved colored pencils. Just as Po was about to retaliate, he suddenly remembered the turtle's secret! He immediately crossed his arms, pressed his chin to his chest, and curled up into a ball. He closed his eyes inside his shell, took a deep breath, and counted to one in his mind. Ten seconds later, Po looked up; the storm had passed. He calmly said, 'Please give me back my pencil.' The whole class applauded Po's miraculous braking!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you want to hit someone or cry and scream, what happens to the anger in your brain when you shrink into your shell and count to ten?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When a toy is snatched or accidentally bumped into, everyone practice immediately making a homemade braking motion by "hugging your chest and counting to ten"!
🦁 Yu Yu, who shrank his car and braked.
🎬 Action:Cross your arms in front of your chest, tuck your chin to your collarbone, close your eyes, and slowly and evenly inhale and exhale three times.
"Tuck yourself into the turtle shell and take a deep breath, one, two, three!"I put my fist away and I will talk again in ten seconds!”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu blocks the impulse to attack through the proprioceptive stimulation of the chest.
🐻 Jun The little farmer counting to ten
🎬 Action:Place your fists on your abdomen, stand firmly on the ground, count down to one in your mind, and exhale a long breath.
"Ten, nine, eight... three, two, one!"Phew~ the fire was extinguished, I successfully pressed on the brakes!”
💡 Tips:The guide uses a countdown to switch the brain's hot zone to the prefrontal cooling zone.
🐼 He Gentle and protective little one
🎬 Action:Stand quietly by your side, without rushing or mocking, and gently count the beats to help your partner relax their shoulders.
"Well done, Jia. Slowly relax your shoulders. The turtle shell protects you. You are so awesome without hitting anyone!"”
💡 Tips:Help He give peers a safe space for cooling off periods.
🦊 Jia Award presenter for brake compliance - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the green turtle badge sticker and stick it on the chest of the partner who successfully stepped on the brake.
"Restrain your fists and move your brain, the tortoise is the best in the world in braking skills!"We are all little heroes of emotional self-discipline!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen self-control and honor recognition.

🍬 Politely ask for candy without causing trouble
🏷️ Unit 2: Autumn Celebrations and Gratitude 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Halloween Gentleman Elf

[Halloween] Trick-or-treating little gentleman: The line between politeness and joking when asking for candy

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the etiquette of asking for candy and costume parades during festivals: politely say please and thank you, don't use masks to scare people, and stop immediately when someone tells you not to play pranks.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎃 A pumpkin basket filled with gold coin chocolates and a terrifying giant pumpkin mask!

At the Halloween costume party, the fourth grader Jia wore a vampire mask that glowed red and was full of fangs, and walked in the corridor "Wow——!" "Shouting is scary!" The little sister in the lower grade was so frightened that she cried and dropped the pumpkin basket in her hand. He came over and reminded me gently: "Xiaojiu, Halloween is a holiday that brings laughter to everyone, not a holiday that scares others to tears!" If someone is already crying or saying they are scared, we need to take off the mask immediately!"Xiaojiu quickly took off his mask, squatted down to help his little sister pick up the pumpkin basket, and took out one of his pumpkin marshmallows and gave it to her: "I'm sorry, little sister, I am brother Xiaojiu wearing a mask, don't be afraid!” The little sister wiped away her tears and smiled, and the joyful laughter returned to the corridor!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What should we do if a classmate is already crying from fright when we're joking around on Halloween? What's a polite thing to say when asking for candy?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Halloween parade trick-or-treating and masked interaction. Everyone practiced knocking on doors politely to ask for candy and respecting those who are scared!
🦁 Yu Yu politely asks for candy
🎬 Action:Carry the pumpkin basket, walk to the door and knock three times, look at the other person and show a cute smile.
"Trick or treat!"Could you please give me a candy? Happy Halloween everyone!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to maintain the etiquette of knocking on doors and greetings in a carnival atmosphere.
🐻 Jun Little Jun takes off his mask and apologizes
🎬 Action:Immediately push the scary vampire mask up to your head, revealing your sincere face, and return the candy you picked up with both hands.
"I'm sorry!"I didn't know you were scared! I took off the mask and gave you this strawberry candy!”
💡 Tips:The guide is keenly aware of the fear reactions of others and immediately stops the mischievous behavior.
🐼 He Comforting the frightened peers, He
🎬 Action:Gently pat the back of the frightened classmate, hand them a small tissue, and soothe their emotions.
"It's okay, it's okay. That's the mask played by Brother Jia. Let's go get some delicious pumpkin cookies together!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He exert the power of peer stability care.
🦊 Jia Halloween Parade Captain - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the glowing pumpkin stick and lead the line forward in order to maintain order in the candy-asking line.
"If you want candy, say please and thank you, don't push, don't scare, we are the best little gentlemen and ladies on Halloween!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the festival etiquette guidelines.

✋ Quietly raise your hand and wait to be called on.
🏷️ Unit 4: Classroom Routines and Learning Together 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Speech Keeper Star

Raising a Hand: Waiting for Your Turn to Speak

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the boundaries of body language when speaking in class: sit upright, keep your elbows on the table and raise them quietly, keep your mouth closed and wait to be called on, and overcome the habit of impulsively shouting out when you think of an answer.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦖 The little Tyrannosaurus Rex that interrupts and the great magician who raises his hand!

An interesting guessing question was asked in the social studies class: "What white English letters are on the chest of the Taiwanese black bear?""Xiaojiu just read the animal encyclopedia yesterday. He was so excited that he jumped up on the chair and waved his hands wildly and shouted: "I know! It’s V! Choose me! Choose me!” The whole classroom was buzzing. He frowned and nodded at He, who was sitting in the second row, sitting upright with his right hand raised quietly: "He, please answer." He stood up and said gently: "It's the English letter V." ” He stamped He with a smile. Xiaojiu sat down angrily: "Obviously I said it first!" "Tell him: "It's great that Jia answered correctly, but the magic of speaking in class is to "raise your hand first, wait for your name to be called, and then speak."If you rush to talk, everyone will not be able to hear clearly! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Although Jia knew the answer, why didn't he ask him to speak first? What do you do to be popular when you want to be published?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In class, students almost got into a big argument by rushing to answer questions. Four students demonstrated proper speaking etiquette: "Elbows on the table, mouths closed, and only stand up when called by name!"
🦁 Yu Yu, a model of quietly raising her hand
🎬 Action:Sit up straight with your back straight, elbows on the table, right hand raised quietly, and eyes looking at the teacher without making a sound.
"I want to answer the question, but I first raise my hands, close my mouth, and wait for the teacher to call my name before I speak!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu through the specific physical boundaries of "elbows on the table, mouth closed", waiting to be called.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, who pressed the brakes on interrupting.
🎬 Action:Sit back in the chair, take a deep breath, purse your lips tightly to suppress the urge to shout, and place your hands on your knees.
"What a risk!"I almost shouted and interrupted again! I want to practice waiting patiently and abide by the hand-raising rule in class!”
💡 Tips:Help Jun to detect the physical precursors of the urge to jump, and turn energy into the power to sit quietly.
🐼 He The gentle response from He
🎬 Action:After hearing the teacher call your name, stand up, keep your body steady, and say the answer clearly and gently.
"The teacher called my name, and the answer is the English letter V!"After answering, I sat down quietly.”
💡 Tips:Help He practice standing firm and speaking generously when called.
🦊 Jia Hand-raising etiquette referee - Jia
🎬 Action:Take out the class participation scoreboard and stamp a smiley face on the "Quietly waiting without interrupting" column.
"Awesome! Everyone raises their hands first, waits for roll call, and then speaks. Classroom order is 100%!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the social cognitive reward of "waiting for others to finish speaking".

Back to Class: Getting Ready When the Bell Rings

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the routine for switching to class when the bell rings: put down your toys, return to your seat, take three deep breaths, and take out your textbook for the next class to improve transition anxiety and procrastination.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🔔 Flying spinning top and the magical school bell!

Twenty minutes after class, fourth graders Yu and Xiaozuo started a golden top showdown in the corridor! The top rotated at high speed and made a crisp collision sound, and the surroundings were surrounded by classmates cheering. Just as Xiaozuo's top launched its ultimate move, "Danglanglang—Danglanglang—" the school bell suddenly rang! Xiaojiu still yelled: "Wait a minute!"Fight for the last three seconds!"Although Yu also wanted to see the result, he looked at the clock on the wall and decisively pressed the gyro transmitter: "Yu, the bell is ringing! I have said that the sound of the bell is an order. Let’s put the top away and return to our seats!”Xiao Kazuo also ran over quickly to help pick up the parts. Within thirty seconds, all four children sat upright in their seats and opened their Mandarin textbooks. The instructor walked into the classroom and saw the whole class neatly seated, and gave the class a big badge of honor!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What would happen if we refused to return to the classroom when the clock struck midnight and we were having the most fun? What actions should we take within thirty seconds of the clock striking midnight?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When the bell rings to signal the end of class, everyone is engrossed in playing with their toys. Practice putting down the toys immediately, returning to your seats, and arranging your textbooks!
🦁 Yu Yu, the leader of the "Getting Back on Track" team
🎬 Action:Upon hearing the bell, immediately put down the building blocks in your hands, stand up and move the chair closer together.
"The school bell is ringing!"The toys are put aside first, and we go back to our seats and take out our Chinese textbooks and pencil cases!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a bell control response and quickly switch activity situations.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, reluctant to part
🎬 Action:Take a deep breath, take a picture of the unfinished building blocks as evidence, and quickly put them into your storage box.
"Okay!"Although I still want to play, I have to concentrate in class and continue building after class!”
💡 Tips:Delayed gratification in guided practice activity transitions.
🐼 He Desktop Organizer Expert - He
🎬 Action:Quickly sweep the scattered building blocks on the ground into the storage box and close the lid.
"The desktop is clean and the mind is calm. Let's sit upright and wait for the teacher to teach!"”
💡 Tips:Help He establish good classroom routines.
🦊 Jia Jia, the "Return to Home" Inspector
🎬 Action:Check all the desks in the class to make sure that all four students are sitting upright in their seats.
"Thirty seconds after the bell rings, everyone is seated and seated. Full marks in the OO elementary school learning classroom!" ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia is responsible for regular inspections and improves participation.

Joining a Game: May I Play Too?

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the strategy of integrating into peer games: First, observe from the side for three seconds, wait for the game to pause, make eye contact and ask, "May I join?", and calmly accept if rejected.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
⚽ A soccer tournament on the playground and a lonely little fox!

After class, the students on the playground are playing an exciting football game. Jia stood next to the goal with her own water bottle, really wanting to play football together. But Jia didn't know what to say, so she suddenly rushed into the field, took the football away and shouted, "I want to play too!"Let me kick it instead!” The classmate who was originally playing vigorously yelled angrily: "Why are you trying to steal our ball!"Very rude! No more fun for you!” Jia froze in place, tears about to fall. He came over and took Jia's hand: "Jia, if you want to play with the ball, you can't grab it." We have to stand on the sidelines and watch how everyone plays. When the ball stops, we look at the captain and ask politely: "Can I join you?" Jia wiped away her tears and followed the instructions. The football captain smiled and said: "Okay!" You become the goalkeeper! ”Jia jumped up happily!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you want to join someone else's game, how would everyone feel if you just snatched the ball away? What are the three correct steps to join?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Everyone is having a great time playing on the playground. Four friends practice observing, waiting for an opening, and then politely requesting to join the game!
🦁 Yu Yu asks a polite question
🎬 Action:Stand on the sidelines for three seconds, then walk up to the captain during the time when the ball goes out of bounds and you have a break, look at the captain and smile as you ask.
"You play football so well!" Can I join and play together? ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to grasp the timing of entry into peer games.
🐻 Jun A warm welcome from Jun
🎬 Action:Stop the ball under your feet, raise your head and wave to Yu, and confidently assign positions.
"Okay!" Welcome to join! We happen to be short of a defender, you come to defend this side! ”
💡 Tips:Leaders demonstrate a generous and cooperative attitude that accepts peers.
🐼 He Little He who follows the rules
🎬 Action:Briefly explain the game progress and score to new members to help them integrate.
"Now it's two to one, we wear blue vests, and we score if we kick into the white frame!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He provide peers with specific game rules instructions.
🦊 Jia Friendship Referee Jia
🎬 Action:Blow the whistle to announce the restart of the game and applaud and cheer for both teams.
"With polite greetings and warm acceptance, the playground friendship competition officially begins! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance and recognition of group inclusion and fair play.

[Thanksgiving] Friendship Money Box: See the little angel around you and accumulate gold coins of positive popularity.

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Experience the concept of reciprocity in interpersonal relationships: every kind word spoken or every helping hand is like depositing a coin into the friendship piggy bank; complaining and taking action are like deducting a coin.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🪙 Grandpa Elephant's Golden Friendship Piggy Bank!

On Thanksgiving Day, Principal Elephant presented the special education classroom with four gleaming gold piggy banks: "Children, everyone has a 'Friendship Piggy Bank' in their heart. When you walk into the classroom in the morning and smile and say good morning to your classmates, you deposit one gold coin; when you lend a pencil to a classmate, you deposit another gold coin! But if you swear or steal, five gold coins will be deducted!" Looking at his piggy bank, Jun decided to be the "Pig King" today! He picked up Yu's fallen colored pencils, helped He move his chair closer, and praised Jia's drawing of a cute turkey! For each good deed he did, the whole class would "ding-dong!" and drop a gold token into his piggy bank. At the end of the school day, Jun's piggy bank jingled incessantly, and Jun excitedly shouted: "Doing good deeds deposits gold coins, now I'm the richest friend in the world!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What things can we do to deposit coins into our friendship piggy bank? What things will deplete our friend's savings?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Thanksgiving sharing session. Everyone should think back to the little angels who have helped them and take the initiative to say a word of praise and thanks to their friends!
🦁 Yu Yu deposited sharing coins
🎬 Action:Hold your beloved dinosaur encyclopedia with both hands and lend it to your peers, then drop a gold token into the transparent piggy bank.
"Ding dong!"I borrowed my classmates’ beautiful encyclopedias and deposited a gold coin in everyone’s friendship piggy bank!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to accumulate positive interpersonal capital through specific sharing behaviors.
🐻 Jun Little Jun depositing courtesy coins
🎬 Action:Step back to the side in front of the water dispenser, smile and let the thirsty student fill up first, and insert the token.
"Ding dong!"I politely asked my classmates to fill the water first! Don’t push me, be more polite, my popular piggy bank is getting heavier and heavier!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to practice politeness in daily chores and experience the sense of accomplishment of increased interpersonal savings.
🐼 He Deposit Listening Coins (Little He)
🎬 Action:Sit quietly next to your peer and watch them speak, nod in response, and insert a flashing coin.
"Ding dong!"I patiently listened to what my good friend was saying! Be a warm listener and store a lot of love!”
💡 Tips:Help He develop listening and empathic qualities to deepen interpersonal intimacy.
🦊 Jia Jia, the richest banker in Friendship
🎬 Action:Shake the piggy bank filled with gold coins, which makes a crisp sound, to announce that everyone has made it onto the Friendship Monopoly Gold List.
"By depositing good words and good deeds every day, everyone in the OO learning classroom will become a friendship tycoon worth billions!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide and reward positive cycle interpersonal behaviors with a sense of achievement.

Building Together: Taking Turns and Sharing Jobs

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the core elements of teamwork: take turns receiving materials, divide tasks according to ability and avoid monopolizing them, and compromise and negotiate when encountering differences of opinion.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚀 The construction of a dream Mars space station is a marvel!

A super challenge came to the special education classroom today - took out four large boxes of colorful magnetic sheets and announced: "Today, the four special service team members Yu, He, Jia and Zhen will work together to build a "dream space station" to land on Mars! "When they heard about the task, everyone wanted to grab the biggest magnetic piece. Xiaojiu and Yu's hands almost hit each other in the box! Yu looked at the design drawing and took the initiative to say: "Xiaojiu, you are strong, you are responsible for covering the bottom rocket launch pad with square pieces; He is responsible for sorting the triangular parts according to color; Jia is good at eloquence, and is responsible for designing the space station control tower!"I'll install the radar!” Everyone immediately performed their duties, and no one competed. Forty minutes later, a huge, sparkling Mars space station, one meter high, rose from the ground! The four little heroes held hands and cheered around the space station: "We succeeded!" The power of cooperation is a hundred times more powerful than one person! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If everyone tries to grab the most magnetic tiles and build their own, will the space station ever be built? What are the advantages of teamwork?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Four boxes of building blocks need to be used together to build a large base. Everyone practiced assigning tasks based on the design drawings, one person taking the required parts, and not fighting over them!
🦁 Yu Yu, Chief Architect of the Space Station
🎬 Action:Arrange the square magnetic tiles on the base according to the design drawings, and clearly assign each person their assigned area.
"We take turns taking the magnetic pieces according to the design, I build the launch pad and the rocket wings, and everyone completes it together! ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu leads peers to cooperate through visual division of labor charts.
🐻 Jun Little Jun controlling the hand grabbing the parts
🎬 Action:Withdraw your hand from trying to hold all the magnetic pieces in your arms, take three red magnetic pieces, and concentrate on assembling the rocket booster.
"I just need the few pieces I need!" If one person builds a part of it, the total is the largest Mars base! ”
💡 Tips:Guided practice material sharing and self-restraint.
🐼 He Parts Supply Support Officer - He
🎬 Action:Arrange the scattered magnetic tiles according to color and actively deliver the appropriate parts to your teammates.
"Yu, do you need a yellow triangle?"I've found it for you. This is the strongest propeller!”
💡 Tips:Help He leverage the advantages of careful classification and supply support.
🦊 Jia Rocket Launch Commander-in-Chief - Jia
🎬 Action:Plant a golden national flag on top of the space station and lead all team members in a countdown and clapping to celebrate the completion.
"Take turns, don't fight, our Mars space station is super strong!" Everyone landed on Mars a great success! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the team to share and collaborate on the brilliant results.

💖 Praise generously and say thank you.
🏷️ Unit 5: Friendship, Cooperation and Sharing 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Praise the little sun

Giving Compliments and Saying Thank You

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the two-way skill of positive interpersonal feedback: specifically point out the strengths of your peers and praise them loudly; when praised, do not be shy or awkward, but stand up straight, smile and say "Thank you for your appreciation".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🔍 A colorful magnifying glass for praise in a gloomy little forest!

The little hedgehog Api wore a brand new sky blue hooded coat today, with a fire-breathing dinosaur printed on the chest. He looked very cool. But as soon as he entered the classroom, Jia shouted with sharp eyes: "Wow!" Api, your dinosaur jacket is so cool! The color is so beautiful! "After hearing this, Api's face turned red to the roots of his ears. He was so shy that he buried his whole face in the hood of his coat and huddled up, not daring to look at anyone. The owl smiled and handed Api a "praise magnifying glass" with gold rim: "Api, when others praise us, they give us a shining gem."We don’t have to hide, we just need to hold up our chests, look into each other’s eyes, smile and say “Thank you, I like this coat too”, that’s the perfect gift! Api pulled down his hood, looked at Jia and smiled and said, "Thank you Jia, my father gave this to me!"I also think your red bow today is so cute!”The two good friends held hands together, and the classroom was filled with sweet laughter!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone compliments your clothes or your handwriting, is it okay to hide and lower your head? How should you respond to compliments confidently?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A classmate compliments you on your new shoes or a beautiful drawing. Everyone practices standing tall, looking at the other person, smiling confidently, and saying thank you!
🦁 Yu Yu discovers the strengths of her peers
🎬 Action:Pick up the gold-rimmed magnifying glass, look at Jun with sincere eyes, and loudly say out Jun's best quality today.
"Xiaojiu, I saw you taking the initiative to help everyone get textbooks while queuing today. You are so enthusiastic and generous! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to practice specifically identifying the advantages of peer behavior and expressing it generously in spoken language.
🐻 Jun Little Jun overcame his shyness to say thank you
🎬 Action:Stand tall with a smile, turn around and give He a thumbs up, praising him in a loud voice.
"Thank you, Yu!"Haha, I also want to use a magnifying glass to praise He, the lines of the treasure map you drew are so beautiful!”
💡 Tips:Guidance in transforming shyness into generous and confident social acceptance.
🐼 He Warmth seeks out the kind-hearted He
🎬 Action:Hold the magnifying glass in both hands, smile at Jia, and gently express the thoughtful details you have observed.
"Jia smiles and says good morning to me every morning. Your smile is as warm as the sun! ”
💡 Tips:Help He delicately aware of the warm details in daily interpersonal interactions.
🦊 Jia Graceful and poised award presenter, Jia
🎬 Action:Take out the "Generous and Confident" medal and hang it around the student's neck, then lead the whole class in a high-five to encourage them.
"Don't bow your head, don't be coy, just say thank you generously!"The confident little hero shines the brightest!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the positive sense of self-worth that accepts praise.

🍡 Celebrating Winter Solstice with Tangyuan (Sweet Rice Balls) and Expressing Gratitude
🏷️ Unit 6: Winter Celebrations, Gratitude and Sharing 📌 Field:💡 Special topics

[Winter Solstice] Hot red and white glutinous rice balls: Eating glutinous rice balls means gratitude and filial piety to the elders

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the culture of the Winter Solstice Festival and safe eating etiquette: blow on the food to cool it down before eating to avoid scalding your mouth, chew slowly to avoid choking, and reflect on your growth to express gratitude to your elders for their years of care and hard work.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🍡 Sweet glutinous rice balls amidst the rising smoke of winter solstice!

December 21st is the "Winter Solstice" in the twenty-four solar terms. It is the day with the longest night and the coldest weather in the year. The electric pot in the special education classroom is cooking steaming brown sugar and red bean glutinous rice balls. Distribute bowls of round, pink and tender dumplings to the four little heroes. Jia took the spoon and almost swallowed the whole hot sesame rice dumpling in one bite! Yu quickly reminded: "Xiaojiu, be careful! The glutinous rice dumplings are very sticky, so you need to blow them with a spoon to cool them down before taking a small bite and chewing them slowly! ” He said softly: “Traditionally, eating glutinous rice balls during the Winter Solstice means that we have grown up one year safely! Tangyuan represents completion and gratitude. In the past year, who helped you wash clothes and cook hot meals every day? "He held the warm bowl with warm eyes: "I want to take this bowl of the most beautiful pink glutinous rice balls home to my grandma who takes me to school every day..."

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What safety precautions should we take when eating hot glutinous rice balls? Eating glutinous rice balls means we've grown a year older. Which elder in your family would you like to thank?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:On the Winter Solstice, we eat hot red and white glutinous rice balls. Everyone practices blowing on them to cool them down, chewing them slowly, and saying a warm thank you to the classmates and elders around them!
🦁 Yu Sharing Yu's first glutinous rice ball
🎬 Action:Carefully scoop up a pink sweet glutinous rice ball with a spoon and blow on it to cool it down, looking tenderly at the classmate next to you.
"Eating glutinous rice balls during the winter solstice makes me one year older!"I want to thank Jia for teaching me how to put together building blocks. I wish your winter is as sweet as glutinous rice balls! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to open her mouth and give positive verbal affirmation to peers in a festive atmosphere.
🐻 Jun Little Jun learns to chew slowly and carefully
🎬 Action:Get rid of the impatient habit of swallowing in one gulp. Slowly bite open the sesame glutinous rice ball and serve the best red bean soup to He.
"The glutinous rice balls are so hot, I want to cool them slowly!"He, this bowl is for you! Thank you for always helping me find pencils!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to practice patience in their diet and take the initiative to show consideration for their peers.
🐼 He He, remembering the kindness of his elders
🎬 Action:Hold the warm bowl of glutinous rice balls in both hands, close your eyes and smile, and feel the warmth spread from your stomach to your whole body.
"I want to take this bowl of the most beautiful pink glutinous rice balls home to my grandma. Thank you grandma for helping me cook hot rice every day!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He extend gratitude to family core caregivers.
🦊 Jia Winter Solstice Reunion Host - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold the large bowl with both hands and lead the whole class in a toast to celebrate the perfect Winter Solstice, filling the classroom with a sweet fragrance.
"The dumplings are round and the friendship is sweet!"After taking a bite of love in the winter solstice, our four little heroes of OO become more and more united!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jiashan to use festive imagery to build a sense of intimacy among peers.

🎄 Politely accepting gifts with good manners
🏷️ Unit 6: Winter Celebrations, Gratitude and Sharing 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Gentleman

[Christmas] Gift Exchange Battle: Draw a gift you don’t like and still be graceful

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the social etiquette of exchanging Christmas gifts in class: If the gift is not as expected, do not show displeasure or look upset on the spot; actively look for the good points of the gift; and sincerely thank the giver with a smile.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎁 A huge red gift box that didn't meet my expectations!

At the school-wide Christmas gift exchange party, Jun had been dreaming of winning the latest Pokémon trading cards or a Transformers toy car. When it was Jun's turn to draw, he excitedly drew number seven – a huge red gift box! The whole class craned their necks to look – but when they tore open the wrapping, inside was a thermos flask covered in pink strawberries and a pink towel! This gift was carefully chosen by a gentle girl in the class. Jun's face instantly fell, and he almost blurted out, "What rubbish! I'm not a girl!" The girl who gave the gift almost cried. Yu quietly tugged at Jun's sleeve and whispered, "Jun, look, this thermos keeps water super warm in winter, and the towel is so soft. It was a thoughtful gift from your classmate!" Jun took a deep breath, composed himself, and smiled generously at the girl, saying, "Thank you for preparing this gift for me!" "This is exactly the thermos I need in winter, I will take good care of it!" The little girl stopped crying and smiled, and the whole class burst into the loudest applause!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How upset would the giver be if they immediately rejected a gift? When exchanging gifts, is the most valuable thing the gift itself, or the sentiment behind it?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Christmas gift exchange. If you open a gift you didn't want, practice controlling your disappointment, finding the good points, and sincerely smiling and saying thank you!
🦁 Yu Yu sees the advantages of the gift
🎬 Action:Pat Jun on the shoulder, point to the thermos switch on the kettle, and smile as you explain the practical benefits of this gift.
"Look, Jia!"This insulated kettle holds hot water super warm in winter, and the strawberry pattern is so cute!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to practice "thinking from another perspective" and find out the positive value of unexpected things.
🐻 Jun Little Jun showing his magnanimous demeanor
🎬 Action:Relax your furrowed brows, take a deep breath, accept the pink gift with both hands, and smile and nod to the classmate who gave you the gift.
"Thank you for preparing this gift for me!" This is exactly the thermos I need in the winter and I will take good care of it! ”
💡 Tips:Leaders should refrain from using disgusting words when their expectations are disappointed, and show a mature gift-taking demeanor.
🐼 He Warm and comforting partner - He
🎬 Action:Step forward to offer affirmation, take out your own snacks and exchange them with everyone, and the atmosphere will immediately become joyful and harmonious.
"The way Jia smiled and said thank you was so gentlemanly! The best thing about exchanging gifts is the feeling of everyone coming together!”
💡 Tips:Help He support peers to show good manners and maintain interpersonal harmony.
🦊 Jia Chief Judge of Gentlemanly Conduct - Jia
🎬 Action:Loudly announce that Jun has won today's "Super Elegant Award", and lead the whole class to applaud Jun enthusiastically.
"No matter what you draw, always smile and say thank you!"Jia's performance today is more handsome than getting a thousand tops!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to immediately reinforce the high emotional intelligence performance of peers.

🎋 Hang your goals on the wishing tree
🏷️ Unit 6: Winter Celebrations, Gratitude and Sharing 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today's Badge: New Year's Hope Star

[New Year’s Day] Year-end time machine: Review this year’s biggest progress and set new goals

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Looking back on the past year's growth trajectory, affirm the difficulties you have overcome (not hitting people randomly, learning to raise your hand), and hang actionable social New Year goals on the wish tree.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎋 Golden wind chimes on the wishing tree and a miraculous countdown to the New Year!

In the last week of December, a huge "New Year's Wish Tree" was drawn on the blackboard of the special education classroom of OO Elementary School, and the branches were covered with red and gold ribbons and small wind chimes. Show on the screen a video of when school started in September - Yu at that time would roll on the ground when a building block fell over, Jia at that time would punch whenever someone touched him in line, He at that time did not dare to look at people, and Jia at that time would cry when he was nervous. The four little heroes looked at their past selves, laughing and being moved. Give each person a golden wooden prayer card: "Children, each of you has defeated the monster in your heart!"To welcome the new year, we will write a "new social superpower goal" on the wooden sign!” Yu wrote: “I hope that in the new year, I can make a good friend who often plays basketball together!” Jia wrote: “I hope that in the new year, when I am angry, I can count to ten before speaking!”When the golden wind chimes jingle in the breeze, everyone is full of strength to run towards the future!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Looking back at yourself in September and at yourself now, what's the thing you've improved the most? What new goals do you want to challenge yourself with in the new year?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:During the New Year's countdown and New Year's wish-making moment, the four partners reviewed the challenges they overcame this year and hung their new social wishes on the wishing tree!
🦁 Yu Looking back on Yu's growth and breakthroughs
🎬 Action:Stand tall and look at the screen. Compare yourself to how you used to yell and cover your head when you encountered noise in September. Smile and give yourself a thumbs up.
"In September, I was afraid of noise and would cover my ears and scream, but now I have learned to take deep breaths and hold earmuffs. I have overcome this big problem!"”
💡 Tips:Guide the growth of self-reflection and self-regulation and build deep psychological resilience.
🐻 Jun Little Jun makes a grand vow to make his own food.
🎬 Action:Recall how you used to kick a chair when you lost a game. Now, let your hands hang naturally and carefully write your wish on a wooden sign.
"I used to want to hit someone when I didn't get my way, but now I will make a fist and count to ten before stepping on the brakes. In the new year, I will be the guardian of peace!"”
💡 Tips:Guide people to see the huge leap in their emotional control and affirm the value of self-control.
🐼 He Little He with a wish for happiness hanging on it
🎬 Action:Stand on tiptoe and hang the wooden sign in the sunniest spot, put your hands together and smile as you express your New Year's wishes.
"In the new year, I hope that I will not be afraid every time I go on stage to speak, and that everyone will be happy together in the classroom every day!"”
💡 Tips:Help He closely integrate individual aspirations with collective happiness.
🦊 Jia Witness to New Year's Wishes - Jia
🎬 Action:Gently shake the golden wind chimes on the wishing tree, listen to the sound echoing in the classroom, and lead everyone to cheer for the future.
"The wind chimes are tinkling, and your wish will definitely come true!" Welcome a new year and let’s make great strides towards new goals together! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to deepen goal commitment and determination to act through a sense of ritual.

🔄 Flexible Mind Transfer Pass

When Plans Change: Using a Change Pass

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When faced with unexpected changes such as rainy days preventing physical education classes or temporary replacement of substitute teachers, learn to manage fixation anxiety and use the green "change pass" to smoothly accept new arrangements.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌧️ A sudden downpour caused by dark clouds! My most anticipated PE class is ruined!

The second period on Tuesday is the dodgeball PE class that the fourth grade children are most looking forward to all week! Yu had already changed into sports shorts and even put on his beloved non-slip gloves. Unexpectedly, a strong wind suddenly blew outside the window after class in the first period, thunder rumbled, and heavy rain suddenly turned the playground into a big pond! Physical education walked into the classroom and announced: "Dear students, it is raining heavily today, so the physical education class will be changed to self-study and calligraphy in the classroom.""This sentence exploded in Yu's head like a bomb! Yu held his head and shouted: "No!" The class description clearly states physical education! I don’t want to study by myself! I'm going to the playground! "Yu was so angry that he smashed his pencil case on the table. He came over and handed Yu a green "Change Pass": "Yu, the weather is like nature's magic. It's no one's fault that it rains."Let's take out the change pass and finish writing the new words. How about we play dodgeball with you?”Yu took three deep breaths and posted the pass on the class schedule. His violent mood slowly calmed down!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Heavy rain is a natural phenomenon that no one can control. If the class schedule suddenly changes, what can we do to calm our agitated minds?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The most anticipated PE class was canceled due to heavy rain and instead we studied in the classroom. Everyone practiced taking out their "change pass" to calm their anxiety about the disappointment!
🦁 Yu Yu took out the changed pass
🎬 Action:Originally very angry and wanting to grab your hair, look at the green elastic card on the table, take three deep breaths, and put the dodgeball glove back in the drawer.
"Although I am disappointed that I cannot go to the playground because of the rain, I use the change pass and can study happily in the classroom!”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu uses specific visual "change passes" to break the rigidity of the curriculum and soothe the anxiety of failed expectations.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, put away your irritable temper.
🎬 Action:Gently put down the pencil case that almost fell on the table, place both hands flat on the table, and then take a deep breath.
"Everyone is disappointed on a rainy day. It's useless to be angry. Let's finish writing the new words first and then play dodgeball next week!"”
💡 Tips:Guide people to see that the weather is force majeure, and replace the venting of throwing things with positive expectations.
🐼 He Indoor fun assistant · He
🎬 Action:Take out a box of class puzzle checkers and colored pencils from the locker and place them in the middle of the table to share.
"After self-study and writing new words, the four of us can play checkers together in the classroom. It's fun even on rainy days! ”
💡 Tips:Help He propose alternative activity plans to divert the class's low mood.
🦊 Jia Flexible and Adaptable Captain - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the Brain Elastic Gummy Badge and stick it on the "Today's Heroes of Response" board on the blackboard.
"The class schedule will change, but our good mood remains the same! Faced with the unexpected situation, everyone got through it smoothly!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the positive experiences of successful group response.

💪 I'm still learning the magic words.
🏷️ Unit 7: Flexibility, Resilience and Winter Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics

When Work Feels Hard: I Am Still Learning

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Develop a growth mindset: When you encounter a bottleneck in paper cutting, tying shoelaces, or writing math and want to shout "I can't," replace giving up and self-doubt with "I'm just still learning."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧩 The magical knot for tying shoelaces and the magic spell!

Today's self-care challenge in the special education classroom is "Learn to tie bows and shoelaces by yourself"! He, a fourth-grade student, held two red and blue shoelaces and awkwardly threaded them around with his fingers, but they either tied into a tight knot or fell apart as soon as he pulled them. After trying it five times, the shoelaces were scattered all over the floor like limp caterpillars. He's tears fell on his sneakers one by one, and he kicked them away in frustration: "I can't do it!" I'm a big fool! I could never learn to tie my shoes! ” Squatting down, holding He’s cold little hand: “He, it’s not that you can’t learn, you’re just “still learning”! You see, birds also learn to fly by waving their wings hundreds of times! Recite the incantation again: "I'm just still learning!" He sniffed, recited the magical incantation three times, took a deep breath and picked up the shoelaces again. This time, Yu was there to help hold the knot, and He slowly pulled it - a beautiful pink bow knot was solidly born!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you can't do something well or can't solve a problem, is saying "I'm stupid" helpful? Why does saying "I'm just still learning" have a magical effect on the brain?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When you fail repeatedly in tying shoelaces or cutting paper and feel like giving up and crying, practice saying the magic mantra "I'm just still learning" and try again!
🦁 Yu Yu encounters setbacks
🎬 Action:Put down the scissors, take a deep breath to relax your hand muscles, clench your fists, smile at yourself, and say the magic incantation.
"It doesn't matter if I can't cut well now, because I'm still learning!"Cut another one more slowly, I will definitely learn it!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu Nei to transform the magic word "I'm still learning" to block the learned helplessness.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who controls and gives up his impulses
🎬 Action:Gently place the part you are about to throw on the table, take a deep breath, and turn to learn from Yu.
"Yes!" I’m still learning too! You can't get things done if you're angry. Only by taking your time can you assemble the most beautiful airplane!”
💡 Tips:Guide to control destructive impulses brought about by frustration.
🐼 He Skilled Support Partner - He
🎬 Action:Gently press down on the corner of Yu's drawing paper with your left hand to help secure the paper and make it easier for Yu to cut.
"Yu, I will help you hold the paper. You can cut slowly according to the black dotted line. Take your time and don't rush!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He provide peer physical support.
🦊 Jia Witness to perseverance: Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up everyone's completed works, display them by the classroom window to let the wind blow, and applaud loudly.
"Look!"We succeeded! Persevere and never give up, the magic word "I'm still learning" will win the day!”
💡 Tips:Guide and praise the results of persistent efforts.

📝 Red pen corrections upgrade your brain
🏷️ Unit 7: Flexibility, Resilience and Winter Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Smart Upgrade Officer

[Final evaluation] Use the red pen to cross out as a brain upgrade, do not tear up the test paper

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When faced with red crosses and low scores on the final exam, get rid of the catastrophic mindset of "I'm a complete idiot" and build positive resilience by thinking "making mistakes is a reminder for my brain to upgrade."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
❌ Manjianghong's Math Quiz and Brain Upgrade 2.0!

Final exam week is here, and math test papers have been sent back. Yu took the test paper tremblingly, and saw a big number written with a bright red ball pen on the top of the paper - "58 points"! The entire exam paper is full of dazzling red Xs! Yu's head went "Boom!" ’ with a sound, tears instantly came to my eyes. I grabbed the two corners of the exam paper tightly with both hands and tried my best to tear the exam paper into pieces! He walked over quickly and gently held Yu's trembling hand: "Yu, stop!"Take three deep breaths! The cross with the red pen is not to scold you for being stupid, it is the "upgrade treasure map" hidden in the test paper! The crossed out places remind us where our brain needs to install new parts!"Yu slowly let go of the wrinkled test paper, and He took the initiative to hand over an eraser and dictionary. When Yu found out the errors in calculation, revised it with a blue pen and wrote the correct answer, and stamped a "Brain Upgrade 2.0" gold seal next to it, Yu burst into tears and laughed!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you tear up or hide the red crosses on your test paper, will your brain become smarter? Why is correcting mistakes considered more impressive than starting by getting them right?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When you receive a test paper full of red crosses and feel like crumpling it up and crying, practice smoothing out the test paper, taking out a red pen, looking up the answers in the dictionary, and correcting the questions!
🦁 Yu Yu who wrote the wrong answer on the exam paper
🎬 Action:Take three deep breaths, place the exam paper flat on the table, do not crumple the paper or cry, and take out a red pen and a dictionary.
"It doesn't matter if you make a mistake in the exam paper!"The cross with the red pen reminds me that my brain needs to be upgraded. I will look it up in the dictionary to correct it now!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to transform frustration into growth thinking, and revision is an opportunity for brain upgrade.
🐻 Jun Little Jun almost tore up the exam paper
🎬 Action:Seeing Yu diligently correcting his work, gently flatten the ball-shaped test paper and take out the eraser.
"Huh~ I almost want to tear up the paper in anger!"But the teacher said that mistakes are the best teachers. Let me write it again! ”
💡 Tips:Guide students to restrain impulsive destructive behaviors and learn to face setbacks.
🐼 He Corrections to the Mini Dictionary - He
🎬 Action:Actively turn to the page of the dictionary and point to the correct character to compare its radical with Yu's.
"Yu, look, the right side of this word is the power of strength. Let's write it together once and remember it forever!"”
💡 Tips:Guidance and provision of peer-specific academic scaffolding support.
🦊 Jia Brain Upgrade Witness - Jia
🎬 Action:Stamp a "Brain Upgrade 2.0" gold seal on Yu's corrected test paper.
"Finding errors yourself and correcting them is better than writing it right from the beginning!" All members’ brains have been upgraded successfully! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen self-affirmation and growth mindset.

🧧 Receiving red envelopes with both hands while saying auspicious words
🏷️ Unit 7: Flexibility, Resilience and Winter Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Lucky New Year Star

[Lunar New Year] The etiquette of celebrating the new year, saying auspicious words, and receiving red envelopes with both hands

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the traditional etiquette of New Year's greetings: Look elders in the eye and loudly say four auspicious words, accept red envelopes with both hands, do not open and count the money on the spot, and sincerely say thank you.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧧 The hundred-yuan bills in the red envelope and the embarrassment of opening the red envelope on the spot!

The Lunar New Year is here, and there are jubilant red Spring Festival couplets and the sound of firecrackers everywhere. On the first day of the Lunar New Year, relatives, uncles and aunts came to the house to pay New Year greetings. When Xiaojiu saw her uncle take out the red envelope, she was so excited that she grabbed it with one hand like a monkey, tore it open in front of all her relatives, took out the money inside and shouted, "It's only two hundred yuan!" So few!” The atmosphere at the scene was instantly as awkward as ice! My mother's face turned red, and my uncle also smiled bitterly. Returning to the Spring Festival simulation corner in the special education classroom, I took Xiaojiao to practice again: "Xiaojiao, the red envelope represents the blessings of blessings from our elders. It's not about comparing who has more money!"When receiving the red envelope, you should stand upright, look at the elders, hold it with both hands, and say loudly: "Thank you, uncle. I wish you a happy new year and good health!" And you must put it in your pocket and go home before opening it!” Xiaojiu nodded, bowed respectfully in front of his uncle again and said auspicious words. The uncle smiled from ear to ear and praised Xiaojiu as a good, sensible and polite boy!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you snatch a red envelope from an elder with one hand, open it immediately, and complain that the money is too little, how hurt will the elder be? What kind of kind words should you say when receiving a red envelope with both hands?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:During Chinese New Year, we visit relatives to offer New Year's greetings. Everyone practices standing at attention, receiving red envelopes with both hands, saying auspicious words, and putting them into their pockets!

💡 Tips:Guide people to restrain the urge to open red envelopes on the spot and implement the routine of receiving gifts with both hands.

🎬 Action:Holding a golden auspicious firecracker ornament, lead everyone in bowing to the teachers and students of the school to wish them a Happy New Year.
