📱 Your 3C Time Manager
🏷️ Unit 7: Flexibility, Resilience and Winter Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Little Master of Time

[Winter Vacation Life] Refuse 3C addiction: plan regular schedule and outdoor activities

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Develop self-management skills during winter break: Set a rule for using tablets and mobile phones with alarms every 30 minutes, turn them off immediately when they ring, and schedule outdoor activities and share household chores every day.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
👾 The tablet monster's eyes are bright red and have a blinding blue light!

During the first week of winter vacation, Yu was alone at home. Since he doesn't have to get up early to go to school, he can't stop playing shooting games on his tablet computer. He stares at the screen from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.! His eyes were sore and bloodshot, his neck was as stiff as a stone, and his temper became very irritable. He would yell at his mother when she asked him to eat! When Yu went to bed at night, his mind was filled with images of fighting and killing games, and he woke up crying from insomnia and nightmares. The next day, I called Yu online and helped him make a "Winter Vacation Magic Time Roulette": "Yu, the tablet is a tool, not its owner!"We have to make a "30-degree safety clock" agreement with the tablet - when the alarm clock rings for thirty minutes, we should immediately turn off the screen, go to the balcony to look at the green trees in the distance, do eye protection exercises, and go to the park to ride a bicycle in the afternoon!” Yu followed the instructions, and after a few days, his eyes no longer hurt, he felt refreshed, and his whole person became energetic!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What health warnings will your body and brain experience if you spend all day playing on your phone or watching TV without rest? How long should you look at a screen before giving your eyes a break?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill

🦁 Yu Yu keeps his promise to the alarm clock
🎬 Action:When the alarm rings, press the tablet's power button with your right hand without hesitation and put the tablet back on the bookshelf.
"Thirty minutes are up!"I need to protect my eyes, turn off my tablet, and go out to ride my bike!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use the visual/auditory alarm clock as the objective boundary to interrupt the use of 3C.
🐻 Jun Little Jun restrained himself from playing another game.
🎬 Action:Take a deep breath, put down the remote control you are holding, and loudly announce to your mother that it's time.
"Although I still want to play the next level, I promised to be self-disciplined!"Mom, I’m going to the living room to jump rope now!”
💡 Tips:Guide students to practice self-control in resisting the temptation of instant feedback from games.
🐼 He Eye Protection Demonstration by He
🎬 Action:Walk to the window, blink forcefully five times with both hands, gaze at the tallest tree in the distance, and relax your shoulders and neck.
"Look at the green trees in the distance, take a deep breath and turn your neck, your eyes will feel comfortable and your heart will relax!"”
💡 Tips:Help He master specific soothing movements to relax the body and mind.
🦊 Jia Winter Break Self-Discipline Inspector - Jia
🎬 Action:Stamp the sun in the "One Hour of Outdoor Exercise" column on the Winter Break Daily Life Checklist.
"Don't be a low-minded person, be a little master of time!"Live a regular life and be in good spirits, and your winter vacation life will be healthy!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the sense of accomplishment of independent life planning.

🏮 Guess the riddles while following the rules for answering quickly.
🏷️ Unit 7: Flexibility, Resilience and Winter Routines 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: The top prize in lantern riddles

[Lantern Festival] Lantern Riddle Guessing Carnival: Follow the rules and don’t be discouraged if you guess wrong

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the rules of group intellectual competitions: ring the bell/raise your hand only after hearing the question, do not peek at the answer, applaud enthusiastically when others answer correctly, and smile and say "try again next time" if you guess wrong.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🏮 Mysterious note under the red lantern and the battle to ring the bell!

On the Lantern Festival, the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, the ceiling of the special education classroom is covered with red paper lanterns, and an interesting lantern riddle hangs underneath each lantern. The big golden lantern puzzle in the middle is: "Hemp house, red tent, and a fat white man living inside." (Pick some food)” As soon as Xiaojiu saw that the question had not been finished, he rang the answering bell so hard that it almost broke and shouted: "It's glutinous rice balls!" Shaking his head, he said, "That's the wrong answer, and you have to wait until the gong rings to say please answer before you can ring the bell!" "Jia was so angry that he wanted to kick the table. Yu held his hand beside him and said, "Don't be angry, Jia. It doesn't matter if you guess wrong. You will know after you guess a few times!""He quietly raised his hand and said, "It's peanuts!”I am happy to sound the gong to announce the correct answer! Although Xiaojiu didn't guess correctly, he took his hand back and applauded He sincerely. Everyone ate the hot Yuanxiao together and was very happy!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When participating in a quiz game, why is it easy to answer incorrectly if you press the bell before the question is finished? How should you adjust your mood when you guess wrong?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill

🦁 Yu Yu listens quietly to the questions
🎬 Action:Place both hands on the table, listen attentively to the entire riddle, and only raise your hand to speak when you hear the gong.
"Wait until you finish reading the question before raising your hand!"I know the answer, it’s sweet peanuts!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to restrain the urge to rush quickly and listen to the complete voice instructions.
🐻 Jun Little Jun accepts the wrong guess
🎬 Action:Take a deep breath to calm down from pressing the wrong bell, place your hands flat on your knees, and applaud your peers who answered correctly.
"Oh, it doesn't matter if you guessed wrong!" He is so smart, congratulations to He for getting the lantern riddle gold coin! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance to practice mature sportsmanship when losing in competition.
🐼 He A gentle and thoughtful little girl
🎬 Action:Looking at the riddle card, point out the characteristics of the peanut shell and clearly explain the thought process to everyone.
"The hemp house is made of hard peanut shells, and the fat white man is made of peanut kernels. It's so fun for everyone to guess lantern riddles together!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He practice logical thinking and oral explanation skills.
🦊 Jia Lantern Riddle Master - Jia
🎬 Action:Ring the small golden gong, raise the red lantern, and lead the whole class in cheers to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
"Fair rules, good manners, warm applause!" OO Lantern Festival Lantern Riddle Carnival was a complete success! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to master the order management skills of group competitions.

[Relax at the beginning of school] Reboot and return to campus life and warm up in the morning light

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the psychological and physiological adjustment for returning to school after winter break: Adjust your bedtime three days in advance, check your stationery and winter break homework, and return to campus with a smile to warmly reunite with your peers.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎒 The alarm clock rings and it's time for the winter break monster's farewell ceremony!

On the eve of the end of winter vacation, fourth-grader Yu sighed as he looked at his schoolbag: "Ugh, school starts tomorrow, I still want to stay on vacation and sleep in..." He felt weak and listless. His mother gently came over, helped him open his pencil case, sharpened each pencil neatly, and packed his new textbooks into his schoolbag. The next morning at seven o'clock, as sunlight streamed into the room, Yu changed into his neat uniform and walked into OO Elementary School. At the school gate, he saw Jun, He, and Jia standing by the flowerbed, waving enthusiastically at him: "Good morning, Yu! Long time no see! We missed you so much!" Seeing his best friends' bright smiles, the lazy monster in Yu's heart vanished instantly! Yu ran forward and gave them a high-five: "Good morning everyone! We're going on adventures together again this new semester!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What should I do if I feel lazy and don't want to go to school after a long holiday? What joy will I find when I see my good friends at school?

Personal Space: Learning About Body Boundaries

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Establish the concept of physical interpersonal space: Everyone has an invisible "airbag" around them. When interacting with others, maintain an appropriate distance of one arm's length, and do not get too close or hug or pull others casually.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎈 An invisible safety airbag and an overly enthusiastic, close-fitting brown bear!

Yu likes Yu very much, but the way Yu expresses his love is often too much for people to tolerate - every time he speaks, he puts his face five centimeters in front of Yu's nose, and suddenly hugs Yu's neck tightly from behind! Yu is very sensitive to touch. Every time he is suddenly hugged, he will scream and jump with fright, and his heartbeat will race! Today, I took out four big hula hoops and asked each of the four little heroes to put them on their waists: "Children, there is an invisible "invisible airbag" around everyone! Just straighten your right arm and draw a circle with your fingertips. This is your "personal space." If others don't agree, we can't just get into each other's air bags, otherwise others will feel that they can't breathe and are very scared! ”It suddenly dawned on Jia! He stretched out his arm to measure, took a step back, stood at an arm's length and waved to Yu: "Yu, it's just right for us to stand here and talk!"” Yu breathed a sigh of relief and nodded happily!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When talking to someone, if you stand too close or even suddenly hug them, how will they feel? How is the safe distance of an arm's length measured?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When queuing or chatting, someone gets too close and makes you uncomfortable. Everyone practice extending one hand to show the distance of an arm's length and gently remind them!
🦁 Yu Yu, the guardian of airbags
🎬 Action:Extend your right arm forward and raise it horizontally, palm facing forward, to make a pause gesture, and look at the other person politely but firmly.
"Xiaojiu, please take a step back!"We stayed a safe arm's length apart so I felt comfortable!”
💡 Tips:Guidance Yu uses arm extension movements to clearly establish self-body boundaries.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who took a step back
🎬 Action:Upon seeing the pause gesture, immediately take a small step back with both feet, place your hands on your sides, and give an understanding smile.
"I'm sorry!"I just got too close! I step back so we both have comfortable airbags!”
💡 Tips:Guide and learn to recognize other people’s space rejection signals and retreat immediately.
🐼 He Distance Measurement Helper - He
🎬 Action:Make a hula hoop shape with your hands, stand beside two classmates, and make sure that you do not bump into each other.
"Everyone has an invisible large bag, one step away from each other, everyone can breathe smoothly and feel at ease!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He concretely strengthen the perception of interpersonal spatial boundaries.
🦊 Jia Boundary Safety Inspector - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold the airbag badge and check the social distancing during class interaction.
"Keep an arm's length distance, politeness and comfort come first!"We are all gentlemen who know how to respect boundaries!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the social virtue value of interpersonal distance.

✋ Firmly Reject Protective Shield
🏷️ Unit 8: Body Autonomy and Saying No 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today's Badge: Physical Defense Officer

A Firm No: My Body, My Choice

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Take control of your body: Understand that your body is your own treasure. When faced with unwanted physical contact or unreasonable requests, refuse with a firm look, extend your hand, and loudly say, "I don't like it, please stop!"

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦔 The little hedgehog's invincible shield and its first brave "No!"

In the forest classroom of OO Elementary School, the little hedgehog Bobo has a gentle and shy personality. Usually his classmates like to pinch his cheeks or suddenly hug him from behind. Although Bobo felt very uncomfortable, he always endured and did not dare to speak out because he was afraid that his classmates would be angry. Seeing Bobo's distress, he said to him gently: "Bobo, your body is your most precious treasure!"If you feel uncomfortable, you have the right to protect yourself!’ Teach him to hold up his chest, straighten his hands, palms forward, and say loudly and firmly: ‘Please stop! I don't like this!"At the end of class, a classmate wanted to reach out and pinch his face again. Bobo immediately stood at attention, stretched out his palm and yelled stop. The classmate was stunned for a moment, then apologized and backed away. Bobo discovered that only by being brave enough to say no can others truly respect him!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone does something uncomfortable to you, will remaining silent solve the problem? When you bravely say "no," what should your eyes and hand gestures be?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the hallway or playground, when classmates push you excessively, pinch your face, or force you to touch your belongings, practice "standing tall, reaching out your hand, making eye contact, and firmly refusing"!
🦁 Yu Yu firmly refused
🎬 Action:Stand firmly on your feet like a tree, extend your right hand with your five fingers facing forward, and look firmly at the other person's brow.
"Please stop!"I don't like being pinched, please step back and respect me!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome the ingratiation and shrinkage reactions, and clearly declare self-sovereignty with body boundaries.
🐻 Jun Little Jun Learns to Respect
🎬 Action:Immediately retract your outstretched hand behind your back, take a step back with both feet, and look serious and focused.
"I'm sorry Yu!"I just wanted to play with you. I didn’t know you didn’t like it. I won’t do it again!”
💡 Tips:Guide the practice of stopping immediately when receiving a clear rejection signal, and learn to empathize with boundaries.
🐼 He Guardian of Body Boundaries - He
🎬 Action:Stand beside your peers to offer support, clasp your hands together in front of your chest, and maintain a calm and composed expression.
"Everyone has their own body boundaries. If you say no, you can't. Everyone must protect each other's boundaries! ”
💡 Tips:Help He establish peer alliance to support awareness and affirm the correctness of refusal behavior.
🦊 Jia Body Autonomy Oath Officer - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the red defense shield symbol and lead all partners to loudly repeat the three-word mantra for protecting the body.
"Reject loudly, leave quickly, and ask an adult for help!" Bodily autonomy is ours! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to review and consolidate the anti-infringement standard protection process.

🌿 Guardian Star of Public Property Protection
🏷️ Unit 9: Shared Spaces and Community Manners 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Love Pet Green Man

[Arbor Day] Cherish public property and whisper in the library

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with Arbor Day in March, we should cultivate an awareness of cherishing life and campus property: protect flowers, plants and trees and do not climb or break them at will; walk softly when entering the library, turn pages gently, and return items to their original place after reading.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
📖 The banyan tree in the library and the crying fairy tale book!

March 12th is Arbor Day, and new saplings are planted on the campus. He passed by the flower garden after class and saw a lower-grade classmate trying to pull off a small branch. He walked up to Wenwen and said, "The sapling has just settled in the new soil. It will hurt. Can we water it gently?"” Walking into the school library, Xiaojiu saw a wonderful comic book and ran over excitedly, almost knocking down the bookshelf. Whisper in the ear: "Xiaojiu, the library is a forest of books. We have to walk gently like kittens."” Xiaojiu nodded, immediately stepped lightly, and turned the book as gently as a feather. After reading it, he carefully put it back on the green numbered bookshelf. The library praised Jia: "You are really the best little gentleman in the library!" ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:The flowers and plants on campus and the books in the library are public property for everyone. How should we treat them gently? Where should we put the books after we've finished reading them?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the library reading room and the campus plant area, four little heroes practiced "walking slowly like a cat, turning pages gently, putting public property back in its place, and protecting plants!"
🦁 Yu Yu turning the pages of a book softly
🎬 Action:Gently pinch the corner of the book page with your index fingers and thumbs, and slowly turn the page without making any clicking sound.
"As gentle as the breeze turning the leaves, I don't fold corners or draw lines, so that the next person can also see the beautiful book!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to cultivate a gentle and protective heart for books and public property in fine movements.
🐻 Jun Little Jun walks with a light, cat-like gait
🎬 Action:Walk quietly on your toes like a cat walking on clouds, holding three borrowed picture books steadily in your hands.
"Shh~ I put my steps so lightly!" Walk like a cat in the library and don’t disturb everyone’s reading! ”
💡 Tips:Help Jun to control large movement muscle groups and maintain posture in public quiet places.
🐼 He Campus Green Guardian - He
🎬 Action:Squat in front of the flowerpots on the classroom windowsill, gently spray the green leaves with a small spray bottle, and look warm in the eyes.
"Give the small trees more water to drink and don't pick flowers and leaves casually. Let's turn the OO campus into a beautiful forest! ”
💡 Tips:Help He extend gentle empathy traits to the natural environment and life care.
🦊 Jia Little Jia, the Inspector of Putting Things Back in Their Place
🎬 Action:Hold the green numbered tag card to help verify the book call number, and insert the picture book upright into the bookshelf.
"Books go home and things return to their original places!"It is everyone’s responsibility to care for public property. The little model of library reading passed the test!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the implementation of classification and public responsibility.

🚦 Instant brake-striking reflexes
🏷️ Unit 8: Body Autonomy and Saying No 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Empathy Brake Officer

Respecting No: Accepting Other People's Boundaries

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the two-way boundary of respecting others: When others say "no" or "please stop," be able to immediately stop what you are doing, not get angry, not ask questions or pester, and gracefully step back.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🏎️ A remote-controlled race car speeding along with a red light siren!

Jun brought a cool remote-controlled race car to school today. He enthusiastically wanted to grab He's hand and touch the tires together. Startled by the sudden touch, He pulled his hand back to his chest, shook his head, and whispered, "Jun, no, I want to draw first." Jun frowned, about to shout, "That's fun! It won't hurt if you touch it!" Then, he saw the "Empathy Traffic Light" sign on the blackboard. He took a deep breath and mentally applied the red brake: "When someone says no, it's like the red light is on!" Jun put away the remote control, smiled, and said, "Okay! You draw first, and come find me when you want to play!" Seeing that Jun wasn't angry, He breathed a sigh of relief, looked up at Jun, and smiled sweetly: "Thank you for respecting me, Jun!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone tells us "no," why can't we force them or keep pushing? What good quality does immediately stopping and saying "okay" represent?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When the other person refuses to share a toy or hold hands, the four little heroes practice "immediately withdrawing their hands, taking a deep breath, smiling and saying yes, and taking a step back!"
🦁 Yu Yu's calm and composed expression
🎬 Action:Look into the other person's eyes, shake your head in a calm but firm tone, and keep your hands on the table without touching it.
"I need to rest quietly now, please don't push my chair, thank you for your understanding!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to express needs in clear and calm spoken language without causing confrontation.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who slammed on the brakes in a second
🎬 Action:Upon hearing a peer's rejection, immediately raise both hands in a surrender gesture, take a step back, and reveal a big smile.
"When the red light signal is received, brake to the fullest!"No problem, you rest first, I won’t disturb you anymore!”
💡 Tips:Guidance to suppress frustration at the moment of rejection and establish a second-stop braking reflex.
🐼 He Little He with a peaceful smile
🎬 Action:Feeling respected by your peers, relax your tense shoulders and gently nod to thank them.
"Jia, you are so considerate!"Stop immediately when you hear me say no, I feel so safe being my friend!”
💡 Tips:Help He give positive feedback to positively reinforce the polite behavior of peers.
🦊 Jia Similarly, traffic light referee Jia
🎬 Action:Flip the red and green indicator signs to show the perfect green light and applaud the mature interaction between the two parties.
"Stop if you say no, respect each other!" Everyone in the OO special education class is the most personable and good interpersonal partner! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia summarizes the core meaning of braking in the same way.

🎖️ Today’s Badge: Little Detective of the Truth

Safe and Unsafe Secrets: Speaking Up and Getting Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Develop children's self-protection awareness: distinguish between "good secrets" (surprises that make people happy and look forward to, with time limits) and "bad secrets" (secrets that make people afraid, require them to hide, involve physical privacy, and should never be kept secret), and bravely seek help from trusted teachers and elders.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎁 Birthday gift hidden in a box vs. a heartbreaking secret!

Today I took out two magic boxes. The first one is a gift box tied with a pink ribbon: "Next week is He's birthday. We secretly draw cards for him without telling him first. This is called a "good secret" and makes people feel warm and happy!" ” Then he took out a black box and said: "But if someone touches your private parts, or asks you to do dangerous things, and threatens you by saying, "This is a secret between us, if you dare to tell it, I will beat you."This is a "bad secret"! Bad secrets can give you stomachaches, nightmares, and fear! Yu raised his hand and asked, "What should I do if I encounter a bad secret?" "Said firmly: "Bad secrets must not be hidden in the belly! Tell your parents immediately or we will protect everyone!” The four children answered loudly: “We understand!”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What is a good secret? What is a bad secret? If someone threatens you not to tell bad things, should you listen to him or come to him quickly?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Faced with potential threats, dangers, or secrets, everyone practiced boldly breaking the silence and clearly informing a trusted teacher for help!
🦁 Yu Yu's keen observation
🎬 Action:Point to the scenario picture cards on the blackboard and clearly point out that the scenario that makes people feel scared and anxious is a bad secret.
"Anything that makes my heart beat faster and makes me feel scared and uncomfortable is a bad secret and I must not hide it!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a connection between emotional and physiological feelings (stomach pain, rapid heartbeat) and dangerous situations.
🐻 Jun Little Jun breaks the silence
🎬 Action:Clench your fists to encourage yourself, walk quickly to the teacher, and ask for help loudly with a determined look in your eyes.
"Teacher!"Some people threaten me not to tell others, but I know it is a bad secret and I must tell you!”
💡 Tips:Guidance to eliminate threats and fears, and master the skills to quickly seek help from adults.
🐼 He Gentle guardian He
🎬 Action:Stand next to the person seeking help, take their hand, and offer them courage and companionship.
"It's safe to say it!" Teachers and parents will protect us like big umbrellas! ”
💡 Tips:Help He play the role of peer help support to reduce fear of reporting.
🦊 Jia Chief of Security and Defense, Jia
🎬 Action:Show your "Help Green Channel" number (110, 113) and summarize the key points of protection.
"Zero tolerance for bad secrets, speak out bravely and don't be afraid of the dark!"Trust that adults are by your side, and the campus is 100% safe!”
💡 Tips:Guidance to memorize key help channels and core protection principles.

🎫 Little expert in public etiquette
🏷️ Unit 9: Shared Spaces and Community Manners 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Polite Gentleman

[Children's Day and Qingming Festival] Little Gentlemen in Public Places: Riding and Queuing Order

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with the Children's Day and Qingming Festival holidays in April, pay attention to public transportation and public place order: queue in order when taking the bus, let passengers off first and then board, hold the handrails tightly and do not run inside the carriage, keep your voice down, and give up priority seats.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚌 A big yellow bus and a wobbly little penguin!

During the Children's Day long weekend in April, four little heroes from OO Elementary School took a yellow bus to the Municipal Zoo. At the bus stop, Jun excitedly tried to rush onto the bus as soon as he saw it arrive! Yu tugged at Jun's sleeve: "Jun, look, there are yellow queuing lines on the ground. We have to wait for people to get off before we can swipe our cards and board!" Once on the bus, it swayed a bit. After He sat down, he saw an elderly woman with a cane board. He immediately stood up, holding onto the handrail: "Grandma, here's your seat!" The elderly woman smiled and patted He's head, saying thank you. Jia quietly discussed the penguin exhibit on the bus, making the entire journey quiet and smooth. The driver gave them a thumbs-up and praised, "You are the most polite little gentlemen in all of Yunlin!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When taking the bus, is it okay to rush forward as soon as the door opens? What should we do if we see someone with mobility issues on the bus?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a simulated bus and subway station setting, the four little heroes practiced "queueing, letting passengers off before boarding, holding onto handrails, and offering their seats to others"!
🦁 Yu Yu, who follows the rules of queuing
🎬 Action:Stand behind the yellow waiting line at the bus stop, hold your EasyCard with both hands, and wait patiently for all passengers to get off before stepping onto the bus.
"Get off first, then get on, don't push, swipe your card one step at a time to get on the bus, and obey the traffic order is the safest!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to strictly observe the physical boundaries of queuing in stimulating traffic situations.
🐻 Jun The little guy gripping the handle tightly
🎬 Action:Step into the carriage with your feet slightly apart and stand firmly. Hold the yellow handrail firmly with your right hand. Do not jump or run.
"Driving on the bus is like surfing. I have to hold on to the handrails to stand firm. I can't run in the car!"”
💡 Tips:Help Jun to control body shaking impulses and implement the driving safety instinct.
🐼 He He offered his seat
🎬 Action:When you see an elder approaching, immediately stand up and stand aside, pointing your right palm upwards at an empty seat.
"Hello grandma! This fraternity seat is for you to sit on, please be careful and sit down slowly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He transform observation into substantive helpful and courteous actions.
🦊 Jia Jia, the train carriage etiquette announcer
🎬 Action:Gently place your index finger to your lips to make a quiet gesture, reminding everyone to speak in a whisper.
"The carriage is quiet and not noisy, and the politeness on the bus ranks first!"We are OO's best public citizens!”
💡 Tips:Guide to maintaining low-volume environmental monitoring in public situations.

🥢 Little Food God Who Finishes Every Dish!
🏷️ Unit 10: Self-Care and Healthy Habits 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Dinner Table Connoisseur

Lunch Manners: Chewing Quietly and Reducing Food Waste

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the etiquette and rules of group dining: sit upright, keep your mouth closed while eating and do not make chewing noises, do not spit or talk while eating, cherish food and do not be picky about food, and keep tableware neatly sorted and recycled.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🥣 A mouthful of rice grains spouting nonsense versus a spotless plate!

During the nutritious lunch time, the kitchen aunt cooked fragrant corn soup and fried pork chops. Jia's stomach growled with hunger, and he stuffed his mouth with a big mouthful of white rice. Before he could finish chewing, he hurriedly shouted: "Yu, look!"This piece of meat is so big...Pfft!"The white rice grains sprayed all over the table like snow, and Yu quickly wiped it with toilet paper. He came over and showed Jia a "dinner table gentleman card": "First, don't speak when there is food in your mouth; second, close your lips and chew carefully;third, the bottom of the bowl will sparkle after eating!" ” Xiaojiu wiped his mouth sheepishly, imitated He and sat upright, chewed every mouthful of rice carefully and swallowed it before speaking. At the end of the meal, all four people's plates were clean, and the kitchen aunt was so happy!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What terrible things happen when you speak with your mouth full of food? What should you do first when you want to speak?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:At the lunch table, everyone practiced chewing with their lips tightly closed and without making a sound, speaking only after swallowing, and cleaning up their plates neatly after the meal!
🦁 Yu Yu chewing with his mouth closed
🎬 Action:After putting the food in your mouth, close your lips tightly, chew your jaw rhythmically twenty times, and swallow quietly.
"Cut your lips tightly and chew slowly without making any sound or dropping rice grains. Your stomach will be comfortable and healthy!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to improve table etiquette through oral control through closed lips and chewing.
🐻 Jun Little Jun only spoke after swallowing the
🎬 Action:Gently pat your chest with your right hand to confirm that you have swallowed all the soup in your mouth. Then gently press the corners of your mouth with a tissue before turning your head to speak.
"Phew~ I swallowed all the food!"Now I can share with you that today’s corn chowder is delicious!”
💡 Tips:Guide the patient to establish an impulse suppression chain of "swallowing → wiping mouth → speaking".
🐼 He Cherishing food, He
🎬 Action:Use a spoon to scrape the last grain of rice off the bottom of the bowl and eat it, leaving the plate shiny like a mirror.
"Uncle farmer, farming is very hard. I ate all the vegetables and white rice. It's full of nutrition!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He develop a healthy attitude of being grateful for food and not picky about food.
🦊 Jia Post-meal cleanup officer - Jia
🎬 Action:Put the spoon and chopsticks into the designated recycling bin, stack the lunch boxes neatly in order, and wipe the table clean with a cloth.
"The tableware is back in place and the tabletop is smooth!" All members of the OO Lunch CD Operation have cleared the level and achieved healthy growth and reached the first place! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to implement the ability to take care of the environment and tidy up after meals.

🏷️ Unit 9: Shared Spaces and Community Manners 📌 Field:💡 Special topics

[World Earth Day] Turn off lights and recycle resources: Guardian of green life

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with World Earth Day, establish concrete behaviors to protect resources: turn off lights and fans when leaving the classroom, stop running water from the tap when washing hands, and implement waste sorting for paper, plastic, and metal/aluminum containers.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💡 A crying light bulb and a magical blue-green recycling bin!

On April 22nd, World Earth Day, I will take everyone to visit the campus. Everyone found that in many empty classrooms the lights were on, the fans were blowing, and the faucets in the corridors were still leaking. Said: "If Mother Earth has a fever, the polar bears will have no ice to live in!" We want to be the little green bodyguards of the earth!"Yu volunteered to be the "lights-off captain" and pressed the switch to turn off the power when leaving the classroom after class; Xiaojiu saw water dripping from the faucet and stepped forward to tighten the valve in three steps; He and Jia guided everyone in the corridor to clean and flatten the finished milk cartons and put them into the paper recycling bin. The principal came over and saw the four little guards awarding the special education class the "School Energy Saving and Carbon Reduction Championship Flag" at the flag-raising ceremony!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What resources are wasted if the lights aren't turned off when leaving an empty classroom? What should you do before putting an empty milk carton into the recycling bin?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the classroom before school ends and in the recycling yard, the four little heroes practiced "inspecting water and electricity switches, turning off the power, and rinsing and flattening recyclables"!
🦁 Yu Lights-out Patrolman - Yu
🎬 Action:Walk to the door and check the light and fan switches one by one, then turn off the power with a click.
"When people leave, the lights go out and the power is turned off!"OO classrooms do not waste electricity and save precious energy for the earth!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish the responsibility habit of checking environmental facilities when changing activities.
🐻 Jun Water-saving champion, Jun
🎬 Action:Walk quickly to the sink, extend your right hand and tighten the dripping metal faucet completely until it stops leaking.
"The faucet is locked tightly!" Every drop of water is the tears of Mother Earth, and not a drop can be shed in vain! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the application of agility skills in practical actions to protect public facilities.
🐼 He Meticulous Sorter - He
🎬 Action:Rinse the empty milk carton with a small amount of water, flatten it with both hands, and put it into the blue cardboard box.
"Push, press!" By sorting the garbage and placing it at the right place, the waste paper can be transformed into recycled new paper! ”
💡 Tips:Help He implement the precise and detailed process of resource recovery.
🦊 Jia Green Earth Ambassador - Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the green Earth logo and lead all partners in reciting the OO Love the Earth Pledge.
"Use less plastic and cherish water and electricity!" With a little effort to protect the environment, we are the best little guardians of the earth! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to build a collective consensus among the team on environmental citizenship responsibilities.

🎯 I communicate with magic arrows
🏷️ Unit 11: Expressing Feelings with I-Messages 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: I’m the Message Master

I-Messages: Sharing Feelings Without Blaming

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master advanced communication skills: Overcome the tendency to use "you messages" to blame others when angry ("It's all your fault! You're so annoying!"), and learn to use the three-part "I message" to clearly express your feelings, reasons, and specific expectations.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💥 The fire-breathing Tyrannosaurus Rex's "You" bomb vs. the gentle and magical "I Message"!

In the art class, when Xiaojiu turned around with the scissors, he accidentally knocked over the paper castle that Yu had put together with his elbow. Yu's face turned red, he clenched his hands into fists, and almost shouted: "You suck!" Are you blind? It's all your fault!” At this time, Yu remembered the "My Message Magic Card" that he taught. He took a deep breath for three seconds, suppressed the Tyrannosaurus in his heart, looked at Jia and said: "Xiaojiu, [I feel] very sad, [because] it took me half an hour to build this castle. [I hope] you can look at the road when you walk, and help me pick up the blocks together!""Xiaojiu originally thought that Yu was going to hit him, but he didn't expect Yu to be so reasonable. Xiaojiu lowered his head in shame: "I'm sorry, Yu! I didn't mean it, I'll help you fight it back right now! ”A possible physical conflict was gently resolved by the magical message from me!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone breaks your things, will telling them "You're so mean" make things better? What are the three magic phrases for "I Message"?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a conflict situation where toys are messed up or people are bumping into each other while queuing, the four little heroes practice using the "I Message Trilogy" to resolve misunderstandings!
🦁 Yu Yu, who conveyed my message
🎬 Action:Place both hands flat on your chest, look directly into the other person's eyes, speak clearly and steadily, and use the three-part sentence structure.
"Xiaojiu, I feel very anxious because this picture is about to be handed in. I hope you don't shake the table!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use sentence structure to calmly express his feelings in the moment of frustration and excitement.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, completely convinced
🎬 Action:When you hear that your peers are not verbally abusing you, hold onto the corners of the table with both hands, nod sincerely to express your apology, and take remedial action.
"Yu, I'm sorry, I understand how you feel!" I promise not to shake the table again, and I'll hold the paper down for you! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the child to actively generate a sense of responsibility and willingness to compensate under non-aggressive criticism.
🐼 He A gentle and harmonious little peace
🎬 Action:Hand each person a new box of colored pencils, stand smiling beside them, and create a peaceful atmosphere.
"Speaking well is powerful!" Use "I think" instead of quarreling, and we can paint happily together again! ”
💡 Tips:Help He affirm the effectiveness of positive communication to resolve residual tension.
🦊 Jia Communication Sentence Pattern Checker - Jia
🎬 Action:Check the three green checkmarks "Feeling, Reason, Hope" on the blackboard to praise both parties' performance.
"My message trilogy is a perfect hit!" Don’t curse, explain clearly, and the conflict is resolved successfully! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to master the structured standards of interpersonal communication and provide reinforcement.

🩹 Clearly identifying young patients seeking medical help
🏷️ Unit 10: Self-Care and Healthy Habits 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Health Help Star

Asking the School Nurse for Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Mastering the accurate verbal expression of physical symptoms: When injured or in pain, one should not cry or vent, but be able to walk into a health center, knock on the door and greet people, and point to specific areas to describe the pain, the time, and the cause.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🩹 A miraculous ointment from the health center for a scraped and bleeding knee!

While running in physical education class, Xiaojiu fell down on the PU track in order to chase a basketball that was about to go out of bounds. A large piece of skin was scratched on his right knee and blood seeped out. Xiaojiao screamed in pain, tears welling up in his eyes. Yu and He quickly helped Jia towards the health center. Xiaojiu originally wanted to sit on the ground and cry, but she followed him and encouraged him: "Xiaojiu is very brave. Let's wipe away our tears and go in and tell the nurse aunt clearly where he was injured!""Going to the door, Jia knocked on the door twice: "Hello, aunt!"The nurse aunt asked kindly: "What's wrong with the child?"Xiaojiu pointed to her right knee: "Auntie, I just fell down while running in gym class, and my right knee was broken and bleeding. It hurts!”The nurse aunt praised Jia for explaining it clearly, and immediately helped him disinfect and apply saline solution and put on a large gauze. Xiaojiu wiped away her tears and said loudly, thank you, aunt!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you go to the health center to see a doctor or nurse, if you just cry and don't say anything, can the nurse immediately tell where it hurts? What three things should you clearly state when reporting symptoms?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a health center visit scenario, everyone practiced "knocking on the door to greet, pointing to the area, stating the reason and feeling, and sincerely thanking"!
🦁 Yu Jun expresses himself clearly
🎬 Action:Sit on the examination chair, point to the wound on your right knee with your finger, and calmly and clearly report the pain and its course.
"Hello, nurse aunt!"I just fell down while running and my right knee was broken and very painful. Please help me apply medicine!”
💡 Tips:Guidance is provided to suppress cathartic crying when the body is in pain and to accurately describe the injury in spoken language.
🐻 Jun Little Yu, a caring companion
🎬 Action:Stand next to the examination chair, hold Jun's water bottle and coat with both hands, and look at your colleague with concern.
"Don't be afraid, Jia. Apply the medicine to cool it down and the pain will stop immediately. I'm here to accompany you!"”
💡 Tips:Guidance Yu demonstrates companionship and peer support for injured partners.
🐼 He Little He handing over toilet paper
🎬 Action:Take out a clean tissue and gently wipe away the tears on your companion's cheeks, offering gentle comfort.
"Jia was so brave when applying medicine and didn't cry!" Wait for the medicine to be applied and we will slowly walk back to the classroom! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance and provision of immediate emotional comfort and physical care.
🦊 Jia Health Guardian Ambassador - Jia
🎬 Action:Organize the patient etiquette card and emphasize the importance of saying thank you to medical staff.
"Clearly tell where it hurts, thank the nurse for her hard work!" OO little hero ranks first in health and self-protection!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the etiquette of asking for help and gratitude to medical staff.

💖 Loving Household Chores Taker
🏷️ Unit 2: Spring Celebrations and Gratitude 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: A filial and warm man

[Mother's Day] Hand-painted gratitude cards and doing a housework: using actions to show consideration to caregivers

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with Mother's Day in May, appreciate the hard work of family caregivers (mothers, grandparents, etc.): express your gratitude by hand-drawing carnation cards and fulfill your promise to complete a household chore (sweeping, washing dishes, or giving a back massage) on the weekend.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
Carnation: A carnation I folded myself and a bowl of rice that I washed until it was sparkling clean!

The second Sunday in May is Mother's Day. He looked at family photos in class and remembered that his mother would get up at five o'clock every morning to cook breakfast, ride a motorcycle to take him to school, and wash clothes and dishes until very late at night. His hands were rough. In the special education classroom, red colored paper and golden crayons were handed out: "We can't just say that we love mom, we want to give mom two of the most heart-warming gifts: the first is a sincere thank you card, and the second is to share a housework for mom!""Yu folded a three-dimensional carnation with red paper; Xiaojiu promised to clean the living room floor at the weekend; He wrote "Mom, I will help you beat your back for twenty minutes"; Jia drew a family portrait. When he got home, He handed the card to his mother with both hands, and walked into the kitchen to wash the dishes after dinner. His mother hugged He and was so moved that she cried!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What hard things do our mothers or elders do for us at home? Besides sending cards, what actions can we take to help ease their burden on Mother's Day?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a Mother's Day appreciation event and family setting, four little heroes practice giving cards to their caregivers and expressing their love through specific household chores!
🦁 Yu Yu presents the card with both hands
🎬 Action:Hold the red carnation card respectfully with both hands, bow slightly, and look sincerely at your mother.
"Thank you for your hard work, Mom!"This is a carnation made by me. I wish you a happy Mother's Day and I will love you forever!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to express introverted emotions generously through ritualized body movements.
🐻 Jun Little Jun promised to do housework
🎬 Action:Roll up your sleeves and mimic wiping the table and washing dishes, loudly announcing your commitment to household chores.
"Mom, sit down and rest today!"Leave all the dishes, chopsticks, and living room flooring for today’s dinner to me!”
💡 Tips:Guide the parents to turn their abundant energy into practical housework actions that are considerate of their elders.
🐼 He Gentle back massage from He
🎬 Action:Make small, hollow fists with both hands and gently massage the shoulders and neck of your peers in a rhythmic and warm manner.
"Tap gently and rub slowly to eliminate mom's fatigue all day long! Mom, take a sip of warm tea and rest slowly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He implement meticulous and considerate physical and mental soothing care actions.
🦊 Jia Exemplary Filial Piety Elder - Jia
🎬 Action:Cover the class's filial piety tree with everyone's family affairs check-in cards, and lead all the classmates to cheer together.
"Say gratitude and do housework! Protect our family members who love us the most with all our heart, OO special education on filial piety is perfect! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to strengthen the practical sense of achievement of family gratitude value.

🚸 Turn corners, stop, look, and listen like a radar
🏷️ Unit 4: Classroom Routines and Learning Together 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Safety Navigator

School Safety: Walking in Hallways and on Stairs

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the physical safety of walking on campus: slow down in the corridors to avoid collisions, hold the handrail and walk on the right when going up and down stairs, and follow the "stop, look and listen" collision avoidance guidelines when passing through blind spots and corners.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌪️ A small whirlwind in the hallway collides with a huge collision at the corner of the stairs!

The bell just rang for the end of get out of class. In order to go to the playground to play on the swings, Jia ran like a bullet out of the barrel in the corridor! Just as they were about to turn the corner of the stairs, the little girl in first grade came out with a kettle, and the two of them said, "Bang!" ”A hard collision! The kettle broke, and the little sister sat on the ground crying in pain, and Xiaojiu also had a big bump on his forehead. He walked over seriously: "Jia, the corridor is not a runway!" The corner is a blind spot that cannot be seen. If everyone runs in the corridor, someone will be seriously injured every day! Lead the whole class to practice "Three Corridor Safety Rules": walk slowly one step at a time, keep to the right when walking up the stairs, and stop for two seconds when passing a corner to look left and right. Jia apologized to his little sister and learned his lesson. From now on, there will no longer be dangerous little whirlwinds in the corridor, only gentlemen who walk steadily!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Why is running in the hallway and on the stairs so dangerous? When you pass a corner where you can't see the other side, what three things should you do?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the corridor, corner and staircase traffic scenarios, the four little heroes demonstrated "walk slowly to the right, stop for two seconds at the corner, and proceed only after confirming it is safe!"
🦁 Yu Slow Walking Demonstrator - Yu
🎬 Action:Let your arms hang naturally at your sides and walk steadily to the right of the white safety line, keeping your eyes on the road ahead.
"Walking slowly in the corridor, I feel at ease every step of the way!" No pushing, no running, campus safety is our concern! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to maintain a steady and slow body rhythm in the exciting atmosphere after class.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who stops to look and listen at the corner
🎬 Action:Stop immediately in front of the corner pillar, turn your body slightly to the side, look to the left and then to the right, and only walk across after confirming that no one is there.
"Stop when you turn the corner, look left and right to see if no one is coming!" Fortunately, I stepped on the brake and I won't hit my classmates again! ”
💡 Tips:The guidance system changes the sprint reflex into a restricted response such as corner stopping.
🐼 He The little one on the right
🎬 Action:Lightly hold the metal handrail of the stairs with your right hand, and step up and down the stairs one step at a time, keeping to the right, without stepping into empty spaces.
"Hold your hands when going up and down the stairs, and keep to the right step by step. If you are in danger of falling, stay away from me!"”
💡 Tips:Help He strengthen the sense of spatial orientation and safe holding habits of stairs.
🦊 Jia Safety Inspector Captain · Jia
🎬 Action:Holding yellow safety command flags, guide the flow of students and staff after class to maintain order.
"Walking slowly in the corridor, stopping around the corner to watch and listen!" OO Elementary School is safe and has no blind spots. Go to school safely and go home happily! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to serve as an important role in safety inspection and deepen the awareness of campus safety responsibility.

🙇 The Four-Step Method for Sincere Apology
🏷️ Unit 12: Apologies, Forgiveness and Repairing Relationships 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Sincere Apology Officer

A Sincere Apology: Four Steps to Make Things Right

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Mastering core relationship repair skills: Overcoming defensiveness when making mistakes (making excuses like "I didn't do it on purpose!"), and learning the four steps to a sincere apology: I'm looking at you + I'm sorry + It's my fault + I'll do it next time...

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎨 Red ink spilled on white sneakers and a heartfelt apology!

When washing watercolor brushes in art class, Jia took a bowl and swung the water, and all the red water drops accidentally fell on Yu's new white sneakers! The snow-white shoe upper was immediately stained with a large mottled red stain. Yu's eyes were red and he was so angry that he gritted his teeth. Jia's first reaction was to blurt out: "You came too close on your own, I didn't mean it!""But seeing Yu's sad tears, Xiaojiu remembered the "Four Steps of Apology". Xiaojiu took a deep breath, walked up to Yu, and looked at Yu sincerely: "First, I'm looking at you;secondly, Yu, I'm sorry; thirdly, it's my fault that I shook the water bowl and soiled your new sneakers;fourthly, I'll help you get a wet paper towel to clean it immediately. Next time you wash your pen, you must look next to you first!" "When Yu heard that Jia was so sincere, the anger in his heart slowly died down: "Okay, let's wipe it clean together! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you make an excuse like "I didn't do it on purpose" when you do something wrong, will the other person feel comfortable? What are the four steps to sincerely apologizing?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a sudden conflict where a classmate's belongings are accidentally damaged or soiled, the four little heroes practice the standard "four-step sincere apology + concrete repair actions"!
🦁 Yu Little Jun demonstrates the four steps to apologizing.
🎬 Action:Look into the eyes of the victim, place your hands folded in front of your abdomen, bow slightly, and speak sincerely without excuses.
"Yu, I'm sorry!" It was my carelessness to knock over your watercolor. I will definitely slow down next time, please forgive me! ”
💡 Tips:Help Jun accept responsibility and experience the strength of a sincere apology.
🐻 Jun Yu, having calmed down and accepted the situation.
🎬 Action:Take three deep breaths to expel the pent-up air from your chest, look into the other person's eyes, and relax your shoulders.
"Although I was very heartbroken just now, seeing you apologize so sincerely, I know you didn't mean it, and I forgive you!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to let go of her emotions in a timely manner and release forgiveness and kindness after receiving a complete apology.
🐼 He Small items assisting with cleaning and repair
🎬 Action:Get wet wipes and a dry cloth, squat down next to the two people and help absorb the stains on the shoes.
"Let's wipe it with a wet paper towel together. The red ink is not dry yet. After wiping it, it turns into a handsome white shoe! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance and investment in collaborative support for substantial relationship repair.
🦊 Jia Relationship Repair Mediator - Jia
🎬 Action:Raise the handshake and reconciliation card to announce that the two partners have successfully resolved their conflict and reconciled.
"A true gentleman has the courage to admit his mistakes and apologize to restore the connection between hearts!"The Four Steps of Sincerity to Resolve Thousand Waves of Waves!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the key value of interpersonal repair in peer interactions.

🗝️ Forgiveness and a magnanimous heart
🏷️ Unit 12: Apologies, Forgiveness and Repairing Relationships 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Tolerance Decoder

Accepting an Apology and Rebuilding Friendship

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the ability to accept apologies and let go: When the other party sincerely apologizes, be able to restrain the vengeful mentality of "holding a grudge, being relentless, and speaking ill of others," and say "It's okay, I forgive you," and agree together on how to do better next time.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💔 A torn dinosaur sticker and two little hands clasped together!

When borrowing stickers after class, Xiaojiu accidentally tore Yu’s favorite Brontosaurus sticker in half. Xiaojiu immediately apologized nervously: "Yu, I'm sorry!" I really didn’t mean it, I’ll give you a new one! ” Yu was so angry at first. He turned around and ignored Jia, thinking to himself: "I don't want to be good friends with Jia anymore!" Sitting next to Yu, he said gently: "Yu, Jia has sincerely apologized to you and is willing to find a way to compensate." If we hold on to our anger, our stomachs will be filled with black stones;but if we choose to forgive, beautiful flowers will bloom in our hearts! "Yu looked at Xiaojiu's guilty face and was about to cry. He turned around and walked over and patted Xiaojiu on the shoulder: "It doesn't matter, we glued it up with transparent tape. It's still a very beautiful dinosaur!”The two little hands are held together again, and the boat of friendship is sailing again!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone has sincerely apologized and is willing to compensate, what will happen if we keep scolding them and ignoring them? What are the benefits of "choosing to forgive"?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Faced with a sincere apology from a peer, four partners practice opening their hearts, accepting the apology, saying "It's okay," and repairing items together!
🦁 Yu Yu shows tolerance
🎬 Action:Turn to face your peer, look at them with gentle eyes, extend your right hand to gently pat their shoulder, and slightly raise the corners of your mouth.
"It doesn't matter!" I see your sincerity, I'm not angry anymore, let's find a way to fix it together! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to break through the stubborn thinking of black and white and learn to be flexible, tolerant and relieved.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, relieved of his heavy burden
🎬 Action:Let out a long sigh of relief, relax completely, and carefully use the tape in both hands to help with the repair.
"Yu, thank you for forgiving me!" You are so kind. I will be more careful when I borrow something from you in the future! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the child to feel the redemptive sense of being forgiven and inspire more cautious peer respect.
🐼 He Gentle Tape Little Angel - He
🎬 Action:Tear off a piece of transparent tape and stick it flat on the torn crack in the paper, smoothing out the marks.
"Put on the transparent tape, the cracks are invisible, and the hearts of the two good friends are stuck together again!"”
💡 Tips:Help He use objects as metaphors to deepen the meaning of cooperative restoration.
🦊 Jia Witness for the Rebirth of Friendship - Jia
🎬 Action:Lead the whole class to clap together and award the "Open-mindedness Gold Medal" to the peers who showed tolerance.
"The most courageous person is to know how to forgive, and the magnanimity can tolerate everything in the world!" OO Learning Classroom is full of friendship and sunshine every day! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance strengthens the positive group motivational effect of the virtue of tolerance.

🥁 Row a dragon boat in perfect rhythm

[Dragon Boat Festival] Team spirit of dragon boat racing: cooperate with teammates’ speed without complaining

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with the Dragon Boat Festival in May, we can experience the true meaning of teamwork and cooperation: in group competitions and tasks, we should coordinate with the team's rhythm and pace, not complain about teammates who are slower, and encourage each other.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🐉 Colorful dragon boat races on the floor and the synchronized beating of drums!

The Dragon Boat Festival in May of the lunar calendar is here! On the floor of the special education classroom, two long colorful land-based dragon boats were made with skillful spelling. Give everyone a cardboard paddle and get ready for the "Dragon Boat Festival Land Dragon Boat Race"! At first, the strong Xiao Quan rowed very fast, using his hands and feet to rush forward; but Yu and He behind him couldn't keep up with the rhythm, and the whole dragon boat spun in circles and almost capsized! Jia was so anxious that he shouted: "You are paddling too slowly!"Hurry up, please!” Jia beat the rhythm drum: “Boom! Boom! Boom! Look at the rhythm of the drummer, one, two, one, two!”Xiaozuo heard the sound of the drum and slowed down his paddling speed to match He's rhythm. The four people shouted slogans in unison, and the dragon boat advanced smoothly like flying, successfully winning the red flag at the finish line! Everyone hugged together and cheered to celebrate!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When rowing a dragon boat, if the strongest person only focuses on rushing forward, can the dragon boat move forward? How can the team move fast and steadily?

🐻 Jun A little farmer who has learned to wait and cooperate
🎬 Action:Deliberately slow down the powerful stroke, turn your head to confirm that your teammates are following behind, and put on an encouraging smile.
"Dong dong dong!" He, follow me! The four of us are one, and we cross the finish line together! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the transformation of individual heroism into teamwork and compassion for the weak.
🐼 He Little He giving it his all
🎬 Action:Grip the paddles tightly with both hands, shout in response to the slogans, lean forward and paddle with all your might.
"Although my arms are sore, I insist on not giving up!"We are the best dragon boat team!”
💡 Tips:Help He enhance stress resilience and team belonging.
🦊 Jia Unity Dragon Boat Drummer - Jia
🎬 Action:Strik the rhythmic wooden fish rhythmically and forcefully, while shouting out loud and unified stroke commands.
"Boom!" one! Boom! two! Working together to win the red flag, the OO dragon boat team worked together to take first place! ”

👏 Sportsmanship - Big applause!
🏷️ Unit 13: Resilience and Good Sportsmanship 📌 Field:📝 Classroom learning
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Style Champion Officer

Good Sportsmanship: Winning and Losing Kindly

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Mastering competitive resilience: Overcome anger and loss of control when losing (crying, knocking over the chessboard, accusing the opponent of cheating), learn to take deep breaths to calm down, smile, shake hands with the winner, and say, "Congratulations, you're amazing!"

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
♟️ A billionaire who was just one step away from winning the championship and a cool high-five!

During board game time this afternoon, four children were playing the intense Animal Monopoly. Xiaozuo leads the way, and it seems that he can buy the last castle and win the championship if he throws another "three points"! When it was Xiao'an's turn to throw the dice, the dice rolled and rolled, and it actually rolled out a little! Then it was He's turn. He got a lucky throw of six and reached the finish line directly to win the championship! Jia's face fell instantly, his eyes widened, he grabbed the edge of the chessboard with both hands, and almost wanted to overturn the entire chessboard! He gently put his hand on Xiaojiu's shoulder: "Xiaojiu, the real hero is not the one who always wins, but the one who can afford to lose and applauds others gracefully!"”Xiaojiu closed his eyes, took three deep breaths, and took his hands away from the chessboard. He stood up, strode up to He and stretched out his right hand: "Congratulations, He!"You are so lucky today and had a great time!” The whole class immediately burst into thunderous applause!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you get angry and flip the table after losing a game, will anyone want to play with you again? What constitutes true "sportsmanship"?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a board game duel or sports competition where the team loses, the four little heroes demonstrate how to "restrain the urge to flip the table, take a deep breath to calm down, and proactively walk up to the winner to shake hands and congratulate them!"
🦁 Yu A young man displaying a magnanimous demeanor
🎬 Action:Let your hands hang naturally, take a deep breath and smile, walk up to your opponent and extend your right hand to shake hands.
"He, congratulations on your win!" This game of chess is really exciting. Next time I challenge you, I will definitely work harder! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Zhen to overcome the mania and frustration of being competitive, and sublimate the desire to win and lose into a magnanimous demeanor.
🐻 Jun Humility leads to victory.
🎬 Action:Politely shake the other person's hands with both hands, and wear a grateful and humble smile on your face, without showing off or mocking.
"Thank you, Jia!"The places you bought earlier are so amazing, we all have the most fun together!”
💡 Tips:Help He practice the humble virtue of "not being arrogant when winning" and not irritating defeated peers.
🐼 He Yu calmly accompanies her.
🎬 Action:Stand by the chessboard and help arrange the pieces, gently acknowledging the efforts of both players.
"Winning or losing is a common thing in military affairs. Having fun is the most important thing!"Everyone performed at a high level!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to view the competition results with a rational and calm attitude.
🦊 Jia Chief Etiquette Judge · Jia
🎬 Action:Holding the golden demeanor medal, present it to all participants and lead the applause.
"You can afford to play, you can afford to lose, the situation is big, and you have many friends!" OO’s special education athlete’s demeanor is perfect! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to establish a class honor culture in which "style is more important than winning or losing".

When Things Feel Unfair: Speaking Up Calmly

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master positive rights advocacy strategies: When subjectively feeling that "teachers are biased, the distribution is uneven, or it is unfair", do not vent by screaming, throwing objects, or resisting and striking. Instead, calmly raise your hand and raise questions and explanations to the teacher based on objective facts.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
⚖️ Two boxes of colored stickers and a raised arm!

When collecting points to exchange gifts today, Yu saw that He was given three large stickers, but he only got two small stickers. Yu suddenly felt a strong dissatisfaction in his heart: "It's not fair!" eccentric! I obviously studied seriously in class, so why are there more He! "Yu was so angry that he threw his pencil on the table, buried his head in his arms and muttered angrily. He came over and asked gently: "Yu, what's wrong with you?" ”Yu thought of the communication rules he usually practices: when you are angry or sulky, others will not be able to guess it, so you must use your words! Yu sat upright and raised his hands upright: "I would like to ask, He took three stickers and I took two. I feel a little sad and confused. How did you calculate it?" "Answered with a smile: "Yu, He also completed extra points for classroom cleaning today! And you wrote beautifully today, this is your exclusive shiny sticker! "After hearing this, Yu suddenly understood, and the injustice in his heart disappeared!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you feel something is unfair, will throwing things or crying resolve your doubts? What are the benefits of calmly raising your hand to ask a question?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:When faced with disputes over resource allocation or points, everyone practiced "not losing your temper, sitting upright and raising your hand, asking questions objectively, and listening to explanations!"
🦁 Yu Yu, who rationally raised his hand to ask a question
🎬 Action:Sit up straight with your back straight, raise your right hand steadily, and state your question to the teacher in a calm and polite tone.
"Teacher, please tell me. I just saw that the number of stickers is different. I feel a little confused and want to know the rules for extra points!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to transform his inner frustration into positive verbal actions that seek objective verification.
🐻 Jun Little Jun, who listens objectively
🎬 Action:Place both hands flat on the table, listen carefully to the teacher's explanation, and nod frequently to understand the rules and standards.
"So that's it!"If you ask the rules first, you won't lose your temper. The teacher's instructions are so clear!”
💡 Tips:Guide students to learn rational thinking based on facts and overcome preconceived emotions.
🐼 He Sharing the results with He
🎬 Action:Take the initiative to show your cleaning record card to your peers and gently explain the reason for the bonus points.
"Yu, look, this is a bonus point for cleaning the blackboard at noon today. Let's sign up to clean it together next time!"”
💡 Tips:Help He display information openness and transparency, and promote peer empathy and cooperation.
🦊 Jia Notary Public of Fairness, Jia
🎬 Action:Holding a scale sign, reiterate the open and transparent class reward point system to the whole class.
"If you have questions in your mind, ask politely!" Rational communication solves thousands of problems, OO classroom is the fairest! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia Shu and a healthy communication model to fight for rights and interests rationally.

[Retirement Ceremony and Graduation Season] Facing separation in classes: Adjusting to separation anxiety, cherishing each other

🎯 Summary of core objectives:In conjunction with the closing ceremony in June and the end of the school year, adjust to the anxiety of environmental changes: when facing peers moving up to higher levels, being divided into different classes, or graduating and parting ways, learn to look back on shared memories, write down blessing cards by hand, wish each other well, and make promises for the future.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎒 A colorful autographed commemorative booklet and a dream balloon soaring into the sky!

On campus at the end of June, cicadas began to sing in the treetops, and the annual closing ceremony arrived. He looked at the photo wall on the classroom wall and thought that everyone might be divided into different classes next school year. His nose felt sour and he couldn't help but shed tears on the table: "Are we not going to be able to be together in the future?"” The four children sat around on the floor mat and handed out a colorful souvenir book: "Children, being divided into classes is not the end, but that everyone grows up and explores the new world with new wings!"We want to thank each other for being there all year long!"Xiaojiu picked up the pen and drew a strong big bear in He's notebook: "He, don't cry, even if we are not in the same class, I will play ball with you every day after class!” Yu wrote “Xiaojiao, thank you for teaching me to be brave”, and Jia gave everyone a painted balloon. Everyone looked at each other's sincere messages, bursting into tears and laughing, and their hearts were filled with warmth and strength!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Is it normal to feel sad when facing grade changes or when a good friend graduates? What methods can we use to preserve beautiful memories forever?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:At the closing ceremony farewell party, everyone practiced reviewing shared memories, writing blessings for each other in the yearbook, and bravely giving each other a hug!
🦁 Yu Yu wrote down heartfelt blessings
🎬 Action:Hold the pen upright with both hands, carefully write down your words of gratitude in the peers' commemorative album, and present it to them personally.
"It's been great to have you by my side this year!" Thank you Xiaozuo for teaching me to be brave and He for lending me the colored pens. I wish you all good luck in your grade promotion! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to sort out social friendships and soothe separation emotions through words and specific actions.
🐻 Jun Little Jun generously promised friendship
🎬 Action:Extend your strong arms and gently give each partner a warm side hug, with a bold and confident expression.
"Don't be sad, brothers!"Even if we have different classes next school year, see you on the playground after class! We will always be the best buddies!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to turn attachment emotions into positive commitment and stabilize the group's sense of security.
🐼 He Little He, with tears in his eyes and a smile on his face
🎬 Action:Wipe away your tears, hold the commemorative book in front of your chest tightly, bow deeply to everyone and show a sweet smile.
"Thank you for your tolerance and care for me! I will keep everyone's words in mind and work hard to become a better He! ”
💡 Tips:Help He accept the sadness of farewell and transform it into new motivation for self-growth.
🦊 Jia Graduation Blessing Speaker: Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the colorful flag that reads "Friendship Forever" and lead the whole class in singing the class cheer song to welcome a new beginning.
"Don't be afraid to spread your wings and fly high. The friendship between the four little heroes will never end!" Happy summer vacation everyone, and cheers for the new grade! ”
💡 Tips:The guidance gathers a sense of ritual and sublimates the group learning process throughout the year.

Celebrating My Progress This Term

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Mastering meta-self-awareness and self-esteem construction: Reviewing three specific improvements made this academic year in emotional restraint, polite expression, and peer sharing, and confidently standing on the podium to present and receive applause and affirmation from peers.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
💮 Three big red flowers on the podium and the most dazzling confident smile!

In the last social class of this semester, a huge "Growth Tree" was posted on the blackboard of the special education classroom. Give everyone three gold-edged red flower stickers: "Today, we will give ourselves an award!"Everyone finds out the three things they have made the most progress in this year and puts the flowers on the big tree!” Yu was the first to step onto the stage, raising his head and chest high: "With the first flower, I dare to look at the forehead of others and say good morning; with the second flower, I will express my message; with the third flower, I have made three good friends!"” There was thunderous applause from the audience. Then Jia came on stage: "My big red flower is that I learned to brake with empathy, not to overturn the table when I lose, and to stop and listen around the corner!" "Looking at the red flowers blooming all over the tree, my eyes are moist: "Each of you has grown from a shy and fragile little seed into a giant tree hero standing tall and tall! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Think about it, since the start of the semester, what things have you overcome in the classroom that you were previously afraid to do or couldn't do well? Are you proud of yourself?

🦁 Yu Yu confidently expresses his opinion
🎬 Action:Stand tall and straight in the center of the podium, place three big red flowers on the top of the growth tree with both hands, and speak loudly.
"I used to be too shy to look at people, but now I can look into everyone's eyes and speak loudly!" I'm proud of myself! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the body to experience breakthroughs in self-efficacy brought about by long-term learning accumulation.
🐻 Jun Little Jun affirms his self-transformation
🎬 Action:Make a fist with your right hand and gently pound your chest, with a mature and proud smile on your face and a firm expression.
"My biggest improvement is that I learned to brake and calm down!" I am no longer a little tyrannosaurus, I am a little gentleman who knows the rules!”
💡 Tips:Guide positive internalization of impulse control achievements and strengthen positive self-identity.
🐼 He Gentle Sharing by Little He
🎬 Action:Hold your progress sheet upright with both hands, speaking softly but with strength.
"I learned to refuse bravely and raise my hands to speak. Studying in the special education class this year is the happiest thing for me! ”
💡 Tips:Help He see your inner courage and consolidate your self-affirmation value.
🦊 Jia Little Jia, Host of the Coming-of-Age Ceremony
🎬 Action:Sound the golden horn, award the "All-Round Growth Gold Medal" to all partners, and lead everyone in a cheer three times.
"Three red flowers bloomed all over the tree, and the four little heroes were reborn!"Each of us is number one in the universe!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the social learning results throughout the year and push them to the climax.
