[Summer vacation begins] Summer vacation life independent manual: regular work and rest should not be reversed

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master self-management skills during long holidays: overcome the loss of control over life by staying up late playing video games and sleeping in late during the day, and work with teachers and parents to create a daily schedule for summer vacation (early waking up, exercise, reading, and time limits for 3C products).

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
⏰ The rooster's morning crowing and the colorful daily schedule disc!

In the first week of summer vacation, Jia looked like a deflated rubber ball. On the first day, he watched TV until midnight, and on the second day, he slept until 12 noon before getting up. He was dizzy, grumpy, and even had a big fight with his mother. In the afternoon, the "Colorful Work and Rest Disk" was taken out in the online special education class meeting: "Children, summer vacation is the best opportunity to learn to "be the master of your own time"! If your work and rest are reversed, your brain will become rusty and stupid! ”Xiaojiu looked at the schedule shared by Yu: get up at eight o'clock in the morning to jump rope, do homework at nine o'clock, ride a bicycle at three o'clock in the afternoon, and go to bed at ten o'clock in the evening. Jia was so impressed that she immediately drew her own "Invincible Summer Vacation Schedule" with a paintbrush and posted it on the refrigerator. From that day on, Xiaojiu pressed the alarm clock and got up every morning, looking radiant!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What happens to your body and brain if you play video games until midnight and sleep until noon every day during summer vacation? Why does a regular lifestyle make people happier?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:During a holiday self-planning meeting, four little heroes practiced drafting a daily schedule for the summer vacation and made a pledge of self-discipline to their parents and teachers!
🦁 Yu Yu, who plans with self-discipline
🎬 Action:Showcases a hand-drawn color pie chart of time, clearly indicating reading, exercise, and bedtime periods.
"I get up on time at eight o'clock in the morning to have breakfast and do my summer homework in the morning. I am the little master of time in an orderly manner!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to maintain a structured sense of time during a loosely structured vacation.
🐻 Jun Little Jun made up his mind
🎬 Action:Place the small alarm clock upright in the center of your desk, and pat your chest to assure everyone that you will get up early and not stay in bed.
"I'm no longer a night owl!" Turn off the lights and go to bed at ten o'clock in the evening, and get up and run with the big rooster in the morning! ”
💡 Tips:Guide self-discipline to focus on sleep and circadian rhythm stability.

🛒 Community Courtesy King
🏷️ Unit 15: Summer Routines and Community Citizenship 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Community Gentleman

Being a Good Neighbor: Manners in the Community

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the routines of daily life in community public spaces: do not open unopened or unpaid items in convenience stores, take turns playing on playground equipment in community parks for five minutes in an orderly manner, do not climb dangerous walls, and maintain public cleanliness.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🏪 The five-minute secret between the convenience store at the alley entrance and the swings in the park!

On a hot summer afternoon, four children went to the local convenience store to enjoy the air conditioning and buy popsicles. As soon as Jun entered the store, he saw his favorite Pokémon blind boxes and excitedly tried to pry open the packaging with his fingernails to peek at the cards inside! The clerk frowned, and Yu quickly pulled Jun's arm gently: "Jun, no! You can't open the packaging before paying, that's the store's rule!" Jun quickly stopped, took out his change, and stood in line to pay. After buying the popsicles, they went to the park. There was only one popular swing set, the Bird's Nest. He sat on it and saw two little boys watching longingly. He proactively counted down five minutes and jumped off the swing: "Little brothers, it's your turn!" The parents in the park praised, "The children in the OO special education class are so well-mannered!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What law would you break if you opened the packaging and ate something at a convenience store before paying? What should you do if you're playing a game of snatching toys in a park?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the context of a convenience store checkout process and a community park play area, everyone practiced "keeping items unopened, checking out in order, and taking turns sharing play equipment within a limited time"!
🦁 Yu Yu, a model of proper shopping etiquette
🎬 Action:Hold the selected items upright with both hands and place them on the cashier counter. Look at the cashier and clearly state your payment needs.
"Hello, uncle, I want to buy this red bean popsicle. Please help me check out, thank you!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to implement basic social conversations and monetary transaction processes for independent shopping.
🐻 Jun Little Jun restrains the urge to open the package
🎬 Action:Keep both hands firmly in your pockets and wait until you have paid and received the invoice before opening the packaging bag.
"What a risk! What a risk!" I can only open the package after paying and getting the invoice. I am a good customer who abides by the courtesy of the supermarket! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to restrain their impulses and vandalize public property driven by strong curiosity.
🐼 He Little He taking turns playing with the playground equipment
🎬 Action:Watch your watch and count down. When five minutes are up, immediately stand up, smile and give way to the waiting neighbor's child.
"Five minutes are up, it's time for you to swing on the swing!"Everyone takes turns to play, and there are more laughs in the park!”
💡 Tips:Help He implement the awareness of delayed gratification and active taking turns to share.
🦊 Jia Community Civility Supervisor - Jia
🎬 Action:Pick up the small pieces of paper next to the bench and throw them into the trash can. Check if the whole team has a perfect score in community etiquette.
"Trash should not be left on the ground, play equipment can be enjoyed in turns, and supermarkets should abide by the rules!" We are the most popular and good neighbors in the OO community! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Chia to promote civic literacy in the public sphere of the community.

🚨 The Three-Step Anti-Bullying Self-Protection Strategy
🏷️ Unit 8: Body Autonomy and Saying No 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Anti-tyrant counterattack shield

Dealing with Teasing and Bullying: Leave Safely and Get Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master self-protection strategies when facing verbal mockery and physical bullying: Do not retaliate with violence or suffer in silence and self-pity. Practice "calm gaze and indifference → immediately go to a crowded place/to a companion → shout for help and report to an adult in detail".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦁 A little lion wearing thick glasses and three naughty little devils!

Beside the playground of the summer camp, three older children from other schools surrounded Yu, pointing at Yu's thick glasses and laughing loudly: "Frog with four eyes!"Walking clumsily!” He also deliberately stretched his legs to trip Yu. Yu was very scared and his legs were shaking. At this time, Yu remembered the anti-bullying drill: "The first step, don't yell back in anger, don't cry, look at the top of the other person's head, and walk away calmly and firmly;the second step, walk quickly to your partner!" "Yu puffed up his chest, without even looking at them, and strode decisively towards Jia and Jia who were washing the ball. As soon as Xiaojiu saw it, he immediately rushed forward to block Yu and shouted loudly: "Don't bully my classmates!"” Jia immediately ran to find the camp director. When the three mischievous children saw each other unite and find adults, they were so frightened that they ran away! The director severely punished them, and Yu escaped safely!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone deliberately makes fun of you, will arguing or fighting back solve the problem? Why is "calmly leaving, finding a friend, and reporting to an adult" the smartest three-step approach?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a bullying situation where they are ridiculed and pushed by their peers, the four little heroes practice "keeping their eyes calm and ignoring the situation, quickly walking towards their companions to form an alliance, and loudly reporting to their teachers and elders!"
🦁 Yu Calm and collected Yu
🎬 Action:When faced with ridicule, do not talk back or shed tears. Keep a firm gaze straight ahead and take big strides to quickly leave the scene.
"Your ridicule is of no use to me!"I won't waste time here with you, I'll go find the teacher to deal with it now!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to maintain a psychological defense line when encountering malicious provocation and not to give negative reinforcement to the bully.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who stood up to protect his peers
🎬 Action:Quickly step forward and stand sideways in front of Yu, stretch out your arms to create space, and speak in a loud and authoritative tone.
"If you have something to say, it's wrong to push someone!" Our learning classroom is united and bullying is not allowed! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Zhen to transform justice into a legal physical defense alliance, not actively attacking but resolutely guarding.
🐼 He Peaceful peers and small-mindedness
🎬 Action:Hold Yu's trembling hand tightly, gently comfort him, and walk together to the office.
"Don't be afraid, Yu, we are all here!" This is not your fault, adults will protect us fairly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He provide immediate emotional support to the victimized peer to avoid self-doubt.
🦊 Jia Calmly reporting Jia
🎬 Action:Walk quickly into the office and clearly and systematically report the time, location, and persons involved to the duty manager.
"Report to the director!" There are classmates pushing and laughing at Yu at the back of the playground. The situation is urgent. Please come to the director for help!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to accurately grasp the reporting elements and quickly mobilize the adult rights and interests protection network.

🏔️ A Mountain-like Journey of Love and Gratitude
🏷️ Unit 2: Summer Celebrations and Gratitude 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s badge: Little Warrior of Filial Father

[Father's Day] Rely as strong as a mountain: express sincere gratitude to your father

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Combined with Father's Day on August 8, appreciate the father's love or the deep and perseverance of male elders: hand-painted tie medal cards, serve tea, beat the back, and say loudly "Dad, I love you, thank you for protecting me like a mountain!" to express your heart.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
👔 Those large, calloused hands and a large blue tie card!

Father's Day is approaching on August 8th. Jun sat in the living room looking at his father's plumbing and electrical toolbox. Jun's father worked hard every day under the scorching sun at construction sites, his hands covered in scars and thick calluses. He often fell asleep on the sofa when he got home, exhausted. But whenever Jun wanted watermelon, his father would always cut him the sweetest, biggest, middle piece. In his online special education craft class, Jun cut out a beautiful tie from blue cardboard, writing "World's Number One Superman Dad" on it in gold pen. On Father's Day evening, as soon as his father came home from work, Jun presented him with a cup of iced barley tea, hung the paper tie around his father's neck, and rushed into his arms: "Dad! You've worked so hard! Happy Father's Day! Thank you for working so hard every day to support the family!" Tears of happiness streamed down his father's dark, rugged face.

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How do dads or elders in the family usually protect and take care of us silently like mountains? What actions can we use to say thank you to dad for your hard work?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a heartwarming Father's Day family gathering, four little heroes practice serving warm tea to their fathers or elders, presenting them with medal cards, and loudly expressing their love!
🦁 Yu The young servant who serves tea to his parents
🎬 Action:Hold the tea cup level with both hands, walk steadily to your father, bow slightly and offer him tea, with eyes full of respect.
"Dad, please have some tea!"You work hard outside in the sun every day. Take a sip of tea and take a break. Happy Father's Day!”
💡 Tips:Guidance shows delicate and sincere filial piety and consideration in a rough character.
🐻 Jun Yu, who sent the handmade card
🎬 Action:Present the hand-drawn mountain and Superman card to the elder with both hands and express your gratitude.
"Dad, you protect me like a mountain. I feel so at ease with you!" I wish you good health and happiness every day! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome shyness and boldly express his love and gratitude to his father's elders.
🐼 He Little He, so considerate, gives a back massage
🎬 Action:Walk behind the elder and use steady, hollow punches to relieve the elder's stiff shoulder muscles.
"Relax your shoulders!" Thank you dad for everything you have done for our family, you are our best supporter! ”
💡 Tips:Help He implement gentle care into substantial body feedback.
🦊 Jia Filial Piety and Brotherly Love Promotion Director - Jia
🎬 Action:Display the honor medals designed by the whole class for their fathers, and lead the whole team to shout the slogan of filial piety.
"Father's love is as high as a mountain, every bit of kindness will be remembered in my heart!" OO model student of filial piety, salute to all fathers in the world! ”
💡 Tips:Guide and promote the sentiment of filial piety and gratitude.

🛟 Water Safety Ring
🏷️ Unit 10: Self-Care and Healthy Habits 📌 Field:💡 Special topics
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Waters Drowning Prevention Officer

Summer Water Safety: Staying Away from Dangerous Water

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the concepts of summer water safety and drowning prevention and self-protection: do not play in the water at streams or beaches without lifeguards, warm up before entering the water, and do not blindly dive into the water to save others if you encounter someone drowning.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌊 A rushing stream and a lifebuoy floating on the water!

On a hot August day, my neighbor’s eldest brother told me to go swimming in a deep-water ravine without a lifeguard. When Jia heard that she was so excited, she grabbed her swimming trunks and wanted to follow! He quickly ran over and grabbed Xiaojiao's backpack: "Xiaojiao can't go!" I have said that there are undercurrents and sharp rocks under the stream. You must not play in the water without a lifeguard! ” I also rushed there immediately to review with everyone the five-word formula for preventing drowning: “Scream, scream, stretch, throw, and paddle”! Seriously: "If you see someone struggling in the water, you must not jump in to save him!"Shout for help, call 119, or throw a long bamboo pole or floating object to him! ”Xiaojiu wiped cold sweat all over his body. Fortunately, He caught her in time, and they all agreed to go to the municipal standard swimming pool with lifeguards. They had a safe and fun time!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you see a classmate or passerby falling into the water and about to sink, can you jump into the water to save them yourself? What is the first step in correct "calling, stretching, throwing and paddling"?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a water safety awareness campaign and a simulated emergency drowning situation, everyone practiced "strictly avoiding dangerous waters, loudly calling for adults, and using bamboo poles and lifebuoys to throw rescuers!"
🦁 Yu He firmly refused
🎬 Action:Stand with your hands on your hips, blocking the way, with a serious and firm attitude, and point to the safety poster to remind your peers.
"You absolutely cannot go to a stream without a qualified lifeguard!" We only have one life, so it is safe for us to go to a standard swimming pool! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance and resolutely assume the role of safety brake when faced with dangerous risk-taking proposals from peers.
🐻 Jun Little Jun realized his mistake in time
🎬 Action:Immediately put your swim trunks back into your backpack, pat your head hard, and thank your companions for stopping you in time.
"How dangerous, He, hold me!"I almost made a big mistake on impulse! Safety first, I only go to clean swimming pools with lifeguards!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to recognize the fatal risks that impulsiveness may cause and obey safety guidelines.
🐼 He Yu demonstrates rope rescue
🎬 Action:Simulate lying on the shore with your body low to the ground and forcefully throw the lifebuoy with the long rope attached forward toward the target water surface.
"Call for help!"Call 119! I'll throw the lifebuoy to you, hold on to the float, and don't jump into the water!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to become proficient in the safe drowning SOP of "rescuing on shore and throwing floats".
🦊 Jia Drowning Prevention Campaign Chief Commander: Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the ten anti-drowning slogan signs and lead everyone in loudly reciting the water safety slogans.
"It's safe to play in the water. Stay away from wild streams to stay safe!" OO little drowning prevention hero welcomes the start of school with perfect safety scores! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to summarize the core essentials of water safety.

🔍 Mind reading through micro-expressions in your eyebrows
🏷️ Unit 16: Empathy and Making New Friends 📌 Field:🗣️ Pragmatic communication
🎖️ Today’s badge: Mind-reading detective

Empathy Detectives: Noticing Other People's Feelings

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the ability to interpret advanced non-verbal emotions: observe peers' "eyes (widening/downcasting), eyebrows (tightening/flattening), corners of mouth (up/down), shoulders (tight/relaxed)", accurately interpret each other's happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy, and give appropriate social responses.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🔍 The little brow and the smile at the corner of the mouth under the magnifying glass!

The summer vacation is coming to an end, and an "Emotional Micro-Expression Detective Competition" was held in the special education classroom. Many close-up photos of only the eyes and corners of the mouth were displayed on the projection screen. The first photo: eyebrows furrowed into caterpillars, eyes blazing, fists clenched. Xiaojiu immediately responded: "He is angry!" You can't go over and make trouble with him at this time, you have to give him space to calm down! ”Second photo: Shoulders hunched up, looking down at the floor, corners of mouth turned down. Yu raised his hand and said: "He is very sad or has low self-esteem now and needs a gentle pat on the back from his friends!" ”He and Jia also correctly guessed the expressions of shyness and surprise. Praise: "Everyone's spiritual eyes are opened!"As long as you know how to read other people's expression codes, you can become a master of interpersonal relationships that everyone loves!”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you see a good friend frowning and not saying a word, what does it mean about his mood? What will happen if you play tricks on him at this time?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In a peer emotion interpretation scenario, the four little heroes practiced observing their partner's micro-expressions and providing the most appropriate care and interaction!
🦁 Yu Yu's keen observation
🎬 Action:Lean forward and observe your peers' facial expressions. Accurately convey your peers' feelings based on the characteristics of their mouths and eyes.
"I see your eyebrows relaxed and the corners of your mouth raised. You must be very happy now. Is there any good news?" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use specific facial features to objectively deduce the emotional state of others.
🐻 Jun Little Jun who has learned to read facial expressions
🎬 Action:When you see your peers frowning, take a step back and keep quiet, put away the funny toys in your hands, and step back to remain quiet.
"I see that you look very troubled. I won't bother you anymore. If you need someone to listen to you, I will be here at any time!"”
💡 Tips:Guidance to improve the past "cannot see the air" white-eyed behavior, showing timely concessions and empathy. [04381​​] Guidance to let go of self-esteem and defense and experience the personality strength brought about by sincerely taking responsibility.
🐼 He Sending you a warm little tidings.
🎬 Action:Hand over a glass of warm water, look at the colleague who is feeling down with gentle and focused eyes, and gently pat the other person's back.
"Your shoulders are so tight. Are you tired and sad?"Take a deep breath, we are with you!”
💡 Tips:Help He directly transform micro-expression interpretation results into caring behaviors.
🦊 Jia Empathy Detective Chief - Jia
🎬 Action:Holding an emotion decoding manual, award the "Detective Gold Badge" to all members to praise their improved interpersonal sensitivity.
"Looking at the facial features and people's hearts, being considerate and empathic is the most heart-warming thing!"OO special trainers are all great interpersonal detectives!”

🧊 The Three-Phrase Politeness Breaking Method
🏷️ Unit 16: Empathy and Making New Friends 📌 Field:🗣️ Pragmatic communication
🎖️ Today’s badge: Ice Breaker Magician

Making New Friends: Starting a Conversation

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Master the skills to actively break the ice and make friends in unfamiliar situations: Overcome the unfamiliarity and embarrassment when facing new classmates, and master the three-step ice-breaking rule of "smile and focus eyes → praise the other person's good things or advantages → bring up common topics or share toys".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧊 Two little hedgehogs and a box of magical magnets by the playground!

On the freshman experience day in mid-August, many transfer students and new classmates came to the campus. Under the shade of the trees on the playground, a new classmate sat alone on a bench holding his schoolbag, looking lonely and nervous. Jia pulled Yu and Xiaojiu: "Let's go!" Let’s go work on some ice-breaking magic! ”The four people walked forward quickly. Yu first showed a warm smile: "Hello!" I am Yu from OO Elementary School! "Xiaojiao looked at the Pikachu pendant on his new classmate's school bag and praised loudly: "Wow! Your Pikachu pendant is so handsome. Do you like Pokémon too?” The new classmate’s tense face suddenly lit up: “Yes! Charizard is my favorite! He opened the box of magnetic tablets and said, "We just want to build a Pokémon castle. Do you want to join us in building it?"”The new classmate happily put down his schoolbag and jumped over, and within five minutes we became good buddies who talked about everything!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you see a new classmate sitting alone, what kind of courage does it take to take the initiative to go over and say hello? What are the "Three Steps to Breaking the Ice"?

🎬 Action:Take a steady step to the new peer, smile and wave your right hand to clearly introduce yourself.
"Hello! I am Yu from the study classroom. Welcome to OO Elementary School. Nice to meet you!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to take the initiative to take the first step in strange interpersonal situations and break the self-social barriers.
🐻 Jun Praise Jun for finding topics to talk about.
🎬 Action:Look at the other person's sneakers, give a thumbs up to show your sincere appreciation, and start a conversation that resonates with them.
"Your sneakers are so handsome!"Do you also like to play basketball? Let’s go shooting basketball together after class!”
💡 Tips:Guide students to master the efficient ice-breaking strategy of "opening up common interests with praise".
🐼 He Little He actively shares his toys
🎬 Action:Hold out your toy block box with both hands and make a welcoming gesture to your new peers.
"This is my favorite magnetic building block. We just need a partner. Let's build a tall tower together!" ”
💡 Tips:Guidance and sharing of specific objects as a medium for deepening social relationships.
🦊 Jia Jia, the chief builder of friendship bridges
🎬 Action:Take the hand of the new peer and integrate them into the circle of four, then lead everyone in a high-five and cheer.
"New friends, new partners, we have the happiest time playing together!"The door of OO special education friendship is always open for you!”
💡 Tips:Guidance Jia serves as the core link for group inclusion and integration.

[Take off in the new school year] Put on the cloak of courage: the self-confidence and big commitment of entering a new grade

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Review the entire fifty-two weeks of social skills and communication practice, fully integrate non-verbal language, emotional braking, I-message, rejection and self-protection, teamwork and other abilities, put on the red cloak of courage, and confidently meet the new challenges of the new grade!

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦸 Put on the red cloak of courage, the four little heroes of OO face the future!

August 24th, the last social class for fifty-two weeks. The podium of the special education classroom was covered with a bright red carpet and surrounded by fifty-two sparkling badges and flags. He held four bright red "Little Heroes of Courage Cloaks" in his hands: "Fifty-two weeks, three hundred and sixty-five days."From little dinosaurs to little hedgehogs, you have passed the fifty-two major tests of emotional thermometer, me message, sincere apology, dragon boat cooperation, and safety and bullying prevention! Now, each of you has the invincible social superpower to protect yourself and love your friends!”I tied red cloaks on the four children with my own hands. Yu, Jia, He, and Jia stood in a row, raised their hands in salute facing the sunshine outside the window, and swore loudly: "We have grown up!"We are ready for the next grade!"That loud voice penetrated the campus and echoed in the blue sky!

🔕 Noise-canceling earmuffs for a calming experience
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation
🎖️ Today’s badge: Little air defense evacuation hero

Loud Alarm Drills: Ear Defenders and Safe Evacuation

🎯 Summary of core objectives:The sudden, sharp air raid siren during drills often causes auditory overload and panic in autistic children. Guide children to recognize the drill warning, quickly put on noise-canceling earmuffs, and adopt the safety protection posture of "crouching down with their heads covered, mouths closed, and ears covered".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚨 Big buzzing alarm and magically silent earmuffs!

At ten o'clock in the morning on Thursday, the campus radio suddenly heard a harsh and loud "Woo--Woo--" air defense drill siren! The entire corridor reverberated with a sharp buzz. Yu was so frightened that he shrank under the table, covering his ears with his hands, and his body was shaking violently. Wen Wen squatted down and took out a pair of navy blue "noise-cancelling and silent earmuffs" and gently helped Yu put them on. In an instant, the piercing scream turned into a distant sound of wind! Jia and Xiaojiu also followed the mantras they usually practiced: "Don't push, don't talk, hold your head and squat down" and hid calmly next to the table. He came over and gave Yu a thumbs up. Yu took a deep breath, and his heartbeat slowly calmed down: "With protective earmuffs, the roar of the big monster in the drill can no longer scare me!"”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What dangers might occur if you run around when a loud alarm suddenly sounds on campus? Why can wearing earmuffs and crouching under a table protect you?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The air raid evacuation drill was conducted without warning. The alarm sounded throughout the school. Four little heroes practiced quickly putting on earmuffs, covering their heads for protection, and not screaming!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Quickly take out the noise-canceling earmuffs from the side pocket of your backpack and put them on. Shrink your body under the table and hug the back of your neck with both hands.
"Whew ~ put on the big silent earmuffs, the alarm sound has become smaller! I'm safe under the table! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome sensory overload caused by sudden sharp and loud noises and establish a sense of self-protection.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to run around, kneel down with both knees on the ground, put your hands behind your head, and keep your mouth tightly closed without playing around.
"Everyone, squat down!"It’s evacuation time, we need to stay quiet and protect our heads!”
💡 Tips:Guidance is given to convert excess physical energy into self-disciplined behavior that abides by evacuation disciplines.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Gently hide behind the table, look at Yu with concern in your eyes, and pat Yu's shoulder to comfort him.
"Don't be afraid, Yu, we are together, the drill will be over in three minutes!"”
💡 Tips:Help He use gentle companionship qualities to build a sense of peer support.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Hold the classroom escape and refuge map card, keep your body close to the table legs, and confirm that everyone is in position.
"Report to the teacher!"All members of our group got into position with their heads held in their hands, no one spoke or pushed!”
💡 Tips:Guidance Jia gave full play to ASD's insistence on rules and structures and became the leader of the class order team.

🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Provide gripping acupressure balls to guide the transformation of screaming panic into the physical release of clenching the acupressure balls.

🧤 Tactile comfort and autonomy
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Little Master of Tactile Adaptation

Scratchy Labels and Sticky Clay: Explaining Sensory Needs

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with autism often experience emotional distress due to itchy collar tags, sticky or cold textures in art clay, or other tactile discomfort. Encourage children to verbally describe their tactile discomfort and to proactively remove the tags or wear gloves to complete tasks.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌵 A little hedgehog on the neck and colorful little gloves!

Jia wore a newly bought bright yellow sportswear to school today. But as soon as he entered the classroom, Jia kept reaching out to scratch the back of his neck. His whole face turned red, and he was so irritated that he threw the textbook on the table: "It's so itchy!" So prickly! I don't want to wear this dress anymore! ” I walked over and inspected it gently, and found that there was a hard nylon washing label sewn on the back collar of the clothes. Picking up the small scissors, carefully cut off the label, and placed a soft cotton handkerchief on the collar. Then during the clay art class, I also prepared a pair of thin transparent baking gloves for Kowa, who was afraid of the sticky feeling. Jia touched her neck and smiled happily: "The prickly little hedgehog is gone. I feel so comfortable now!"”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If clothes tags or clay make you feel uncomfortable, is it helpful to keep throwing tantrums or tearing clothes off? What can I tell you to solve the problem?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In art class, the clay sticks to their hands, and the tags on their new clothes are itchy. The four little heroes practice expressing their feelings and seeking help!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:When you touch the sticky slime and feel your palms go numb, immediately place both hands flat on the table and take a deep breath, without throwing the slime on the ground.
"Teacher, I feel weird when the clay sticks to the palm of my hand. Can I put on gloves first and then squeeze it?"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to actively express tactile defensive feelings and use tools to gradually desensitize them.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Your neck is itchy from the new clothes. Resist the urge to tear the collar and raise your hand to walk towards the teacher.
"Phew~ I'm about to get angry!"Because the label on the back of my clothes is very prickly, please help me cut it off!”
💡 Tips:Guidance to tell the specific physical reasons before the angry volcano erupts.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Put on thin, transparent gloves, happily pick up the yellow clay and knead it into a small ball, with a bright smile.
"When you put on gloves, the clay won't stick to your hands!" I can build a clay castle too! ”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the sense of successful participation brought by tool assistance.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Take the cut-off tag and put it in the trash can, straighten your collar, sit up straight and return to your seat.
"The label is cut clean!"When I feel better, I can concentrate on doing art work with everyone!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to experience the state of focused learning after eliminating sensory interference.

1
Notice any itchy or sticky discomfort on the skin.
2
Raise your hand gently and say: "Teacher, the tag on this shirt is prickly."
3
Trim with small scissors or place a pure cotton handkerchief underneath.

🔋 Three-minute recharge technique
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Sensory Charging Butler

🍲 Noisy Places: Asking for a Quiet Recharge Break

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Faced with the crowds at the after-school cooperative, the smell of steamed buns, and the noisy hawking, schoolchildren are prone to multi-sensory overload. Teaching children to recognize brain shutdown warning signs involves giving a "pause" gesture to their peers and retreating to a quiet, well-ventilated area to recharge.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🐝 A buzzing hive of people and a breezy corridor!

During the long break, Yu and Jun went to the school cooperative to buy milk with their spare change. As soon as they reached the door, Yu froze—it was packed with thirty or forty students, all shouting at the top of their lungs: "I want tea eggs! I want bread!" The cash register beeped, steam billowed out. The various sounds and smells mingled together, like thousands of bees buzzing in Yu's head! Yu's face turned pale, and he stood rooted to the spot. Seeing Yu's blank stare, Jun immediately remembered the "off-site recharging method" taught in class. Jun gently pulled Yu's hand and led him to the camphor tree-lined corridor outside the cooperative: "Yu, let's enjoy the breeze under the trees and take three deep breaths!" In the quiet shade, with the gentle breeze, Yu's mental alarm finally subsided.

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you feel dizzy and nauseous in a crowded, noisy, and smelly place, how do you recharge yourself?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The cooperative is bustling and stuffy. The four little heroes practice identifying sensory overload and remind each other to recharge in a ventilated area!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:When you feel your brain is about to shut down, make a pause gesture to Jun, turn around and walk to the camphor tree, close your eyes and take a deep breath.
"Huh~ The sound inside is too loud. My battery is almost out of power. I want to charge it under the tree for three minutes!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to independently initiate a preventive exit strategy before collapse.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Instead of pushing and shoving through the crowd, they proactively accompanied Yu to the corridor and helped carry the milk bottle.
"Don't worry, Yu, I'll be with you outside!" We will buy it again when there are fewer people in the cooperative! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to develop positive empathy that enthusiastically protects their weaker peers.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Wipe the sweat from your forehead with a handkerchief, take a deep breath of fresh air in a well-ventilated area, and relax.
"The wind outside is so cool!"My brain is no longer knotted, and I have strength again!”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the help of sensory stress reduction on physiological balance.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Confirm that the surrounding environment is safe and free of obstacles, and use your watch to time three minutes to remind everyone of the break time.
"The three-minute charging timer begins!"Everyone close your eyes and wait for the beep before we go!”
💡 Tips:Guidingjia uses time structuring tools to help the team settle down physically and mentally.

1
Notice overload signals such as a buzzing brain, dizziness, and chest tightness.
2
Make a "T" sign with both hands in front of your chest" pause gesture to your peers.
3
Step back into a breezy corridor or a quiet corner and take three deep breaths.

🕶️ Soft Light Visual Protection Net
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation

🔦 Bright Lights: Asking for Help and Adjusting the Room

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Strong fluorescent light flickering or intense afternoon sunlight can easily cause eye strain, migraines, and irritability in autistic children. Teachers should gently and politely ask children to turn off a light or gently close the blinds to create a visually friendly environment.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
☀️ The bright reflection on the blackboard contrasts beautifully with the soft beige curtains!

In the math class at two o'clock in the afternoon, the red sun in the west shines directly on the blackboard of the special education classroom! The dazzling white light formed a large reflection on the blackboard, so bright that it was difficult to open one's eyes. Jia, who was sitting in the first row, squinted her eyes and frowned tightly. Her eyes were so sore that she could not see the questions clearly. Jia wanted to slam the table and shout: "It's too bright!"So annoying!” But she remembered the “Soft Light Communication Method” taught. Jia stood up, put her hands flat, and said politely: "The sun is reflecting on the blackboard and it hurts my eyes. Can I go and half-close the beige curtains?" ” Praise: “Jia’s expression is great! Please go and draw the curtains! ”When the soft beige curtains were lowered, the dazzling white light turned into warm soft light, and everyone felt so comfortable looking at the blackboard!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When the sunlight is too bright or the lighting gives you a headache, will yelling and shouting solve the problem? How can we get everyone to work together to create comfortable lighting?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:In the afternoon, the direct sunlight on the blackboard caused strong glare. The four little heroes practiced politely expressing their needs and worked together to adjust the classroom lighting!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:If you feel a stinging sensation in your eyes from a reflection, gently cover your brow bone with your hand and quietly raise your hand to wait for your turn to speak.
"Tell the teacher, I can't see the words clearly due to the reflection in the middle of the blackboard. I want to see it from another angle."”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to actively adjust the viewing angle and restrain the frustration and anxiety caused by unclear vision.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Walk lightly to the window and slowly pull the curtain cord with both hands, without pulling hard.
"Don't worry, Jia, I'm strong, I'll help pull the curtains neatly so that they won't be dazzling!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide students to turn their abundant energy into concrete actions that serve the class.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Rub your eyes in soft light, smile, and pick up a pencil to highlight key points in your textbook.
"After closing the curtains, the numbers on the blackboard can be seen clearly. Thank you everyone! ”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the positive impact of a friendly environment on learning concentration.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Politely raise your hand and stand up, and clearly and loudly state the specific situation where the light is too glaring.
"Teacher, the blackboard will reflect when the sun shines directly on it. Can we close half of the curtains?"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to use clear spoken language to directly express specific environmental adjustment demands.

💨 Movement and Stimming: Choosing Helpful Sensory Tools

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with autism and ADHD often regulate their inner anxiety by shaking their bodies, making noise by flicking pens, or repeatedly stomping their feet. Teaching children to recognize their need for self-stimulation and to use invisible educational tools that do not disturb others (such as pressure points, silent elastic bands, and tactile rings) to achieve self-soothing.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌀 A spinning top and a soft ball in your pocket!

During the Mandarin class, Yu's body seemed to be equipped with an electric motor. He couldn't help but sit on the chair and rock violently back and forth. The ball pen in his hand "click, click!"” He kept pressing and tapping his toes hard on the floor. The classmate sitting next door couldn't help but turn his head: "Yu, you are so noisy when you keep pressing your pen, I can't even hear you!" ” Yu lowered his head, feeling aggrieved: "I didn't mean to disturb everyone, but my stomach felt so tight and panicked when I didn't press the pen..." He walked over with a smile, took out a green "silent acupressure ball" with raised particles on the surface from the magic box and put it in Yu's hand, and put a soft "silent elastic band" on the front legs of Yu's chair. Yu put the ball into his pocket and squeezed it gently. He stepped on the elastic band and swayed gently. There was no noise in the classroom, and Yu's heart calmed down like a calm lake!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you're tense and anxious and want to move around a lot, who will be affected if you make a lot of noise? What quiet methods can relieve stress without disturbing others?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Feeling anxious in class and wanting to bang on the table to make noise, the four little heroes practice using a silent teaching aid to calm themselves down!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Slowly squeeze the green acupressure ball with both hands in your pockets, step on the elastic band with both feet, and focus your eyes on the teacher.
"I squeeze the ball gently in my pocket, squeeze it, and release it, and my body won't want to shake all the time!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to meet proprioceptive adjustment needs with hidden and quiet sensory input.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Gently place the ballpoint pen that is about to pop out into the pencil case, zip it up, and then use both hands to hold the eraser firmly.
"I won't press the clicking pen anymore!" I hold the eraser tightly so that the whole class can listen quietly! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the child to resist the urge to create auditory stimulation and to be considerate of peers around him.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Hold a soft ball of yarn under the table, move gently, and wear a reassuring smile.
"When I touch the soft hair of the wool ball, I feel very warm in my heart and I am not nervous at all!"”
💡 Tips:Help He make good use of tactile comfort to establish a sense of security in learning.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Sit upright and stamp a small stamp on your notebook after listening to each passage, using structured hand gestures.
"Use your hands for writing and stamping. If you have something to do, your brain will not run away to think about other things!" ”
💡 Tips:The guide locks action intentions through highly structured writing operations.

Feeling an urge to itch your hands, shake your pen, or make strange noises when pressing it.

🩺 White Coat Health Check Reassurance Mantra
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation

🦷 Health Checkups: Preparing for New People and Equipment

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education students often resist and scream when faced with metal mouth mirrors, vision hoods, and white-coated medical staff during school health checks due to the unknown and fear of touch. Through role-playing scenarios to see the examination steps, coupled with the "Big Mouth Ah~ Three Seconds" exercise, they can overcome their fear of medical procedures.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🐊 A baby crocodile with its mouth wide open and a magical little silver mirror!

Today, rows of health checkpoints were set up in the activity center. The dentist in a white robe held a long, thin, shiny metal mirror in his hand. When it was the special education class's turn to line up, when He saw the metal equipment, he was so frightened that tears fell down. He covered his mouth tightly with both hands and hid behind him, refusing to sit on the revolving chair. He took out the little crocodile stuffed doll and demonstrated with a smile: "Look, He, the little crocodile is coming to look in the mirror to check its teeth!"Open your mouth and say: Ah - one, two, three!"The dentist uncle also squatted down gently and gently touched the round metal mirror on the back of He's hand: "Look, this is just a small flashlight mirror that illuminates the teeth. It's ice cold and doesn't hurt at all!” He touched the back of his hand, took a deep breath, sat on the chair, opened his mouth generously and said, “Ah——!”"My uncle praised: "What clean teeth! Done in three seconds! ”He happily got the brave sticker!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you keep your mouth tightly shut and cry during a health check, will the doctor still be able to examine you? What can you do to make yourself brave when you're scared?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:While waiting in line for a routine health check at school, four little heroes practice cooperating with the dentist to open their mouths and overcome their fear!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Sit on the examination chair, look at the star stickers on the ceiling, open your mouth wide and hold for three seconds without moving.
"I looked at the ceiling and counted one, two, three. Just touch the small metal mirror and it was fine. It really didn't hurt at all! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use the visual focus transfer method to overcome the fear of touching instruments.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Place both hands neatly on your knees, cooperate fully with the vision check, and use the baton to accurately indicate the direction of E.
"The gap is facing up!"The gap faces left! My visual acuity is 1.0 in both eyes. I have superhuman vision!”
💡 Tips:Guide the patient to transform his competitive spirit into a positive performance of conscientiously cooperating with the physical examination.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Hold the teacher's hand and sit on the chair. Bravely open your mouth. After the examination, bow to the dentist and say thank you.
"Ah - I did it!" I take good care of my teeth. The doctor said I don’t have any cavities! ”
💡 Tips:Help He overcome medical anxiety and build self-confidence in physical care.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Help by holding everyone's health check record form, reading out the students' names in order, and assisting with the queuing process.
"The next one is Yu!"Everyone stands in one square, take the health check form and don’t lose it!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to undertake specific class administrative tasks and maintain smooth order in the team.

🧘 Chair Core Stretch
🏷️ Inspiration Library Special Topic 1: Sensory Regulation and Sensory Adaptation 📌 Field:⚡ Sensory Modulation
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Rainy Day Vitality Stretch Officer

🌧️ Rainy-Day PE: Stretching Indoors

🎯 Summary of core objectives:The long-awaited physical education class on the playground was forced to be moved indoors due to torrential rain. Hyperactive and emotionally unstable students often became agitated and ran away because their kinetic energy could not be released. The students were taught to use chair squats, stretching exercises, and resistance bands in the classroom to regulate their proprioception and stabilize their physical and mental energy.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
☔ A large puddle on the playground and a small gymnastics routine in the classroom!

The fourth quarter is the physical education class that everyone is most looking forward to. Everyone has changed into their sneakers and is ready to go to the playground to play football! Suddenly, thunder rumbled in the sky, and then it started pouring rain. There were big mud puddles everywhere on the playground. Sports walked into the classroom and announced: "It's raining too much today, so we will study in the classroom and watch football game videos." ” As soon as he heard that he couldn't go to the playground, Jia was so angry that he kicked over the chair and said, "Damn it! Damn it!" I've been preparing to play football all week, I don't care, I'm going to go out and run! ”The whole person was as angry as popcorn about to explode. He came over, held up the chair, and said with a smile: "If you can't run on the playground, then we will have the "Indoor Agent Stretch Challenge" in the classroom!" ”Teach everyone to do “chair squats”, “push the wall with both hands” and “turtle static core exercises”. After ten minutes, Jia was sweating comfortably, and all the suffocation in her heart was gone: "Wow!" Pushing the wall and squatting are more enjoyable than playing football! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When it's raining heavily and we can't run on the playground, can kicking over a classroom chair stop the rain? What indoor activities can we use our strength in the right way?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Heavy rain caused PE class to be moved to the classroom. Four little heroes practiced controlling their tempers and working together to do indoor core stretches!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Feeling uneasy about the sudden change in the class schedule? Look at the wall-pushing picture card and push the wall with both hands for ten seconds to relieve anxiety.
"Pushing against the solid wall, my hands feel very powerful and I don't feel panic anymore!"”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu calms the anxiety of sudden stroke changes through heavy resistance proprioceptive input.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Right the chair that was kicked over, and follow the teacher to do double squats, turning excess energy into healthy sweat.
"Breathe in!"Squatting five times will really make you sweat! I no longer kick the chair, I am now a squat strongman!”
💡 Tips:Help Jun to transform destructive impulses into positive, high-intensity physical outlets.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Sit on a chair and stretch your spine upwards with both hands, like a sapling growing in the rain, with a joyful expression.
"It's so comfortable to do stretching exercises in the classroom on a rainy day!"The muscles and bones are stretched and the whole person is energetic!”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the benefits of gentle stretching for circulation and focus.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Stand in front of the podium and count the beats: "One, two, three, four; two, two, three, four," leading all students to perform the movements in unison.
"Preparation - Pushing the wall starts in ten seconds!" One, two, three... everyone moved very neatly! ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia serves as the command commander and brings the sense of structural rhythm into class activities.

🎾 Two-way conversational ball throwing and catching
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 2: Pragmatic Communication and Implicit Social Codes 📌 Field:🗣️ Pragmatic communication
🎖️ Today’s badge: Throwing, catching and chatting master

🦖 Sharing My Favorite Topic: Taking Turns in Conversation

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Autistic children often launch into lengthy monologues about specific interests (dinosaurs, bus routes, Pokémon), ignoring their peers who are already lost in thought or wanting to leave. Teach them to use the "three-sentence pause" technique and proactively throw the conversation back to them: "So, what do you like?"

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
⚾ The baseball flying non-stop and the ball being passed back and forth!

Ten minutes into the break, Yu grabbed Jun and excitedly launched into a rapid-fire lecture: "Did you know that Charizard has two Mega Evolutions? The X-type is Dragon and Fire, with incredibly high attack power... and Mewtwo's gene arrangement..." Yu talked for eight minutes straight without stopping, gesturing excitedly with his hands. Standing opposite him, Jun's eyes were already drifting towards the playground, his feet involuntarily taking steps backward, muttering, "Yu, I need to go to the bathroom..." But Yu didn't hear him at all, continuing his endless chatter. Just then, Jia gently patted Yu's shoulder and handed him a tennis ball: "Yu, chatting is like passing a ball. If you keep throwing and not letting others catch, their arms will get sore!" Yu paused, seeing Jun's anxious look, and quickly slammed on the brakes: "Ah! Sorry, Jun, I talked too much! What's your favorite game? You throw the ball!" Jun smiled: "I like dodgeball, let's go after school!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you keep talking about your favorite things and don't let anyone else speak, how will the other person feel? How can we create a "give and take" atmosphere in conversation?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:After class, share your favorite toys or cartoons. The four little heroes practice restraining their monologues, asking each other questions, and listening to each other!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:After saying your two favorite sentences from the dinosaur encyclopedia, pause and gesture towards Jun.
"This is my favorite Triceratops!" Now that I’ve finished talking, it’s your turn to be Xiaojiu. What’s your favorite animal? ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to self-monitor the conversation volume and proactively ask questions when special interests are stimulated.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Make a catching motion with both hands, look at Yu, and continue the conversation with a smile.
"I caught the good ball!" My favorite is the cheetah because it can run as fast as me! ”
💡 Tips:The guidance department actively responds to peer dialogue and establishes successful experiences in two-way communication.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Listen attentively to the two people talking, nod and smile to encourage your peers.
"The Triceratops is strong, the cheetah runs fast, your favorite animals are all so unique!"”
💡 Tips:Guidance and practice in the harmonious role of listening and connected dialogue.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Holding a conversation timer hourglass in his hand, he watches everyone take turns speaking with a focused expression.
"Everyone takes turns talking for one minute, and everyone has something to say. This time the chat, passing and receiving was a great success!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to maintain an equal voice mechanism through time and rule structures.

1
Realizing he had already uttered three sentences in a row, he immediately put the brakes on his brain.
2
Observe whether the other person's eyes are looking at you, or if they are already looking around and trying to leave.
3
Throw the conversation ball to the other person: "And what about you? What do you like best?" And listen attentively.

🧠 Filtered Gum for Words
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 2: Pragmatic Communication and Implicit Social Codes 📌 Field:🗣️ Pragmatic communication
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Thoughtful and Speaking Guardian Officer

🤐 Honest and Kind: Thinking Before Speaking

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education children often suffer from interpersonal disasters due to their blunt cognition, saying "your new hair style is ugly" or "your lunch box smells so bad" in public. Guide school children to establish a "thinking filter", distinguish between "objective facts" and "hurtful comments", and learn to chew their brains three times before speaking.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🍋 Tart lemon candy and sweet marshmallows!

He got a new haircut today, with short bangs. She walked into the classroom a little shyly. As soon as Xiaozuo saw it, he immediately pointed at He's head and laughed loudly and shouted: "Hahaha!" He, your head looks like it has been chewed by a dog. It’s so ugly! "When He heard this, his whole face turned pale instantly, tears welled up in his eyes, and he lay on the table with his head down and cried. He came over and gently invited Xiaoji to the side: "Xiaoji, your words are like a sour lemon piercing He's heart."Even if you think your hairstyle is different, calling someone "so ugly" in public will make them very sad.” Teach everyone the formula for chewing “brain filter gum”: “Is this sentence true? Is it necessary to say this? Does it make you sad to hear this?"Xiaojiu looked at the sobbing He and felt very guilty. He stepped forward and bowed sincerely: "He, I'm sorry, I shouldn't have laughed at your hair. It looks refreshing if you cut it short. Please forgive me! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you see a classmate wearing new clothes or having a new haircut, if you just shout "so ugly", how will the other person feel? What trouble can you avoid by chewing three times in your brain before you want to speak?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A classmate got new glasses or a new hairstyle. The four little heroes practice activating their verbal filters to avoid saying hurtful things!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Seeing He's new hairstyle, you feel a little uncomfortable. You think about it for three seconds and don't blurt out any strange comments.
"He, you cut your hair short!" It must be so cool to have physical education class in the summer! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to turn observed facts into practical function-oriented positive responses.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Immediately stop making a mocking face, put your hands behind your back, and sincerely apologize to the peer who was hurt.
"I've chewed the brain gum!" I'm sorry He, I shouldn't criticize your hair casually! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to recognize the hurtful nature of words and implement immediate oral apology repairs.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Wipe away your tears with a handkerchief, feel the sincere apology from your peers, and raise your head to smile bravely.
"Thank you everyone, actually I was a little uncomfortable at first, but now I feel very relaxed!”
💡 Tips:Guiding and rebuilding body image and mental resilience from peer feedback.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Hold up the Classroom Consideration Rules card to remind everyone to maintain respect for and appreciation of diversity.
"Everyone has the freedom to change their hairstyle!"Praise and respect are the first rules in our classroom!”
💡 Tips:Guide and maintain a psychologically safe atmosphere in the class with empathy.

🎯 Super power move visual chart card ⭐ Brain Chew Three Times Filtering Method
1
Perceived urge to blurt out comments about peers' appearance, lunch, or clothing
2
Chew the gum three times in your mind and ask yourself: "Does this sentence make you want to cry?"”
3
Take the hurtful thorn back into your belly and replace it with praise or keep polite and quiet
🎯 IEP Quantitative Goals & Putt Collaboration & Family Life Behavioral classification tripartite connection
🎯 IEP observable quantitative goals:When faced with peers' appearance, works or personal characteristics, they can restrain themselves from making inappropriate direct comments, use neutral or positive language to interact, and do not make fun of them in public. The achievement rate is above 85%.
🏫 Post-it notes on integration tips for regular class instructors:
Regular class tutors should establish the routine of "zero appearance teasing in class" to guide children to see the uniqueness and dignity of each person.
🏠 Home Practice Check-In:
After returning home from school, show your parents how to🧠 Word Filter Chewing Gum" and give warm high fives to your family!
🧩 Individualized differentiated support (support scaffolding for students with special needs) UDL multiple representation and participation
🔹 Students with autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
Show the "traffic light filter list": red light (hurtful appearance evaluation), no speaking, yellow light (personal feelings), whisper in private, green light (praise and gratitude), speak loudly.
🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)
Use the image of "a lotus flower spits out of your mouth to speak good words, and a poisonous snake spits out of your mouth to speak bad words" to metaphorize the consequences of speaking.
🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Practice pressing your tongue against the roof of your mouth for three seconds to force your brain to calm down before you laugh or blurt it out.

🔍 Voice and Tone Decoding Mirror
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 2: Pragmatic Communication and Implicit Social Codes 📌 Field:🗣️ Pragmatic communication

🎭 Joking or Teasing? Listening for Tone and Intent

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Autistic schoolchildren are often unable to recognize irony, joking or ridicule in the tone of voice, and are prone to take a friend's well-intentioned jokes as an attack and punch them, or take malicious ridicule seriously. Teach people how to recognize good-natured jokes by "smiling at the corner of the mouth/gentle eyes/close to the body".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎭 Crooked smile and gentle eyes!

When playing volleyball after class, Yu accidentally missed the ball while serving, and the ball rolled gently to Jia's feet. Jia picked up the ball and said with a smile, "Wow!" Yu, your ball hits a home run, fly to the moon!” Several classmates around him started laughing. Yu's face turned red, and he clenched his fists tightly, shouting: "Why are you laughing at me!" Are you laughing at my stupidity? "Raise your hands to grab the ball." He came over and gently held Yu's shoulders: "Yu, wait!" Please look at Jia's eyes - is she smiling and looking at you tenderly, or is she looking at you sideways? Did she hide the ball from you, or did she hand it to you with both hands? "Yu was stunned for a moment and saw Jia holding the ball in both hands with friendly eyes. Jia quickly said, "I'm sorry, Yu. I was just joking. I'm not saying you are stupid. You are really strong!""Yu unclenched his fist: "So you were playing with me, I thought you were scolding me..."

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When someone says something to you and laughs, how do you tell whether he is having fun with you or laughing at you maliciously?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A colleague's humorous remark on the court leads to a misunderstanding. The four little heroes practice recognizing intonation clues and clearly clarifying the intention!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:If you notice your heart racing and you want to clench your fist, take a deep breath, look at the other person's face, and ask to confirm their intention.
"Jia, you just laughed and said the moon home run. Are you kidding me or laughing at me?"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to actively seek verification through spoken language instead of direct physical attacks.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Assist in observing the situation from the sidelines, and pat Yu on the shoulder to act as a peace mediator.
"Yu, relax!" Jia is praising you for your strength. Our volleyball team needs your strong serve! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to use their sense of justice to resolve interpersonal misunderstandings.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Place the volleyball back into Yu's hands with both hands, with sincere eyes and a gentle, comforting tone.
"Yu is fine, everyone is on the same team, let's catch the ball together!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He use friendly body movements to resolve tense confrontations.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Put your hands together to express apology, immediately explain the original meaning of your humor, and eliminate your peers' unease.
"Yu, I'm sorry!" I spoke too exaggeratedly and misunderstood you. I really think you are very strong and handsome! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to notice the peculiarities of literal interpretation of words by autistic peers and provide timely clarification.

🎯 Super power move visual chart card ⭐ Three steps of mind decoding
1
When you notice the anger that hardens your fist, stop for three seconds.
2
Observe the other person’s eyes (gentle gaze) and corners of the mouth (friendly smile)
3
When unsure, ask directly: "Are you kidding me?"”
🎯 IEP Quantitative Goals & Putt Collaboration & Family Life Behavioral classification tripartite connection

Provide a "good-natured joking vs. malicious teasing" comparison checklist: good-natured (eye gaze, sharing toys, relaxed expression); malicious (rolling eyes, pushing, calling ugly nicknames).
🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)
Use puppetry to perform two different intonations (gentle and brisk vs. harsh), so that school children can identify the difference with their ears.
🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Before you get angry and take action, ask the other person: "Are you kidding me, or are you serious?"” Clarify the intention.

🔒 Privacy Boundary Security Lock

📱 Respecting Privacy: Ask Before Looking

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education children often unzip their peers' schoolbags and read the red letters in their contact books or diaries at will due to their strong curiosity or lack of concept of property rights and privacy boundaries, causing strong resentment among their peers. Guide school children to establish safe boundaries where "other people's personal belongings will never be touched".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🎒 The tightly closed zipper and the little fox’s secret notes!

After class, Jia went to the bathroom. Her pink schoolbag was placed on the chair. The zipper was slightly opened, revealing a beautiful secret diary with a golden unicorn on the cover. When Xiaoji passed by, he became very curious and thought to himself: "Wow!"It's a unicorn diary. I wonder what interesting things are written in it?” Xiaojiu couldn't help but reached out and unzipped the zipper, took out the diary and flipped through it. At this time, Jia walked into the classroom and saw that her diary was opened. She was so angry that she burst into tears. She screamed and rushed forward and pushed Jia away: "Why are you peeking at my things!"Thief! What a nuisance!” Came over seriously: “Jia, your schoolbag and diary are everyone’s private castle. Opening other people's schoolbags or looking through diaries without permission is a very disrespectful and intrusive act!"When Jia saw Jia crying so sadly, she lowered her head in shame. She put the diary back into her school bag and zipped it up with both hands: "I'm sorry, Jia, I'm too curious. I promise never to rummage through other people's things again!" ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you really want to see something interesting in your classmate’s schoolbag, can you just take it out and look through it? Why is respecting other people’s privacy the most important boundary in making friends?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Seeing a beautiful notebook peeking out of a classmate's backpack, the four little heroes practice activating the privacy lock and restraining their voyeuristic desires!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:If you see an open communication book on a classmate's desk, put your hands in your pockets and take a step back to avoid peeking.
"That's Jia's private contact book. I can't read it. I want to protect my friend's privacy castle!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a clear concept of personal and spatial privacy boundaries.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to touch with your hands, put your palms together and bow deeply to Jia to express your apology and promise.
"I'm sorry Jia!"I will never touch the zipper of your schoolbag in the future. I will be a good friend who keeps his word!”
💡 Tips:Guide people to experience the consequences of violating others' boundaries and implement their commitment to respecting boundaries.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Gently walk over and help Jia zip up her schoolbag, then hand her a tissue to comfort her crying classmate.
"Don't cry, Jia. The zipper of your schoolbag is tightened. Your little secrets are safe!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He support peers with specific maintenance behaviors.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Put away your notebook, wipe away your tears, and accept Jun's apology gracefully.
"Thank you for apologizing to me. As long as you promise to ask me first in the future, we will still be good friends!" ”
💡 Tips:After establishing the boundaries of personal privacy, Guidance shows tolerance and the mind to repair relationships.

Do not read other people’s contact book comments and personal diaries

🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Transform curiosity into a positive spoken request: "Your notebook is so beautiful. Can you lend it to me to see the cover after class?"

🤫 Reading the Room: Noticing When Others Need Quiet

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with autism often lack "situational sensitivity" and suddenly talk to themselves loudly, imitate lines from TV commercials, or make strange noises when reading quietly in class or during lunch breaks. Guide the children to look up and observe the expressions of everyone present, and lock the sound into the little drawer of their brains.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
📺 The big TV in your mouth and the quiet lunch break bell!

At 12:30 noon, the soft lunch break bell rang on the campus. The whole class lay down on the table and closed their eyes to sleep. The whole classroom was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop. Yu was lying on the table, but his head was like a movie projector, constantly replaying the Superman cartoon he watched last night! Yu couldn't help but make a sharp dubbing sound with his mouth: "Boom——!" Light wave emission! pound! pound! Defeat the bad guys! "The classmates lying next to them were woken up one by one, holding their heads in annoyance: "Yu is so noisy! Do you want to sleep or not? ” He walked gently to Yu, took out a “Quiet Kitten Paupa card” and placed it on the corner of the table: “Yu, look up and look around - what is the color of the air in the class now? Everyone is closing their eyes to rest. At this time, we have to turn off the big TV in our mouths and switch to brain silent mode to think about Superman!"When Yu saw everyone's tired faces, he quickly shut his mouth. He closed his eyes and watched Superman quietly in his head, and everyone fell asleep comfortably!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When the whole class is sleeping or reading quietly, if you suddenly make a strange noise, what will break it? To "read the air", you need to first look at what the people around you are doing?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:During lunch break and self-study, in a quiet environment, the four little heroes practiced recognizing the group atmosphere and switching to mental silence mode!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:When you realize you have the urge to recite your lines, take a deep breath, close your mouth tightly, and rest your head on the table with your eyes closed.
"It's lunch break now, everyone is sleeping, I want to watch Superman with my brain muted, so as not to disturb everyone!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to convert spoken vocalizations into internal language representations, improving situational acuity.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Gently tuck your feet back into place, which are about to shake and kick the table, and lie down properly with your eyes closed.
"I also want to understand the air!" The whole class was sleeping, so I lay down quietly and acted like a self-disciplined gentleman! ”
💡 Tips:Guide and coordinate with the group rhythm to stabilize the physical and mental state.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Gently draw the curtains to block out the light, quietly walk back to your seat and lie down without making a sound.
"Walk gently, lie down slowly, everyone sleeps soundly, the classroom is so warm!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He maintain the self-disciplined action habits of a peaceful class environment.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Hang a "Lunch Break Silence Red Light" sign in front of the podium to remind the whole class to enter deep rest mode.
"It's charging time for the whole class. Please turn down the generator and enjoy the quiet time!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to use visual symbols to implement group situational routines.
