🚌 Field-Trip Bus Safety: Stay Seated and Ask for Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When the whole school travels on large tour buses for field trips, special education students often become overly excited, chasing and jumping in the aisles, grabbing microphones and shouting, or breaking down in tears due to vestibular motion sickness and vomiting. They are taught to "fasten their seatbelts, quietly look out the window at the scenery, and immediately raise their hands to grab a vomit bag if they feel nauseous."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
⛰️ A wobbly bus and refreshing mint green candy!

Today is the annual autumn off-campus teaching, and the whole school has to take a two-hour tour bus to the Museum of Natural Science! As soon as he got in the car, Jia was so excited that he unbuckled his seat belt and jumped up and down on the narrow aisle, shouting: "Go!" Let’s see who gets the big sofa in the last row first! "As soon as the car started to turn, Jia lost his center of gravity and fell to the ground, his forehead almost hitting the iron railing. He came over and helped Jia up, and said seriously: "The car is running and jumping in the aisle when it starts. As long as the driver makes an emergency stop, the whole person will fly out like a missile. It is very dangerous!"” Help Xiaojiu fasten the two-point safety belt around his waist with a click. At this time, He, who was sitting by the window, turned pale because of the shaking of the car, holding his stomach and wanting to vomit. When Jia saw it, he immediately took out a plastic vomit bag from the storage bag in front of the seat, raised his hand and shouted: "Report, He is a little motion sick and nauseated!" ” He quickly handed over the mint candy and turned the air-conditioning outlet to He’s forehead. He looked at the calm mountains outside the window with a cold candy in his mouth. His stomach gradually stopped churning. Everyone arrived at the Science Museum safely and happily!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What terrible dangers might occur if you unbuckle your seatbelt and run around on a moving tour bus? What should you do if you feel dizzy and nauseous while riding in a vehicle?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The school field trip begins, and the four little heroes practice fastening their seatbelts, maintaining good manners while riding, and looking after each other!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Once you get in the car, fasten your seatbelt, put on your earmuffs, and quietly watch the road scenery outside the window without making any noise.
"The seat belt is buckled!"Wearing earmuffs and looking at the big trees outside is like watching a movie. It’s so fun! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to use sensory protection independently to regulate his mood in a remote closed vehicle.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to run in the aisle, sit up straight, fasten your seatbelt, and quietly drink water from your water bottle.
"Huh~ Safety first!" I fastened my seat belt and sat down like a handsome little passenger who obeyed traffic regulations! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance is given to converge excess energy within the standardized framework to ensure one's own safety in riding a car.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:If you feel dizzy and nauseous, immediately raise your hand to express it, take a deep breath, suck on a mint, and look at the distant mountains.
"Looking at the green mountains in the distance, taking a deep breath, holding the cool candy in my mouth, my stomach feels much better!"”
💡 Tips:Help He timely detect physiological motion sickness warning signs and implement self-care.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Help check if your group members' seat belts are fastened, and promptly fetch cleaning bags for those who are motion sick.
"He, take this clean plastic bag, lean your head on the back of the chair and close your eyes. I'll be with you next to you!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to show the spirit of a general who helps each other and cares for each other during group travel.

🫑 Bravely take a bite of a little adventure
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 5: Special Situations and Environmental Adaptation 📌 Field:🏫 Environmental adaptation
🎖️ Today’s Badge: Nutritionally Balanced Food God

🍽️ Foods I Dislike: Polite Choices at Lunch

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with autism often exhibit extremely severe selective eating based on food texture and smell. When faced with green peppers, eggplants, or onions, they may slam their fists on the table, vomit, yell "Disgusting!", or even overturn their plates. They should be taught to politely ask for a smaller portion, bravely take a bite, and refrain from expressing disgust.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🫑 The little green hat and a brave little adventure!

The third dish of today's nutritious lunch is "Stir-fried Shredded Pork with Colorful Peppers". When serving food, the classmate in charge of serving food gave Yu a large spoonful of green and red peppers. As soon as Yu smelled the unique bitter grassy smell of green peppers, his brows knitted and his stomach was filled with butterflies. He almost knocked the lunch box over on the spot and shouted, "It stinks!" So disgusting! poisonous! I definitely don't want to eat it! ” The classmate who was serving the food next to me looked very ugly when he heard this: "The kitchen worker aunt worked hard to fry this, why are you calling other people's food disgusting!" ” Came over and touched Yu’s back gently: “Yu, food is just like people, everyone likes different tastes. You may not like green peppers, but shouting "It's disgusting" in front of everyone will make the cooks and people who like to eat them feel very sad. Our dining superpower is - "Just politely ask your classmates for a small slice", and give yourself an adventure opportunity to "bravely take a small bite"!"He helped Yu take out more than half of it, leaving only a small piece of red bell pepper. Yu took a deep breath, closed his eyes and took a small bite. After chewing, he realized: "Huh?" It's sweet and crunchy, and it doesn't seem to be as bitter as I thought! "Yu finished eating that small piece, and the whole class applauded his courage!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What are the negative consequences of yelling "Disgusting!" in front of everyone when there's a dish you don't like in your lunchbox? How can you politely tell the student serving the food without wasting food?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The four little heroes encountered green peppers as a dish they disliked during their school lunch. They practiced restraining their disgusted expressions, politely reducing their portion size, and bravely trying it!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to scream and feel nauseous, close your eyes, take a small bite of the bell pepper, chew it, and swallow it.
"I don't say bad words, I took a small bite and my brain was upgraded!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to break through food texture defenses and take small steps towards success in trying new things.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Eat all the vegetables in the bento box with big bites and enthusiastically encourage the picky eaters next to you.
"The fried shredded pork with green pepper is very fragrant! Eat more vegetables and you will grow as tall and strong as me! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the class to use the power of positive role models to promote a healthy eating atmosphere in the class.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Put your hands together and bow politely to the student serving the food, clearly expressing your request for a smaller portion.
"Thank you for helping me prepare the food. Please help me take a small slice to taste. Thank you!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He use elegant spoken language and politeness to maintain personal dietary boundaries.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Keep the tabletop clean and remind everyone to put bones and scraps into the recycling bin after eating.
"Whether you like it or not, the table must be wiped clean. Thank you to the kitchen worker for her hard work!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to maintain table hygiene routines and show gratitude and cherish blessings.

1
Upon realizing the aversion to unpleasant food, I immediately swallowed the word "disgusting."
2
When serving food, hold the plate with both hands and politely say, 'Please just give me a little bit, thank you!'
3
Give yourself the courage to take a small bite, and even if you don't like it, quietly leave it in the corner of your plate without spitting it out.

🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)
Utilize "micro-dose desensitization method": from licking, taking a small bite to eating a piece, gradually expand the eating experience.
🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Before you want to overturn your plate in protest, put your chopsticks down, put your hands flat on the table and take three deep breaths.

🎲 Rainy Day Fun Box
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 5: Special Situations and Environmental Adaptation 📌 Field:🏫 Environmental adaptation
🎖️ Today’s badge: A little expert on how to deal with rainy days

🌧️ Heavy Rain: Choosing a Quiet Indoor Activity

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When it rains, the playground becomes muddy and closed. Special education students who are used to running and playing ball on the playground often become restless in the classroom, frantically sliding on bases in the corridor, or banging on doors and making noise. We guide the students to activate the "Rainy Day Indoor Fun Box" and learn to look at picture books, do puzzles, and play two-player static board games to calm their minds and bodies.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌧️ The big raindrops outside the window and the 3D Rubik's Cube on the table!

At two o'clock in the afternoon, violent northwest rain fell in the sky, and the playground has turned into a large ocean. The Academic Affairs Office broadcast: "Attention to all students in the school, the playground is completely closed this afternoon. Please do not go outdoors after class!" ” Xiaojiu, who usually rushed to the playground to play basketball after every get out of class, looked like a little cheetah in a cage, stamping his feet back and forth in the corridor anxiously: "What are you going to do if you can't play basketball!" I am bored! So boring! "Xiaojiu grabbed the basketball and started dribbling and hitting it vigorously in the corridor of the classroom. The deafening "pounds!"pound! pound!” The noise was so loud that the class next door came out to protest. He came over and gently took away the basketball, and took out a glittering "Rainy Day Indoor Treasure Box" from the cabinet: "Xiaojiu, it's raining heavily outside, it's the best time to upgrade your brain!" The box contains a three-dimensional maze ball, a hundred-piece jigsaw puzzle, and a four-bang game for two people. Do you want to play the next "four-bang showdown"? ”Xiaojiao looked at the exquisite four-piece chessboard and sat down curiously. For fifteen minutes, Xiaojiu concentrated on staring at the chessboard and thinking about the layout. While listening to the patter of rain outside the window, he felt extremely calm: "It turns out that playing chess in the classroom on a rainy day is more fun than playing ball!" ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What dangers and noise would it cause to dribble a basketball wildly in the hallway when it's raining heavily and we can't go to the playground? What static games can we play in the classroom to make our brains smarter?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill

🎬 Action:I walked to the book corner, picked out a thick encyclopedia of the universe, and sat on a comfortable cushion to read it attentively.
"Listening to the sound of rain outside and looking at the map of the universe and galaxies, the classroom is so quiet, I feel very relaxed! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to enjoy high-quality static reading time.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Put the basketball into the bag and put it away. Sit at the table and play a game of Connect Four with your friends. Do not run around in the hallway dribbling the ball.
"Phew~ I won't shoot the ball!" Look at my line defense, playing chess requires more brainpower than playing basketball! ”
💡 Tips:The guide transfers the strong competitive spirit to the static chess and puzzle showdown.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Take out a box of colored pencils and carefully fill in the color of the mandala drawing paper on a rainy day, stroke by stroke.
"After painting this colorful flower, my mood is as beautiful as seeing a rainbow after the rain!"”
💡 Tips:Help He use artistic creation to soothe emotions and improve concentration and persistence.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Help everyone distribute chessboards and pieces in the board game area, and remind everyone to put them back in their original place after playing.
"Everyone picks a board game on a rainy day. Remember to put the chess pieces back into the box after playing!"”
💡 Tips:Guide and maintain the order of indoor activity areas and the storage of teaching aids.

1
Accept the fact that it's raining, take a deep breath and tell yourself: "Rainy days are peaceful and beautiful days."
2
Go to the classroom book corner or board game cabinet, choose a static item you like
3
Sit quietly and immerse yourself in the moment for thirty minutes, enjoying the peaceful time in the rain.

Prepare board games with simple and intuitive rules (such as Kuaishou cup stacking, Tower of Babel building blocks, and four-piece chess) to lower the threshold of written rules.

🧽 Little hero of spring cleaning
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 5: Special Situations and Environmental Adaptation 📌 Field:🏫 Environmental adaptation
🎖️ Today’s badge: Clean and environmentally friendly little guard

🧹 Cleanup Teamwork: Helping Safely and Taking Pride in Our Work

🎯 Summary of core objectives:At the end of each semester, during the school-wide cleaning, special education students often run away or slack off due to tactile aversion to the blackened washbasins, moss-covered ditches, and dirty buckets, or get overly excited and splash water everywhere with hoses, soaking their classmates. The school teaches students to "divide tasks for washing, use water safely, and remember that labor is honorable."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧼 A sparkling handwashing station and a cleaning agent in rain boots!

This afternoon is the "year-end cleaning" time for OO Elementary School once in the whole semester! The special education class is responsible for cleaning the central sink and leaf drains in the entire special education building. The ditches were filled with black and sticky dead leaves, and green moss grew in the gaps between the tiles on the sink. As soon as he saw the black mud, He flinched far away and waved his little hand: "It's so dirty!"So disgusting! I don’t want to touch!” Xiaojiu, who was responsible for holding the long water pipe, was overly excited. He grabbed the water pipe and turned on the water jet to the maximum. He said in the corridor, “Wow——!”"It was like a fire truck, it was everywhere, and Yu's pants and shoes were almost soaked in water!" He came over and turned off the faucet: "Everyone, pause!" Spring cleaning is a magical "battle of renewal", not a water fight! As long as everyone puts on rain boots and waterproof gloves, we will be the cleaning agents to defeat the dirty monster! ”Assigned tasks: He is responsible for wearing gloves and holding long clips to pick up fallen leaves, Xiaozuo is responsible for brushing the cracks of the tiles with a hard brush, Yu is responsible for scraping away the dirty water on the ground with a wiper, and Jia is responsible for checking every corner. Four people worked together to scrub for half an hour, and the originally black sink tiles became as shiny as a mirror! Everyone looked at the sink that was as white as new and felt filled with a huge sense of accomplishment!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If everyone is diligently scrubbing during a big clean-up, but you're just spraying water everywhere with a hose, what dangers might that pose? How would you feel if you personally cleaned a dirty and messy environment until it was sparkling clean?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:The whole school is cleaning and washing the handwashing stations and public areas. Four little heroes practice dividing tasks and cooperating, using water safely and not playing around!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Hold the long-handled squeegee firmly with both hands and push the water in the corridor smoothly towards the drain hole step by step, so that the floor dries quickly.
"Scrape all the water into the drainage holes, and the floor will be dry, so you won't slip when you walk!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to gain a high degree of concentration and control in regular and repetitive tool operations.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Wear an apron and squat by the ditch. Use your hands to scrub the moss back and forth with a steel brush, and restrain the urge to play in the water.
"Hoo~ look at my powerful Vajra brush!" Brush all the black moss away and the sink becomes super white! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance is given to convert excess physical energy into a positive force for high-intensity cleaning work.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Wearing thick gloves and holding long stainless steel tongs, carefully tuck each fallen leaf blocking the ditch into the dustpan.
"Wear gloves and you won't have to worry about dirty hands!" Clamp the fallen leaves cleanly and the water will flow smoothly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He eliminate tactile fear through protective assistive devices and actively participate in public services.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Be responsible for mixing the environmentally friendly cleaning agent on the side and pour an appropriate amount onto the tiles to ensure safe use.
"Pour three drops of eco-friendly orange water, it is fragrant and removes stains, and it saves effort for everyone to brush!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to take on the detailed responsibilities of cleaning materials management.

Teacher Lesson Preparation Manual 💡 Inspiration Library Lesson 87 💡 Flexibility topic
🛑 Strangers' Red Line Brakes
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 5: Special Situations and Environmental Adaptation 📌 Field:🏫 Environmental adaptation
🎖️ Today’s badge: Self-protection little guard

🚶 Stranger Safety: Do Not Go Along or Get into a Car

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education children are often naive and lack vigilance towards strangers, or are easily attracted by candy, Pokémon cards, or cute puppies. When a stranger in a car asks for directions and says, "Little one, get in the car and I'll buy you a drink," they readily get in. They should be taught the safety red lines: "Take three steps back, loudly refuse, and run to a convenience store for help."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚗 A black sedan with its windows rolled down and a gleaming convenience store door!

Walking on the school trail home after school, a black car suddenly stopped slowly on the side of the road, and the window slowly rolled down. Sitting in the car was a strange man wearing sunglasses with a big smile on his face. He was holding a shiny limited edition Pokémon card pack and a kitten stuffed animal in his hand: "Hello, kid!" My uncle is lost at OO Elementary School. Can you get in the car and sit in the front seat to help him show the way? This complete set of Charizard card holder and cute kitten are given to you as a thank you gift!” Xiaojiu's eyes lit up instantly when he saw the rare Pokémon card. He couldn't help but walk towards the car door, reaching out to pick up the card package! Yu, who was walking nearby, saw it, and alarm bells immediately went off in his mind! Yu remembered the "stranger red line braking" drill in the classroom. He rushed forward and grabbed Xiaojiu's schoolbag strap and shouted: "Xiaojiu, stop!"Absolutely no getting on the bus!” Yu pulled Xiaojiu and immediately took three steps back, shouting out the car window: “We don’t know! We are looking for the police uncle!"After that, Yu and Xiaojiu picked up their schoolbags and rushed into the brightly lit "FamilyMart" at the intersection as quickly as possible without looking back. They loudly asked the clerk aunt for help: "Auntie! Strangers outside asked us to get in the car!”The clerk’s aunt immediately protected them behind the cashier and called the police. When the black car saw that something was wrong, it was so frightened that it stepped on the accelerator and ran away! He rushed to the supermarket with the police, hugged the two children tightly and praised: "Yu and Xiaojiu reacted so smartly!"You have successfully protected your lives!”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When a stranger on the street offers you a fun toy or delicious snack and asks you to get in their car and show them the way, can you trust them? Why should you never get in their car no matter what they say?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:On their way home from school, four little heroes are approached by a stranger in a car who offers them gifts. They practice activating the safety red line, resisting the temptation, and running to the safety checkpoint!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:When you see your peers about to be tempted, grab Jun's backpack strap, shout loudly, and lead the way to the convenience store for help.
"Xiaojiu, retreat quickly!" Never get into a stranger's car! We immediately ran to FamilyMart to find the clerk! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to demonstrate precise vigilance and judgment and the courage to rescue his peers in highly crisis situations.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man

🏫 Returning to the General Classroom: Finding My Group and Joining In

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education children, accustomed to the protection of small classes of one to four in disengagement special education classes, often feel lost and stand blankly at the door when the bell rings to return to a regular class of thirty students. This is because the classroom is noisy, they cannot find their seats, or they have missed the progress. We teach them the transition method of "looking at the blackboard homework before entering the classroom, smiling and nodding to the neighbor when walking to their seats".

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚪 Two large doors and a green pass for traveling through time!

The end of get out of class bell rang. Yu, who had finished two classes in the special education classroom, packed his schoolbag and prepared to walk back to the general classroom of Class 2, Fourth Year. When he reached the door of the large classroom, Yu stopped and looked at the thirty classmates inside, laughing loudly and walking around. The blackboard was filled with densely packed homework for Mandarin Language Lesson 7. Yu suddenly felt an unfamiliar panic in his heart. He clutched the strap of his schoolbag tightly with both hands and froze at the door like an outsider, daring not to go in. At this time, a "seamless connection card" was placed in Yu's pocket: "Yu, ordinary class is your big stage!"Do three things when you walk in: first, look up at the blackboard to see what class this is; second, go to your seat and gently pull the chair open; third, smile at your classmates and say "I'm back"!”Yu took a deep breath and walked into the classroom. He pulled up his chair, turned around and smiled at his classmate Xiao Ming and said, "Xiao Ming, I'm back. Which book should I take now?""Xiao Ming smiled and pointed at the blackboard: "Yu, you are back! Hurry up and grab the new word book A, we are about to start writing!”Yu quickly took out the first book and smoothly kept up with the rhythm of the class!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When returning to a regular class from a special education class, if you stand at the door in fear and space out, will you be able to keep up with the rest of the class? What three things should you do upon entering the classroom to quickly integrate into a larger class?

🎬 Action:Enter the regular classroom, look up at the blackboard to confirm the Chinese Language A textbook, quietly return to your seat, take out your textbook and turn to the designated page.
"Xiao Ming, I'm back!"I've already taken out Book A and turned to page 10, and I'm ready to write together!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a highly independent ability to switch tasks back to work.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:When you return to the regular classroom, restrain your impulse to make loud noises, neatly put away your stationery, and sit up straight.
"Huh ~ back to the big class, I will sit down according to the class rules and be a good model student who listens carefully to the class! ”
💡 Tips:Guide students to regard the large class environment as a good stage for demonstrating maturity and self-discipline.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Smile and greet your deskmate, take out your pencil case, and read aloud with the whole class.
"Good morning, everyone!"I read the text aloud with everyone, the voice was clear and loud!”
💡 Tips:Help He actively integrate into large group learning activities to enhance the sense of belonging to the class.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Actively help the group leader carry out classroom exercise sheets, demonstrating a proactive and enthusiastic attitude towards class service.
"Group leader, I'm here to help distribute exercise sheets!" Everyone has one piece each, our group is ready! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jiayi's class service role to quickly integrate into the ordinary class organizational structure.

👦 My Learning Support Classroom: A Place to Recharge My Strengths

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When faced with curious questions from their classmates in regular classes, such as, "Are you stupid for going to the gifted class?", special education students often feel ashamed, lower their heads and cry, or become angry and hit others. Instead, teach them, "That's my superpower charging station! I practice emotional braking and reading magic there!" This fosters a confident and positive response.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🔋 Superman cape and shiny badges in the secret base!

When eating lunch at lunch, a regular classmate sitting in the back row looked at He curiously and asked: "He, why are you not in the classroom every Tuesday and Thursday and go to the study classroom at the bottom of the corridor on the second floor?" Is that a place for idiots? ” This sentence hit He's heart like a sap. He's eyes turned red instantly. He was so sad that he lowered his head to the lunch box. The spoon in his hand was shaking. He really wanted to run away on the spot. At this time, Xiao Qiu, who was sitting next to him, said, "Shua!" ” He stood up, puffed out his chest and said loudly: “That’s not true! There is the strongest "Superman Charging Base" in the school! We learned there how to put on the emotional brake, how to be masters of communication, and they also taught us super powerful memory magic!"He looked at the brave Xiaozuo, took a deep breath, wiped away his tears, slowly raised his head, looked into the classmate's eyes and smiled and said, "Yes! I practiced there to repair the Chinese character dance brain, and now I recognize twice as many new characters as before! If you don’t know how to do emotional magic, I can also teach you!"The classmate opened his eyes in admiration after hearing this: "Wow! Sounds so cool! I really want to recharge it too!”The big stone in He's heart disappeared, replaced by full of pride!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When others ask you why you go to the special education learning room, will crying out of inferiority or throwing a tantrum to eliminate prejudice? Confidently talk about the superpowers you learned in the learning room, and why that's the best way to win others' admiration?

"That's the Superman base!" Now I can count to ten when I'm angry, that's the special power I developed there! ”

🏠 Taking Turns with Siblings: Sharing Screens Fairly

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education students often get so fixated on the cartoons or games they want to watch that they fight fiercely with their younger siblings over remote controls or tablets, sometimes even scratching or biting each other, causing family conflicts. Guiding students to use physical timers and turn-taking agreements can help them learn to share generously.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
📺 Black remote control tug-of-war and colorful timer hourglass!

After returning home from school, as soon as Xiaojiu dropped his schoolbag, he rushed to the sofa in the living room and picked up the remote control to turn the channel to watch his favorite beetle cartoon. His sister, who was just two years younger than him, also ran over and grabbed the other end of the remote control and yelled: "This time, let me watch Peppa Pig!" You let go! ” The two people were pulling hard on the sofa like a tug of war, and the battery cover of the remote control was torn off to the ground. Jia was so angry that the veins on his forehead were exposed. He raised his hand and was about to hit his sister on the arm: "I am the elder brother!"Get out of my way!"My mother heard shouting in the kitchen: "Jia! stop!"The "Friendship Piggy Bank" that I taught Jia suddenly popped into Jia's mind - if you hit your sister, ten gold coins will be deducted! Xiaojiu took a deep breath, retracted his fist, took out the "Thirty-minute liquid color timing hourglass" issued by the special education class from his school bag and placed it in the center of the TV cabinet: "Sister, let's not grab it!" The hourglass is placed in the middle. You watch Peppa Pig for twenty minutes first. When the hourglass is finished, I watch the beetle. No one is allowed to cheat! "When my sister saw her brother being reasonable, she wiped away her tears and nodded: "Okay! Brother, please help me turn on the TV first! ”A family war turned into a harmonious brother and sister time in the ticking of the hourglass!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How sad would it make your parents if you fought with your younger siblings over the TV or tablet at home? Why can taking turns using a timer make you a more likable older brother or sister?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:At home, the four little heroes practice starting the timer hourglass and negotiating to take turns not fighting over the TV remote control with their siblings!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Take out the tablet timer on the living room sofa, set a countdown, and quietly wait for your younger brother to finish watching an episode of the cartoon.
"The time is set!" My brother will watch for fifteen minutes first. When the time is up, he will beep and then let me play!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to apply strict time rules to family sibling relationship mediation.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Pull back your fist that you want to punch, place the remote control flat in the middle of the table, and generously let your sister watch the first episode.
"Hoo~ I'm a man!" Sister, if you are young, you choose first. When the hourglass is finished, remember to watch it for me!”
💡 Tips:Guide parents to transform their impulses into caring for their younger brothers and sisters, and improve their self-esteem and self-discipline.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Actively pour a glass of juice for your younger sister, sit next to her and watch Peppa Pig cartoons together, and enjoy the companionship of your sibling.
"It's fun to watch TV together!"Sister, it’s so funny to see Peppa Pig jumping in the mud pit!”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the brotherly warmth of companionship and communion, and resolve the sense of competition and opposition.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Post a family-shared schedule on the refrigerator, clearly indicating each person's designated entertainment time.
"We put the name and time on the refrigerator, one time per person, everyone is fair!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to extend structured life routines into daily family management.

👵 Visiting Grandparents: Greetings and Helping at Mealtimes

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When visiting elders' homes during holidays, special education students often hide in their rooms scrolling on their phones, ignoring everyone, or even slamming doors and shouting when elders try to comfort them. The school teaches students the proper etiquette of "looking into the eyes of grandparents and greeting them loudly, serving tea with both hands, and setting the table before meals."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🍵 Fragrant oolong tea and four neatly arranged pairs of mahogany chopsticks!

The whole family drove back to the countryside to celebrate the holidays at my grandparents’ house on the weekend. As soon as I walked through the door, the living room was filled with uncles, aunts, and cousins ​​I hadn't seen for a long time. When Yu saw so many relatives, his social anxiety suddenly broke out. Holding his schoolbag, he wanted to rush into the living room on the second floor to hide and play video games. When grandpa saw Yu, he smiled and came over with a cane and touched Yu's head: "Yu has grown so tall!"Good grandson!” Yu wanted to throw away his grandfather’s hand and shout: “Don’t touch me!”So annoying! ’ But Yu remembered the story he told – my grandparents were old and couldn’t see clearly, so they waited at the door every day for their grandson to come home to see them. Yu took a deep breath, stopped and turned around, looking gently at Grandpa's eyes under his white hair. He handed a cup of hot oolong tea with both hands and shouted: "Grandpa and Grandma, I'm back to see you!" I wish you good health and a long life! "Then before the meal started, Yu took the initiative to go to the kitchen to help arrange the four pairs of mahogany chopsticks neatly. Grandpa smiled from ear to ear, with tears in his eyes: "Oh! Our Yu is sensible and filial, and is the best grandson in the family! ”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you stay in your room scrolling on your phone and ignore everyone when you visit your grandparents, how disappointed will they be? How much warmer will they feel if you hold a cup of tea with both hands and greet them loudly?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A family reunion to visit grandparents. The four little heroes practice looking at the elders, greeting them, and taking the initiative to serve tea and set the table!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to hide in the room, look into the eyes of your grandparents, greet them loudly and kindly, and offer them tea with both hands.
"Good morning, grandpa and grandma!" I am Yu. I made hot oolong tea for you to drink. I wish you good health! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to break through social anxiety in cross-generational family situations and convey warm family affection.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Quickly move out the sturdiest chair with the backrest for Grandpa and help him sit down.
"Grandpa, sit down slowly!" I am Jia, I am very strong, let me carry all the heavy things! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the government to devote full energy to the entity labor service of filial piety and respect for the elderly.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Carefully arrange the red chopsticks and small spoons for the elders at the dining table, making sure they are neatly and properly arranged.
"Grandpa and grandma, please sit down. The dishes and chopsticks have been set out for you. The food cooked in the kitchen today is so delicious!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He develop meticulous and considerate qualities, and implement filial piety services in family life.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Sit next to your elders and generously share the excellent awards you received at school, making them laugh heartily.
"Look, grandma, this is my certificate from the school theater performance. I specially brought it back to you to see!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to take the initiative to enhance the emotional connection between family generations through positive achievements.

🛒 Create your own guardian while shopping at the supermarket
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 6: Putian Fusion and Family Life 📌 Field:🏠 Fusion family
🎖️ Today’s badge: Storekeeper who abides by rules in the store

🛒 Shopping with Family: Stay Together and Ask Staff for Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Walking into a supermarket filled with a dazzling array of goods, special education children often run wildly between the shelves, secretly stuff cookies and toys into their shopping carts, or throw tantrums and cry on the floor because they didn't get their favorite snacks, and some even get lost. They are taught to "hold onto the shopping cart without letting go, choose items according to the shopping list, and if they get lost, find a uniformed store clerk."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🛒 A huge shopping cart full of items and checkmarks on the list!

On Saturday afternoon, Xiaojiu accompanied her mother to the Quanlian Welfare Center for a large purchase. As soon as he walked into the store, he saw three rows of colorful potato chips and chocolate bars. His eyes lit up with excitement. He grabbed three extra large bags of potato chips and was about to stuff them into his mother's shopping cart! Mom held down the cart seriously: "Jia, what we want to buy today are onions and tofu for dinner soup. We can't buy random snacks!""When Jia heard that he couldn't buy it, his temper suddenly rose. He sat down on the ground and hugged the wheels of the cart, shouting: "I don't care! I want to eat potato chips! If you don’t buy it, I won’t go home!”Aunts and uncles shopping around stopped and looked over. At this time, the "Shopping Spy List" taught in the special education class flashed in Jia's mind - noisy children will lose the qualification to be a housekeeper! Xiaojiu took a deep breath, got up from the ground and patted his pants. Mom handed over a hand-drawn "purchasing list card" and a pencil: "Xiaojiu, you will be our commander-in-chief!"Help your mother find three onions in the vegetable section. If you find them all, you can choose a box of yogurt as a reward!”Xiaojiu took the list, pushed the cart and focused on comparing the onions. Every time he found one, he put a big check mark. He successfully completed the task and got a box of his favorite strawberry yogurt!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How embarrassing would it be if you threw a tantrum and cried on the floor at the supermarket because you weren't satisfied? Why can helping your mom find things according to the list make you a great little shopping expert?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill

🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Hold the stroller handles firmly with both hands and walk beside your mother. Use the photos on your phone to help find the whole milk on the shelf.
"Hold the cart with both hands and don't let go!"I found the fresh milk on the refrigerator, the date is the latest!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to focus on specific assigned goals in a stimulus-rich store environment.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to lie down and cry, pat your pants and stand up, and carefully help your mother choose three plump onions.
"Huh ~ I shouldn't cheat on you! I am the purchasing commander, and I tick every item I find!”
💡 Tips:Guide the transfer of frustration and anger into goal-directed responsibility taking.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Gently place the fragile egg carton into the front seat of the trolley with both hands, carefully protecting the food.
"The eggs should be picked up and placed gently. If you put them on top, they won't be crushed!"”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the care and sense of accomplishment in handling daily life affairs.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Help the cashier by taking the items from the cart onto the conveyor belt in order and politely thank the cashier.
"Hello, aunt, there are seven items in total. Please help me brush the vehicle during checkout. Thank you!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to implement civilized and polite practices in real social life situations.

🌙 Goodnight Shutdown Sleep Exercise
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 6: Putian Fusion and Family Life 📌 Field:🏠 Fusion family
🎖️ Today’s badge: small model of quality sleep

💤 Bedtime Routines: Putting Books Away and Settling Down

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education students often become so engrossed in comics or mobile games that their vestibular and nervous systems are overstimulated, leading them to refuse to go to bed until 11 p.m., creating a vicious cycle of difficulty waking up in the morning, irritability, and drowsiness in class. We teach them a 30-minute offline ritual before bedtime and deep relaxation breathing.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌙 A little magic trick for turning off your brain's screen when the moon rises!

At nine-thirty in the evening, the alarm clock pointer has pointed to the sleep time. My mother opened the door and gently reminded: "Yu, it's nine-thirty. It's time to turn off the lights and go to bed. We have to go to school tomorrow!""But Yu was holding the most exciting dinosaur comic finale in his hands. His eyes were bright and his heart was beating wildly. He couldn't bear to put it down! "I don't want to sleep!" I still want to read the last ten pages! Give me five more minutes! Ten minutes passed, and Yu was still watching. His mother came over and turned off the headlights. Yu threw the pillow against the wall in anger and yelled on the bed in anger. The "magical magic before going to bed" written to Yu in the contact book suddenly appeared in front of Yu's eyes - sleep is like charging a mobile phone. If you don't turn it off and charge it, your mobile phone will become useless tomorrow! Yu took a deep breath, put the comic back on the bookshelf, got into the warm quilt, and put his hands flat on his stomach: "Inhale~ one, two, three, your belly will swell like a big balloon;exhale~ three, two, one, your body will relax like sinking into a soft marshmallow..." Slowly, Yu's eyelids became heavier and heavier. In a sweet dream, he rode a gentle brontosaurus and flew into the starry sky!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you stay up all night reading or playing games when it's bedtime, what will happen to your brain the next day? Why does turning off the screen and books and taking deep breaths before bed help you have sweet dreams?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:It's bedtime, and the four little heroes practice resisting the temptation to stay up late and completing their pre-sleep shutdown ritual to fall asleep peacefully!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Put the comic books away on the bookshelf at 9:30 sharp, lie in bed and do deep abdominal breathing, then quietly close your eyes.
"Put the book back on the shelf, take a deep breath and exhale, your brain is about to shut down and recharge. Good night everyone!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a regular sleep ritual and overcome excessive attachment to special interests.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to peek at the TV, turn off the main lights in the room, and lie down quietly to sleep while hugging your plush toy.
"Phew~ I have to run in physical education class tomorrow. I have slept well now so that I can be a running champion tomorrow!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to consider adequate sleep as a key self-discipline element in achieving personal exercise goals.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Drink half a cup of warm water under a soft night light, listen to gentle crystal music, relax all your muscles and fall asleep.
"Listen to the music and relax your shoulders. I learned a lot of superpowers at school today. I'm going to explore in my dreams!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He use auditory soothing techniques to overcome nighttime separation or dark anxiety.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Before going to bed, organize your schoolbag and uniform for tomorrow and hang them on the back of your chair, then lie down and rest peacefully.
"My schoolbags and uniforms are all ready. I won't be in a hurry tomorrow morning. I can have a sweet dream with peace of mind!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to establish a stable and orderly psychological state for going to bed through pre-preparation.

2

🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)

👕 A Little Expert at Independent Living
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 6: Putian Fusion and Family Life 📌 Field:🏠 Fusion family
🎖️ Today’s badge: Little housekeeper of independent life

🧺 I Can Help at Home: Folding Clothes and Tidying Toys

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special needs children often rely excessively on their parents for chores at home. Smelly socks are left scattered in the living room, and building blocks are strewn all over the hallway, leaving parents exhausted and experiencing parental burnout. Teaching them the "clothes-folding mantra: hug to the left, hug to the right, bow upwards" helps them develop self-care skills and give back to their families.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧺 A mountain of messy clothes and the amazing magic of folding clothes!

On Sunday afternoon, the clothes dried on the balcony were put into the living room, and there was a pile of clothes as high as a hill on the sofa. Mom had just finished cooking lunch and was so tired that she sat on a chair and rubbed her sore waist. He usually takes off his coat and throws it on the ground. He never puts away his toys after playing with them. The room feels like it has been blown up by a bomb. But today, when He saw his mother's tired white hair, he suddenly felt very distressed. He remembered the "Magic Clothes Folding Technique" taught in the special education class! He ran forward and said with a smile: "Mom, please go to the sofa to rest and drink water. Leave all the clothes to me to collect today!""He took out a T-shirt and spread it flat on the coffee table, chanting a mantra: "The first step, hug with your left hand; the second step, hug with your right hand; the third step, put your hands together and bow upward!”In just ten seconds, a piece of soft clothes was folded into a square little tofu piece! He folded the whole family's clothes neatly and put them into baskets in one breath. Mom was so moved that her eyes filled with tears, and she hugged He tightly: "My baby has really grown up, and he is mom's most caring little helper!"”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If your mom has to tidy up your clothes and toys at home, how tidy is it for her? Why is learning to fold clothes and put toys away neatly a sign of growing up?

"The pants are folded flat twice and arranged like a small building block. The drawer looks so comfortable! ”

🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Pack the LEGO bricks scattered on the living room floor into the toy box, close the lid, and push it back into the corner.
"Return the toys to their original places after playing with them!" The floor in the living room is clean, no one will step on it and get pain when walking! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the team to establish a sense of responsibility for the completion of activities from beginning to end.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:While chanting the mantra "hug left, hug right," skillfully fold all the family's clothes into neat little tofu squares.
"Hug left, hug right, bow upward!" I learned how to fold clothes, and my mother can rest for ten more minutes! ”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the sense of filial achievement of caring for parents through specific housework.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Wipe the coffee table until it's spotless, and help sort the folded clothes by family member and put them into the room.
"Put dad's in this pile, mom in that pile, everyone has clean and neat clothes to wear!" ”
💡 Tips:Guidance Jia demonstrates excellent classification and organization distribution abilities in family life.

💎 Unique Glowing Crystal
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Confident and shining true hero

🪞 My Unique Strengths: Three Things That Make Me Shine

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special needs children often suffer from self-loathing and low self-esteem due to their gait, wearing thick glasses, or slow reaction time, enduring countless stares and judgments. Guiding children to stand in front of a large mirror, identify and loudly proclaim three shining qualities within themselves, helps them embrace their unique selves.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🪞 A magical dressing mirror with three golden, glowing stars!

Today, in the middle of the special education classroom, a full-length mirror with a golden frame was erected. A sparkling five-pointed star was hung on the top of the mirror: "Children, in front of the mirror, we should not pick on our shortcomings. We are going to have the most magical adventure of "discovering luminous gems"! ” The four little heroes stood in front of the big mirror. At first, everyone was a little shy and lowered their heads, not daring to look in the mirror. He touched his short stature and whispered: "I don't think I'm pretty enough, and I can't run fast..." He gently held He's hand and pointed to He's big clear eyes in the mirror: "He, look at yourself in the mirror!" The first gem: you have a pair of gentle eyes that can see the sadness of others; the second gem: you have a pair of skillful hands that can fold clothes neatly; the third gem: you have a kind heart that never laughs at others! These gems are more precious than the stars in the sky! ”He looked at himself in the mirror, and his eyes gradually became brighter. Yu, Jia and Jia also stepped forward one by one and loudly spoke out their shining points! The mirror reflected four smiling faces full of confidence and strength, shining in the sun!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you feel inferior to others or dislike yourself, how sad do you feel? Look in the mirror, find three of your strengths, and read them aloud. Why do they give you so much courage?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Standing in front of a large mirror, the four little heroes explore their inner treasures, practice accepting themselves, and loudly proclaim their personal shining points!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Stand tall and look directly at yourself in the mirror, with your arms hanging naturally at your sides. Read aloud three of your strengths.
"I remember the names of dinosaurs in the whole universe, I am very trustworthy, I can read quietly, I am a great Yu!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to reconstruct special education traits into personal unique talents and establish and improve self-dignity.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Pose in front of the mirror like a bodybuilder, showing off a bright and sunny smile.
"I run as fast as the wind, I am willing to protect the weak classmates, I dare to admit my mistakes and apologize, I am a brave little boy!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to see the awe-inspiring righteousness and courage in their own character, and strengthen the core of self-discipline.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Touching the gold glowing sticker on her chest, her eyes are gentle and bright, and she no longer shyly lowers her head.
"I am very gentle, I am good at folding clothes, I have a considerate and kind heart, and I like what I see in the mirror!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He break through the haze of inferiority, sincerely accept and appreciate the value of your own existence.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Make a big heart shape with both hands above your head, and lead everyone to applaud loudly for everyone in the mirror.
"Everyone is the only miracle in the world!"We all have superpowers to shine, and we are all the best!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to enthusiastically affirm the beauty of group diversity and ignite the fire of hope in life.

💰 Convenience store clerk's abacus
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: A little expert in financial management and self-reliance

🪙 Buying Bread: Counting Money and Checking Change

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with learning disabilities often fail paper-and-pencil arithmetic in class, but in real life, learning to read price tags, take out the correct coin, and check change is an essential foundation for independent adult life. This course teaches practical money skills such as "reading the price tag to find the number, taking out a fifty-dollar coin, and counting change in your palm."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🥐 The fragrant pineapple bread and the clinking coins on the cash register!

Today the special education class has an exciting "Real Money Challenge Outside School"! Give each little hero a blue coin purse containing a fifty-yuan coin and three ten-yuan coins. The whole class walked hand in hand to the FamilyMart convenience store next to the school. He's mission is to buy a "28-yuan puff pastry" for breakfast tomorrow. Walking into the store, He looked at the dazzling array of bread labels on the shelves. The numbers on them were many and complicated. He took the bread and looked at the big characters on the label: "28 yuan". When He walked to the cashier, his palms were sweating, and he didn't know which coin to give to the clerk. A gentle reminder from the side: "He, twenty-eight yuan is smaller than fifty yuan, take out the big fifty-yuan golden coin and give it to your uncle!" "He handed over fifty yuan with both hands, and his uncle said, "Beep!"The barcode was swiped with a sound: "I charge you fifty yuan, give you twenty two yuan!”The uncle put two ten yuan and two one yuan copper coins in He's hand. He took a deep breath and counted the numbers one by one in the palm of his hand: "Ten, twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two!"Exactly twenty-two dollars!"He happily put the bread and the invoice into the bag: "I can buy my own bread! I am the best little shopkeeper!”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What problems might arise if you don't know how much money you need or how much change you'll receive when shopping? How does learning to count change help you become independent as you grow up?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Four little heroes practice buying bread independently at a convenience store, checking the price tag, paying cash, and counting change!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Carefully compare the price of the toast bread on the shelf to 35 yuan, and accurately take out four 10-yuan coins from your wallet to pay.
"Thirty-five yuan to get four ten yuan is just right!"My uncle would ask me for five yuan, I calculated it very clearly!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to successfully implement his number-crunching strengths into real-life trading situations.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Queue up neatly at the cashier, hand over the 100-yuan bills with both hands, and politely say thank you loudly.
"Hello, uncle, I want to buy this sandwich and give you one hundred yuan, thank you!"”
💡 Tips:Guide students to integrate polite spoken language into the routine practice of social life.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Carefully count the 22 yuan change the clerk gives you in your palm, put it into your small wallet and zip it up.
"Two ten yuan is twenty, plus two one yuan is twenty two yuan!"The change is exactly right!”
💡 Tips:Help He overcome money anxiety and build the ability to be independent in real life.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Take the initiative to help pack the noodles that the whole class bought into eco-friendly shopping bags, and remind everyone to keep their receipts.
"If you collect the invoice, you can match the prize!"Everyone successfully bought their own breakfast, a great success!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to take into account the environmental protection of shopping and the management of administrative details.

Take the change with both hands, count it in your palms, and then put it into your wallet.

🚩 Raise a little yellow flag for peace of mind
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Traffic Safety Patrol

🚦 Crossing Safely: Wait for Green, Look Both Ways and Walk Carefully

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with ADHD and autism often lack awareness of road hazards, rushing across green lights and crossing blind spots of turning vehicles, which can easily lead to serious traffic accidents. Teach them three life-saving tips: "Stop at the yellow line and take a step back, look left and right when the green light is on, and hold up the small yellow flag when crossing the street."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦓 A little zebra on the zebra crossing and a small yellow flag held high!

After school, as they crossed the large intersection in front of OO Elementary School, a bustling thoroughfare during recess, large trucks, buses, and motorcycles roared past. Jun and his younger brother, hand in hand, prepared to cross the road. Jun saw the pedestrian crossing signal light up and immediately tried to pull his brother across! Just then, a large truck attempting a right turn sped towards them, its massive cab obstructing the driver's view! A traffic guide standing at the intersection blew her whistle: "Hurry! Danger! Back off!" She grabbed Jun's backpack! The truck, accompanied by a biting gust of wind, whistled past Jun's feet, narrowly missing them by ten centimeters! Jun's legs went weak, and he knelt on the ground, his back soaked with cold sweat. The caregiver crouched down and gently handed Jun a bright yellow "pedestrian safety warning flag": "Honey, big trucks have huge blind spots! The little green flag is lit, so you absolutely can't rush around like a wild horse! We need to stand at the edge of the crosswalk and take a big step back, look left and right to make sure the turning vehicles have completely stopped, then raise the little yellow flag high and take steady steps across the zebra crossing!" Jun took the little yellow flag, took a deep breath, held his younger brother's hand tightly, raised the flag high, looked left and right, and walked safely to the other side!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Why is it so easy to get hit by turning vehicles if you immediately duck and rush across the street when the light turns green? Why can raising a small yellow flag and looking left and right when crossing the street save your precious life?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Facing a busy crosswalk, four little heroes practice starting, stopping, looking, and listening, and safely crossing the road while holding up a flag!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Stand one step behind the sidewalk curb. After the green light turns on, carefully turn your head to look to the left and then to the right to make sure there are no turning vehicles.
"The little green men are on!" We looked left and right. The turning vehicles had stopped and we could leave safely! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to implement accurate visual inspection processes in daily traffic safety protection.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Hold your younger brother's hand tightly, restrain the urge to start running, and walk steadily while holding the bright yellow warning flag high.
"Huh~ I won't rush!" Raise the little yellow flag high to let the big truck driver see us, and walk to the other side safely! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to overcome their reckless and aggressive personality and establish a sense of rigorous self-protection and care for others.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Keep your eyes straight ahead, do not use your phone or look around, and walk steadily on the central stripe of the zebra crossing.
"Walking on the zebra crossing without looking around, looking at the green light on the opposite side, stepping firmly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He maintain a high degree of concentration when crossing the road, eliminating external distractions.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Walk on the outside of the group, always keep an eye out for the movement of motorcycles turning behind you, and guide everyone to arrive safely.
"Everyone, keep the formation and don't scatter. Pay attention to the slow train on the right. Everyone will arrive at the sidewalk safely!"”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia plays the backbone role of escort and leadership in public traffic environment.

🎯 Super power move visual chart card ⭐ Three ways to save your life when crossing the street
1
Stand one step back from the yellow line in the zebra crossing waiting area, and never step onto the road while waiting.
2
After the little green man lights up, he turns his head to the left and then to the right to confirm that the vehicle has come to a complete stop.
3
Raise your right hand or small yellow flag high and walk steadily and straight across the zebra crossing.

🔹 Students with Learning Disabilities (LD)
Use the mantra song: "Stop on red light, go on green light, look left and right for no traffic, hold the yellow flag high and stride forward!"
🔹 Students with Emotional Disorders (EBD)
Treat crossing the road as "a secret agent crossing a minefield", prohibit running and playing, and maintain a high level of concentration throughout the process.

🧼 Seven-step cleansing and refreshing wash
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Refreshing and tidy little gentleman

🚿 Fresh After PE: Clean Clothes, Handwashing and Personal Care

🎯 Summary of core objectives:As special education students enter puberty, they often find themselves drenched in sweat, with dripping wet hair and a strong, unpleasant odor after strenuous physical activity in physical education classes, unaware of their surroundings and causing their peers in regular classes to hold their noses and reject them. They are taught self-management of their personal hygiene, such as wiping away sweat with a towel, changing into dry underwear, and washing their hands and face.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦁 A little lion covered in sweat and a fragrant little towel!

After playing football in the fourth period of physical education class, Yu was sweating profusely. His hair was stuck to his forehead like a drowned rat. The entire back of his gray cotton T-shirt was wet and turned into deep black, exuding a strong, sour and sticky smell of sweat. When the bell rang, Yu gasped for air and was about to walk back to the regular class for lunch wearing this wet and smelly clothes. The classmate sitting next door smelled it and couldn't help pinching his nose and taking a step back: "Wow!" Yu, you smell so bad, the sour smell is so unpleasant! "Yu froze on the spot, his face flushed red, his hands grasping the corners of his clothes at a loss, feeling sad and embarrassed. He greeted Yu gently at the door: "Yu, the profuse sweating means you ran very hard today and you are a true hero!"But after the hero exercise, he needs to undergo a "refreshing transformation"!”Take Yu into the sink, teach him to take out a spare cotton towel and dip it in warm water, wipe off all the sticky sweat on his forehead, neck and arms, wash his face with a fragrant fragrance, and put on a clean and dry blue short-sleeved shirt in the locker room. When Yu changed into dry clothes and walked out, he felt refreshed and exuded a light scent of soap. His classmates smiled and patted Yu on the shoulder: "Yu, you look so handsome and smell good now that you have changed your clothes!"Let's go eat together!”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What health and social problems might arise if you let your clothes get soaked and smelly after sweating profusely during exercise? Why does spending three minutes wiping away sweat and changing clothes after exercise make people like and want to be around you?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:After a PE class, the four little heroes, covered in sweat, practiced their refreshing transformation, changing clothes and washing their faces to maintain cleanliness!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Dry your forehead with a towel at the sink, go into the changing room to change into a dry new T-shirt, and put the wet clothes into a sealed bag.
"Wipe off the sweat and put on clean clothes. My body smells good. I feel so comfortable and energetic!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome body surface moisture discomfort and establish and improve independent hygiene management habits.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Wash your hands thoroughly with soap, palms and backs of hands, wipe your face clean with a handkerchief, and sit back down to prepare for your meal.
"Wash your hands before you can eat lunch!" I am not a sweaty little monster, I am a clean and handsome gentleman! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to integrate personal image self-discipline into routine life practice.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Use a comb to tidy up your messy hair, gently pat off the dust, and maintain a dignified appearance.
"My hair is combed neatly, my face is washed, and I am happiest when I eat lunch neatly!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He develop the habit of careful self-examination of appearance to enhance personal self-esteem.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia

🩹 External Wound Hemostasis and Calming Patch
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance

🩹 A Scraped Knee: Stay Calm and Ask the School Nurse for Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When special education students fall and scrape their knees on the playground, causing bleeding, they often roll violently on the ground and cry loudly due to fear of blood or pain, refusing to stand up or be touched by others. We teach them self-care techniques for trauma, such as "taking deep breaths to stay calm, applying pressure with a clean tissue to stop the bleeding, and walking step by step to the health center to apply iodine."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🩸 Tiny red blood droplets and brave steps towards the health center!

While playing hide-and-seek on the playground after class, He ran too fast and kicked the protruding ditch cover at the edge of the playground. "Thump!" He fell heavily forward onto the rough, muddy ground! His right knee was badly scraped, and bright red blood seeped out, the sand mixed in with the wound stinging painfully. Seeing the blood, He was terrified. He lay on the ground, wailing loudly, kicking his legs wildly, tears and snot streaming down his face: "It's bleeding! My leg is going to break! Help!" Several classmates around him panicked at the sight of the blood. Just then, Jia and Jun rushed over. Jia pulled a pack of clean, sterile tissues from her pocket and gently covered He's knee, pressing lightly: "He, don't panic! Take a deep breath! Look, the bone isn't broken, it's just a scraped area! We have platelet protectors in our brains helping to repair your wound!" Jun crouched down and held He's arm: "He, hold onto my shoulder tightly, I'll be your crutch, let's walk slowly together to the health center to see the nurse apply the medicine!" Looking at the determined eyes of his two friends, He stopped crying, pressed a tissue against his skin, and bravely walked step by step into the health center. The nurse gently disinfected He and applied a breathable gauze, praising everyone: "You handled it so professionally! He is such a calm and brave little warrior!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you fall and scrape your skin, seeing blood, will lying on the ground crying and screaming stop the bleeding? Why is pressing the wound with a clean tissue and bravely going to the health center the best way to protect yourself?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A child falls on the playground, scrapes and bleeds their knee. The four little heroes practice overcoming their fear of blood and crying, applying pressure to stop the bleeding, and calmly seeking medical attention!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Calmly pick up the water bottle and hat that He dropped, and quickly lead the way to guide them toward the health center.
"Don't be afraid, He, the health center is right in front, and the nurse aunt has magical cooling ointment! ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu shows calm assistance and guidance support functions at the accident scene.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Squat down to act as a strong crutch, carefully support He's arm, and move forward in coordination with He's slow pace.
"Hold my shoulders!" Walk slowly and don't be in a hurry. With big brother here, you will never fall again! ”
💡 Tips:The guide transforms body strength into strong arms that tenderly care for his injured peers.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Press a clean tissue against the wound on your knee to stop your tears, grit your teeth and bravely take a step toward the infirmary.
"I took a deep breath and stopped crying!"The platelets were pressing on the wound to help me repair it, and I was able to walk and apply the medicine on my own!”
💡 Tips:Help He overcome physical pain panic and build strong mental toughness against frustration.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Carefully use a clean tissue to gently press the edges of the wound while gently comforting your companion.
"Take a deep breath ~ inhale ~ exhale, the blood has become less, He, you are so brave!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to skillfully use primary first aid knowledge to stabilize the patient's emotions.

📜 Writing a Letter to a Future Hero

📮 A Letter to My Future Self: Keep Learning and Keep Trying

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Looking back on the countless hardships overcome along the way, including sensory sensitivity, emotional stagnation, reading difficulties, and interpersonal friction, the students are guided to write a letter by hand (or dictate and draw a picture) and seal it in the "future time capsule," promising themselves a year from now that they will never give up.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
✉️ A golden envelope and a time travel journey a year later!

Today in the special education classroom of OO Elementary School, I took out four "time capsule sealed iron boxes" with golden wings printed on them. There is beautiful letter paper and colorful crayons on the table. "Children, during this long journey in the past, you have learned to shrink your shell, learn to throw and catch a ball and chat, learn to wipe your tears when you fall, and learn to be considerate of your elders and siblings. Today, we have to complete one of the most solemn tasks in the universe - write a letter to "myself who will enter the new grade in one year"! ”The four little heroes held pens and carefully wrote down the deepest words in their hearts on the letter paper. Yu drew a flying dragon with wide wings and wrote: "To Yu a year from now: I hope you will dare to look into the eyes of new friends and smile by then, and you can take a deep breath when you encounter things that scare you!" ” Xiao Zhen wrote: “To future Zhan: When you are angry, you must count to ten and be a reasonable hero! "He drew a big red flower: "To the future He: Even if the words are dancing, I will slowly cut the chocolate. I am not stupid, I am great! "Everyone folded the letter paper filled with love and vows and put it into the iron box."Click! "Lock the gold combination lock with a sound. With red eyes, he led everyone to bow deeply: "Children, in the future, you will definitely be extremely proud of yourselves for your bravery and perseverance today!"”

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Think back on all the superpowers you've learned from the past to the present, what would you like to say to your future self? Why does sealing your vows in a time capsule give you so much motivation to move forward?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Sealing a time capsule written to their future selves, four little heroes practice reviewing their growth and transformation, and making firm self-commitments!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu

"Hello future Yu, I hope that you in the future will have made many good friends and smile every day!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu uses visual art combined with written vows to anchor the vision of positive self-identity.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Draw a clenched fist on the letter paper and transform it into a big heart. Write down your vow to be a good older brother with self-discipline in your emotions.
"To the future: When you are angry, be as steady as a mountain, and never forget to step on the brake!"”
💡 Tips:Guide people to transform growth reflection into moral sentiments deeply rooted in the soul.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Paste colorful little flowers all around the letter paper and write down your sincere affirmation of your perseverance and never giving up.
"To the future: You are really great. Although you are a slow learner, you take every step seriously!"”
💡 Tips:Help He experience profound self-soothing and self-efficacy improvement.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Holding the golden time-space iron box with both hands, preside over the sacred sealing ceremony with a solemn and resolute expression.
"The No. 1 space-time capsule has been sealed!"Today, one year later, we must all become better versions of ourselves!”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia gives the learning process a noble meaning of life through the practice of ritual.

🌟 Captain of the Boat, Taking Control of Life
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance

🌟 My Social Skills Journey: I Am the Captain of My Life

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Reviewing all the scenario drills in the entire 49-item lesson preparation inspiration library, the four little heroes integrated all the skills of sensory adjustment, pragmatic social skills, learning resilience, conflict resolution, environmental adaptation, and independent living, and won the highest honor, the "Life Captain Gold Medal," ready to set sail for a magnificent and wonderful life!

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚢 A golden rudder and a great pirate ship cutting through the waves!

In front of the podium of the special education classroom, a large, golden wooden "Life Wheel" was erected today, surrounded by the glittering badges and flags of all the One Hundred and One Classes! The ribbons were fluttering, and the big screen showed precious scenes of Yu, He, Jia, and Zhen sweating and crying but getting up with a smile along the way. With tears in his eyes, he stepped forward with four heavy "Almighty and Independent Little Captain Gold Cups" in his hands: "Little heroes, looking back on these forty-nine extraordinary thematic inspirations, you have learned how to protect your ears when the siren sounds, how to smile when you are rejected, how to gently repair torn paper when writing, and how to alertly ask for help when you are lost." Special education has never meant that you become exactly like others, but that you should learn to sail your own sailing boat! Now, the sea of life is ahead, and each of you is a top little captain holding a golden steering wheel! "Yu, Jia, He, and Jia stood side by side in front of the steering wheel, with four pairs of small hands tightly holding the steering wheel, shouting in unison: "Report, we have learned all the superpowers! No matter how big the storm is in the future, we will hold our heads high and move forward through the waves! ”The golden crackers resounded through the sky, and the bright smiles of the four little heroes bloomed into a dazzling rainbow that will never fade under the clear sky of OO Elementary School!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Now that you've learned so many special education life and interpersonal skills, what will you do when you encounter difficulties in life? Why do you say you are the best little captain in your own life?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A grand graduation ceremony and award ceremony for the complete set of 49 inspiration themes, where four little heroes practice taking the helm of their lives and embarking on a new journey!

"I am Yu!" I am no longer afraid to look into my friends’ eyes. I will hold my own rudder and sail bravely into the future! ”
💡 Tips:Guiding Yu to show his comprehensive self-confidence and independent style, and to complete the life transcendence of autism characteristics.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Hang the gleaming gold medal around your neck, let your hands hang naturally at your sides, and stand with the heroic posture of a great general.
"I am Jia!" I turned the impulsive monster into a powerful force to protect everyone. I am the strongest guardian angel of life! ”
💡 Tips:Guidance to completely quench excess energy and competitiveness into noble self-discipline character.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Raise the gold cup of honor high in your hand, with a bright and beautiful smile of pride on your face.
"I am He!" I am not stupid, I am very practical every step of the way, and I am proud of myself for my unremitting efforts! ”
💡 Tips:Help He usher in the full bloom of the dignity of inner life, and face a bright future.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Lead all the little heroes to bow deeply to the teachers who have worked so hard to accompany them, to express their highest gratitude.
"Thank you teacher for teaching us super powers!"We are the four most united secret service heroes in the universe!”
💡 Tips:The guide should repay the teacher's kindness with full gratitude and demonstrate the lofty glory of the great love of special education.
